title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
description:
Leads one or more platform teams; defines tactical and key strategic elements for middleware evolution serving multiple consumers. Accountable for performance, cost control, and reliability outcomes; escalations for distributed debugging and upgrade safety. Drives significant cross-team improvements to observability, SLOs, and resilience patterns. Engages stakeholders inside and outside the group; socializes migration plans and adoption playbooks.
  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Platform Software Development:**

* Lead multiple platform teams to standardize middleware patterns and client libraries used by several consumer teams.
* Establish group-level guardrails for APIs/SDKs, deprecation strategies, and upgrade playbooks; track adoption and risk.
* Sponsor shared observability frameworks and capacity models across teams; review error-budget posture and corrective actions.

**Software Development and Coding - Design, Testing, and Optimization:**

* Leads teams and provides technical recommendations and guidance in designing software solutions and identifying, analyzing and ensuring alignment with requirements.
* Manages the execution of processes to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and to develop documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads code and/or functional reviews to drive improvements across a project.
* Leads and reviews teams to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix software issues across multiple components or functional areas.
* Provides teams guidance to implement software testing (e.g., functional and non-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
* Utilizes an analytic approach to conduct performance profiling and optimization of coding.
* Leads teams in troubleshooting and resolving issues related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
* Leads teams to implement API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

**Software Architecture - Software System Structural Design:**

* Leads teams to design and develop software, systems, and services.
* Acts as a role model to provide technical guidance and domain expertise in software architecture decisions and best practices.
* Leads teams to conduct periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural framework(s) and internal development practices and standards.
* Collaborates with cross-functional teams to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities in focus.
* Leads teams to implement performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
* Impacts teams to conduct regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements.

**Issue/Defect Collaboration - Software Products Support:**

* Collaborates with stakeholders and external clients and/or partners to understand customer issues and align solutions.
* Leads team(s) to provide technical guidance and appropriately prioritize support to customers regarding reported issues.
* Acts as a role model for teams to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements based on feedback.
* Develops, modifies, and executes policies to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Leads teams through processes for handling customer issues and/or defects handling and directs them to training opportunities as needed.
* Manages the investigation and troubleshooting of complex product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short- and long-term solutions.

**Practices and Standards Compliance - Security and Compliance:**

* Collaborates with teams and other stakeholders within and outside of group to establish, follow, and enforce documented security criteria, development industry best practices and processes, and coding standards.
* Ensures clarity of teams' operational objectives for adherence to broad acceptance criteria.
* Implements moderately complex secure software development practices requiring information gathering and analysis to prevent security vulnerabilities.

**Development Operations - System Maintenance:**

* Leads teams in performing periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
* Delegates assignments to teams to implement and evolve standard operating procedures (SOP) for development and for driving improvements, ensuring automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**

**Planning & Execution:**

* Manages multiple medium- to large-scale projects or initiatives across teams, ensuring timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable are monitored and met. Provides direction to teams on project work, setting priorities, and aligning with business needs. Guides teams on adjusting plans to accommodate resource or timeline changes.

**Collaboration & Partnership:**

* Drives cross-functional partnerships to align expectations and shared objectives across multiple teams. Coaches team members to develop strategic relationships with business leaders, stakeholders, and external partners to foster collaboration and long-term success. Promotes inclusivity by actively seeking and listening to diverse perspectives, ensuring others feel heard and respected.

**Problem Solving:**

* Provides direction to multiple teams on addressing complex operational and/or technical issues as well as providing guidance on analyzing complex data and/or information to identify solutions. Reviews and provides insights into unresolved or critical issues, helping the team to identify potential solutions.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Models engaging in continuous learning to deepen expertise and stay ahead of industry trends, integrating best practices into strategic planning. Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Drives team to collaborate on, develop, and implement ideas to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows within and across teams, providing oversight. Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

* Drives performance across teams by providing feedback and coaching in alignment with performance management processes, guidelines, and expectations. Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources.

title: Senior Implementation Specialist (Fixed Term)
description:
At NAVEX, we’re transforming the world—making it safer, more ethical, and ensuring every voice is heard. That’s real impact.
  
Our high-performance culture is driven by our values. We move with speed, passion and purpose — as one team. We are bold in our ideas, accountable in our actions, and committed to doing the right things right.
  
  
We are looking for an 18-month fixed-term contract Senior Implementation Specialist to join our fun, close-knit team that’s respectful of everyone and committed to your continued growth and success!
  
  
Are you someone who is organized, detail-oriented, and an excellent communicator? Are you interested in building a career in Project Management? If so, this Senior Implementation Specialist role may be a great fit for you!
  
  
NAVEX is seeking a contract Senior Implementation Specialist for an 18-month engagement who will thrill, delight, and guide our customers through the implementation of our integrated risk and compliance management software and solutions. In this role, you will leverage the implementation team’s collective experience and learn our highly effective project management methodology while owning a portfolio of implementation projects, with a focus on successful and on-time delivery.
  
  
As an Senior Implementation Specialist, you will manage project timelines, support customers in planning and tracking key deliverables, configure customer software solutions, and lead virtual customer meetings and training sessions.
  
  
At NAVEX, you will work in a hybrid role and thrive alongside an engaged and collaborative team invested in supporting your success!
  
  
**What you’ll get:**  

* Meaningful Purpose. Your work helps organizations operate with integrity and protect their people—at a scale few companies can match.
* High-Performance Environment. We move with urgency, set ambitious goals, and expect excellence. You’ll be trusted with real ownership and supported to do the best work of your career.
* Candid, Supportive Culture. We communicate openly, challenge ideas—not people—and value teammates who embrace bold thinking and continuous improvement.
* Growth That Matters. You can count on authentic feedback, strong accountability, and leaders invested in your success so you can achieve real growth.
* Rewards for Results. We provide clear, competitive compensation designed to recognize measurable outcomes and real impact.

**What you’ll do:**  

* Provide world-class customer service to all NAVEX customers
* Proactively reach out to existing customers to initiate and coordinate migration efforts, clearly communicating the benefits of transitioning from legacy platforms to NAVEX solutions
* Set expectations, establish project timelines, and motivate our customers to deliver within scope and on time
* Coordinate internal and external resources via verbal and written communication for the flawless execution of customer projects
* Manage multiple implementation projects, prioritizing project responsibilities, executing project deliverables and tracking projects to successful completion
* Maintain accurate customer and project records
* Demonstrate use cases for migration effort
* Configure customer software using proprietary tools
* Provide project status updates and reliable project completion forecasting to your team manager at regularly scheduled meetings and as requested
* Maintain individual Key Performance targets
* Be present in the NAVEX office at least 2 days per week
* Work on other exciting internal initiatives, as specified by your team manager

**What you’ll need:**  

* 3+ years of experience in a customer service, project management, and/or implementation role
* SaaS experience strongly desired
* Experience supporting North American customers via phone and email
* Superior verbal and written communication skills
* A high level of attention to detail, excellent follow through, consistently reliable and accountable
* The ability to work independently as a self-starter and within a team environment
* The ability to learn and assimilate new information quickly
* Flexibility to adjust to a dynamic work environment and contribute to a growing team
* The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work within fixed deadlines
* The ability to foster customer relationships
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Office and Salesforce
* Culture Agility. Comfort working in a fast-paced, candid environment that values innovation, healthy debate, and follow-through
* AI Readiness. Curiosity and willingness to use AI and emerging technologies to elevate your work and deliver smarter outcomes
* Fuel performance and outcomes. Leverage your job competencies and champion NAVEX’s core values

**Our side of the deal:**  

* We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way.
* The starting pay rate for this role is 990,000 INR per annum. Shifts ending between 12:00 AM IST and 07:00 AM IST are eligible for a night shift differential of 500 INR/day. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. NAVEX is an equal opportunity employer committed to including individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities and veteran status.

title: Managing Consultant Corporate Strategy & Development
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**  
Corporate Strategy professionals shape Kyndryl's long-term direction and growth by leading high-impact, cross-functional initiatives and supporting executive decision-making. They partner closely with senior leaders to develop and execute enterprise strategies, leverage market, financial, customer, and competitive insights, and solve complex business challenges that drive growth and enterprise value.

Combining strategic thinking, analytical rigour, financial expertise, business case development, and executive communication skills, they support strategic planning, growth initiatives, investment decisions, and enterprise transformation programs that strengthen competitive advantage and deliver sustainable business outcomes.Are you a strategic thinker with a passion for shaping the future of a global technology company? Are you energized by the opportunity to work directly with senior leaders on high-impact initiatives that influence growth, investment decisions, and long-term enterprise strategy? Then we have a unique opportunity for you as a Managing Consultant, Corporate Strategy.

In this role, you will lead and support some of Kyndryl's most important strategic priorities, helping define the choices that shape the company's future direction and growth. Working closely with senior executives, business-unit leaders, finance teams, and cross-functional stakeholders, you will evaluate complex business challenges, identify opportunities for value creation, and develop recommendations that drive measurable business outcomes.

  
  

**What You Will Do**

  

* As a Managing Consultant, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact across the enterprise.
* You will partner with leadership teams to develop corporate and business-unit strategies, assess growth opportunities, evaluate investment priorities, and support critical executive decisions.
* You will conduct rigorous market research, competitive benchmarking, strategic assessments, and financial analyses to identify emerging opportunities, address key business challenges, and help position Kyndryl for long-term success in a dynamic and rapidly evolving marketplace.
* You will play a central role in strategic planning, business case development, and enterprise transformation initiatives.
* Leveraging your analytical rigor, structured problem-solving capabilities, and financial expertise, you will develop executive-level recommendations, strategic roadmaps, investment theses, and implementation plans that enable leadership teams to make informed, fact-based decisions.
* You will also help ensure alignment across stakeholders, monitor progress against strategic objectives, and support the successful execution of critical initiatives.
* Our consultants are restless for innovation.
    
  They thrive at the intersection of business strategy, technology, and transformation, helping shape the future of Kyndryl and our customers.
    
  So, if you are a problem-solver, an analytical thinker, and a self-starter who enjoys working on high-visibility assignments with senior leadership, we want to hear from you. Apply today to join our dynamic team and help solve the strategic challenges that will define Kyndryl's next chapter.

  
  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

Becoming a Project Manager at Kyndryl is an excellent gateway to many different paths. You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications.You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a Senior Project Manager or program manager. There are many different types and flavors of project manager roles, so everyone can find the opportunity that suits them best.

**Who You Are**

You are an experienced corporate strategy, business consulting professional - you are good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important - you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are commercially minded and customer-focused - someone who prioritizes customer success, understands enterprise buying behaviour, brings extensive stakeholder-facing exposure, and applies critical thinking to complex business problems. And finally, you are open and borderless - naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Advanced graduate degree (e.g., MBA, PhD) in business, economics, finance, engineering, analytics, or a related field
* Over 7 years of experience in corporate strategy, pricing strategy, go-to-market strategy, commercial strategy, or management consulting, with 4+ years preferably with leading management consulting firms or technology services / software companies
* Demonstrated expertise developing GTM and pricing strategies for managed services, cloud services, software / SaaS, IT infrastructure, or hybrid technology offerings
* Ability to build robust business cases, price waterfalls, margin analyses, elasticity assessments, unit economics models, total cost of ownership models, and customer ROI frameworks
* Experience shaping go-to-market strategies, including sales and channel motions, portfolio positioning, launch planning, customer segmentation, partner monetization, and KPI frameworks
* Skilled in gathering and synthesizing data, conducting market research, competitive benchmarking, customer research, and translating insights into actionable recommendations
* Strong critical thinking, data analysis, financial modeling, and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to synthesize ambiguity into clear executive choices
* Ability to lead independent workstreams within larger corporate strategy initiatives and influence stakeholders across Offering, Sales, Finance, Delivery, Legal, and executive leadership
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills for developing executive and board-level presentations, pricing recommendations, decision memos, and implementation roadmaps
Extensive customer-facing or stakeholder-facing exposure with strong commercial acumen, including familiarity with enterprise procurement dynamics, deal economics, and technology services / software sales cycles  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* Experience in global technology services, managed infrastructure, cloud, software / SaaS, cybersecurity, IT modernization, or hyperscale partner ecosystems
* Experience supporting pricing transformations, portfolio simplification, commercial governance, go-to-market redesign, sales enablement, or partner monetization programs
* Familiarity with pricing analytics, CRM / CPQ workflows, cloud financial management / FinOps, product management practices, or software licensing operations
Industry certifications or training in cloud platforms, FinOps, pricing, product management, strategic finance, or related disciplines  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: MGR SYSTEMS ARCHITECT - INDIA
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

**The Role**
------------

Team Management: Mgr. Systems Architects manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects, lead architects, and associate managers, assigning them to the right Agile Release Trains (ARTs).
  
Guidance and Mentorship: They guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently, mentor reportees, and ensure they contribute towards achieving business goals and managing technical debt.
  
Architectural Oversight: They oversee system design and roadmap, drive architectural initiatives, identify opportunities for optimization, and ensure designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT guidelines.
  
Coordination Across ARTs: Mgr. Systems Architects ensure technology alignments across ARTs, confirm capabilities meet Definition of Ready (DoR), and review estimates and critical features by working with other architects.
  
Production Performance and Stability: They maintain full awareness of application performance in production environments, participate in SWAT calls to address stability issues, and help document root causes.
  
Engagement and Collaboration: They engage with system architects, outside vendors, and various teams to review and ensure the success of designs, and participate in Continuous Exploration processes.

**The Main Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

* Manage a team of 6 to 10 Sr. system architects / lead architects / associate mgr system architects and assign to right ARTs.
* Guide and enable the team to deliver designs efficiently
* Enable system architects in the team to own and contribute towards achieving business goals and technical debt.
* Understand overall system design and roadmap
* Drive architectural initiatives and identify opportunities for optimization
* Oversee, mentor and guide reportees.
* Identify areas where POCs are required and assign to reportees as appropriate and track the same to completion.
* Mgr System Architects manage reportees working across ARTs.
* Ensure technology alignments across ARTs; align teams of multiple ARTs to a shared technical direction by working with respective ART System architects
* Confirm Capability meets Definition of Ready (DoR) before approving for multiple ARTs
* Attend and participate in Mass Markets Architecture Review Boards
* Review Capability estimates by working closely with other system architects across ARTs.
* Ensure ART system designs adhere to Lumen Enterprise IT roadmap, guidelines, principles
* Review critical enabler Features and NFRs created by ART architects
* Engage with other system architects and establish an integrated technical design
* Engage with outside vendors to ensure design success
* Engage system architects to review designs and ensure complete end to end success (ie. Omni channel, flow through, etc.)
* Actively participate in the Continuous Exploration (keeping up with the industry) process as part of the Continuous Delivery Pipeline, especially with Enabler Epics
* Collaborate with their application/service development team, Load and Performance team, chaos engineering team, SRE SPOC etc.
* Have full awareness of application/service performance in production environment, upstream / downstream applications, database performance characteristics etc.
* Participate in Proactive / Reactive SWAT calls to address production stability issues, help teams on identifying and documenting accurate root cause of issues.
* Review ART technical enabler Feature content
* Review ART environment performance, stability, and scalability targets
* Review critical nonfunctional requirements. Provide inputs based on production stability, performance issues, bottle necks, User experience issues, security etc.
* Review ART system designs focused on system components which align to the larger end state designs
* Review ART technical system design documents
* Review deisgn of subsystems and their interfaces; allocate responsibilities to subsystems; understand design deployment; communicate requirements for interactions within design context.
* Review ART data flow, sources, storage, format
* Review technical and architectural vision for the ARTs and provide inputs to system architects

**What We Look For in a Candidate**
-----------------------------------

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  

* Minimum 10 years of software development experience, with deep expertise in C#, .NET / .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework / EF Core, and LINQ.
* At least 3 years in a solution/application architect role, an engineering manager role, or both.
* Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise applications on Microsoft Azure.
* Strong expertise in microservices, API design, distributed systems, and design patterns (including SOLID, domain-driven design, CQRS, and event-driven architecture).
* Deep experience with Microsoft SQL Server: data modeling, complex T-SQL, stored procedures, indexing, query and performance tuning, execution plans, and transaction and locking behavior.
* Experience with GitHub, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Strong knowledge of application security, including OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, Azure AD / Entra ID, secrets management, and secure handling of sensitive financial data.
* Experience with observability and production support tools such as Application Insights and Azure Monitor.
* Experience leading Agile/Scrum teams using Jira (Confluence is a plus).
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across time zones with US-based leadership and business teams.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills
  

* AI/ML: experience designing or delivering AI/ML or LLM-powered solutions (RAG, agents, Semantic Kernel, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning).
* Palantir: exposure to Palantir Foundry or AIP.
* Python: hands-on experience with Python for services, automation, or data work.
* Multi-cloud: experience architecting across AWS or Google Cloud in addition to Azure.
* Containers and orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes (AKS).
* Infrastructure as Code with Terraform or Bicep.
* Front-end architecture experience with Angular, React, or Blazor.
* Experience with messaging and streaming platforms (Azure Service Bus, Event Grid, Kafka).
* Domain knowledge in billing, payments, invoicing, collections, revenue management, or other financial systems, ideally in telecom or large enterprise.

  

What We're Looking For
  

* A leader who balances hands-on technical depth with strong people management.
* A strategic thinker who can set a clear technical direction and turn it into practical delivery plans.
* Someone who builds trust across teams and time zones through clear, proactive communication.
* A mentor who enjoys developing engineers and raising the bar for the whole team.
* Someone excited to help the team adopt cloud and AI in a responsible, business-focused way.

Requisition #: 343990

Our Lumen 8 behaviors guide how we interact, make decisions, and work together, shaping a culture built to perform and win.

title: Senior Manager - Content Operations
description:
We are seeking an experienced and inspiring leader to lead our global Private Market Operations organisation, supporting multiple LSEG businesses, primarily within the Data & Analytics division.

This role leads a globally distributed team of more than 130 colleagues responsible for delivering authoritative entity reference data that powers critical customer workflows, supports regulatory use cases, and enables the success of a broad portfolio of LSEG products and services.

As Senior Manager, you will shape strategy, drive operational excellence, champion transformation, and build an high-performing culture. You will play a pivotal role in advancing our Private Markets growth ambitions through scalable operations, innovation, client focus, and strong cross-functional partnership.

**What You'll Do**

**Lead a Global Organisation**

* Provide inspirational leadership to a large global operations team, creating transparency, alignment, and accountability across regions and functions.
* Nurture a culture of speak up where colleagues can grow, chip in, and perform at their best.
* Enable leaders and teams to deliver consistently against operational, strategic, and customer outcomes.

**Deliver Exceptional Customer Outcomes**

* Ensure the timely delivery of high-quality data, products, and services that meet customer expectations and commercial commitments.
* Use customer insights, market trends, and performance data to continuously improve service delivery and customer experience.
* Develop a customer-first approach.

**Shape and Implement Strategy**

* Define and deliver the strategic roadmap for Private Market Operations, aligning priorities with business objectives and growth opportunities.
* Lead initiatives that expand content coverage, enhance service capabilities, improve scalability, and strengthen competitive advantage.
* Translate long-term strategy into clear operational plans and measurable outcomes.

**Drive Transformation and Innovation**

* Lead business transformation through process improvement, automation, artificial intelligence, and technology-enabled change.
* Find opportunities to simplify, transform, and scale operations while improving quality and efficiency.
* Build a culture that accepts innovation, continuous improvement, and learning.

**Deliver Business Performance**

* Lead budgets responsibly and optimise resources to achieve financial, operational, and customer goals.
* Monitor and improve key performance indicators, ensuring sustainable delivery against targets and commitments.
* Balance operational excellence with strategic investment and long-term growth.

**Provide Leadership**

* Offer strategic guidance and subject matter expertise to support sound decision-making across the organisation.
* Anticipate emerging trends, risks, and opportunities within Private Markets and related data ecosystems.
* Enable informed decisions through data-driven insights and business expertise.

**Develop Talent and Capability**

* Attract, develop, and retain diverse talent through coaching, mentoring, succession planning, and capability-building initiatives.
* Create opportunities for career growth and leadership development across the organisation.
* Recognise and celebrate achievements while maintaining high performance standards.

**Build Strong Partnerships**

* Work-closely with Product, Technology, Commercial, Strategy, and Operations leaders to shape future capabilities and deliver customer value.
* Influence business outcomes through effective collaborator engagement and partnership.
* Foster productive relationships that accelerate innovation and execution.

**Represent the Function**

* Act as a trusted leader and advocate for Private Market Operations across senior leadership forums.
* Chip in to broader business, operational, and strategic priorities that support the success of LSEG.

**Why This Role Matters**

Private market data is a critical growth area for LSEG. This role leads a business-critical capability that enables customers to discover, connect, and use trusted entity data across products, services, and regulatory solutions.

You will have the opportunity to influence strategy, shape future operating models, drive transformation at scale, and deliver measurable impact for customers, colleagues, and the business. Your leadership will directly chip in to strengthening LSEG's position as a trusted provider of high-quality data and insights.

**What We're Looking For**

We are looking for a strategic and customer-focused leader with deep experience in financial data, content operations, information services, or related environments. You combine operational perfection with strong commercial competence & shown track record to lead large-scale transformation.

**Key Qualifications and Experience**

* Significant leadership experience in large-scale operations, data, content, information services, or related environments.
* Proven understanding of financial markets, entity data, reference data, private markets, or comparable information domains.
* Shown success leading global teams through growth, transformation, organisational change, and business evolution.
* Demonstrated experience delivering against operational, financial, quality, and customer performance objectives.
* Strong background of improving business performance through process excellence, automation, technology adoption, and innovation.
* Experience influencing senior collaborators and driving alignment across Operations, Product, Commercial, Strategy, and Technology functions.
* Exceptional people leader skills with a consistent record to build capability, develop future leaders, and create highly engaged teams.
* Excellent communication, partnership, collaborator management, and executive influence skills.
* Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Ability to navigate complexity, prioritise effectively, and drive execution in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

**Success in This Role**

Successful candidates will:

* Lead with curiosity, kindness, and accountability.
* Create clarity and alignment across complex priorities.
* Inspire teams through change and transformation.
* Build trusted partnerships across the organisation.
* Deliver outstanding customer, operational, and commercial outcomes.
* Shape the future of Private Market Operations through innovation, scalability, and continuous improvement.

title: CIB Business Enablement Senior Manager
description:
**About the Role**

The **CIB Business Execution Senior Manager** plays a critical leadership role within the CIB Chief Operating Office (COO) organization and is responsible for leading multiple strategic functions within the Chief Administrative Office (CAO) portfolio. This role provides leadership across a diverse set of enterprise capabilities that support Corporate & Investment Banking (CIB), including Vendor Management, Access Support & Oversight, Business Resiliency, Information Research & Presentation Design Services, Digital and Physical Records Management, Controls Procedure Management, International Governance, Business Management, and Sustainability initiatives.

The successful candidate will provide strategic direction and operational leadership across these functions while partnering with senior executives to drive business priorities, strengthen governance and controls, improve organizational effectiveness, and deliver scalable operating models supporting Wells Fargo's global Corporate & Investment Banking businesses.

This leader will be accountable for driving transformational initiatives, enhancing risk and control frameworks, optimizing organizational capacity, and ensuring effective execution of key regulatory, governance, and business management priorities. The role requires a strong understanding of CIB products and operations, exceptional stakeholder management capabilities, and demonstrated experience leading large, diverse teams in a highly matrixed environment.

**In this role you will:**

CAO Leadership

* Provide strategic leadership and oversight across multiple CAO functions supporting CIB businesses globally, including Banking, Markets, and Commercial Real Estate.
* Drive operational excellence, organizational effectiveness, and continuous improvement across all supported functions.
* Lead large, geographically diverse teams while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and high performance.
* Develop and execute long-term strategies that align with CIB and enterprise objectives.

CAO Strategy & Transformation

* Lead strategic initiatives on behalf of CIB CAO leadership, including organizational design, capacity planning, target operating model development, and business transformation programs.
* Drive horizontal reviews across key themes including risk and control effectiveness, process optimization, workforce strategy, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with senior leaders across CIB and enterprise functions to identify opportunities for simplification, standardization, and scale.
* Deliver executive-level insights and recommendations that support business decision-making and strategic planning.

International Governance & Business Management

* Provide oversight of governance and business management activities supporting international legal entities, branches, and management committees.
* Ensure effective execution of governance forums through agenda planning, material preparation, action tracking, KPI reporting, and management information dashboards.
* Support executive briefing preparation for Senior Management Function (SMF), regulatory, and leadership engagements.
* Drive accountability for governance actions and strategic initiatives across international businesses and legal entities.

Risk, Controls & Regulatory Management

* Strengthen risk and control frameworks across supported functions while ensuring alignment with enterprise policies and regulatory expectations.
* Partner with Risk, Compliance, Legal, Audit, and Control Management teams to proactively identify and mitigate risks.
* Drive sustainable control execution and governance practices that support a strong risk culture.

Metrics, Reporting & Executive Management

Stakeholder Management & Influence

* 7+ years of Business Execution, Implementation, or Strategic Planning experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience within Corporate & Investment Banking, preferably across leading global financial institutions.
* Proven experience leading large-scale operations, business management, COO, CAO, governance, or strategic execution functions.
* Strong leadership experience managing managers and senior leaders, including Vice Presidents and above.
* Deep understanding of Corporate & Investment Banking products, including Corporate Banking, Capital Markets, Fixed Income, Foreign Exchange, Equities, Derivatives, and Commercial Real Estate.

* Strong experience driving organizational transformation, operating model design, and strategic change initiatives.

title: Senior P&C Coordinator
description:
**About Energy Exemplar**

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.*
* *Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.*
* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners*
* *Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category*
* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*

**How We Work**

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the** **Position**

As Senior P&C Coordinator, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the employee experience at Energy Exemplar, supporting assigned business functions across India. As the day-to-day P&C contact for managers and employees, you’ll build trusted relationships, understand team priorities and turn employee feedback and people data into practical recommendations that make a difference.

You’ll take ownership of key moments in the employee journey, from welcoming new starters and supporting probation through to offboarding, coordinating with relevant teams to deliver a smooth and positive experience. You’ll also help bring people programmes to life, guide managers through established policies and processes, and partner with the Senior Director, P&C on sensitive or complex matters.

This opportunity will suit someone who enjoys connecting with people, solving problems and taking initiative. How you work matters as much as what you deliver. We are looking for someone who brings a positive, constructive attitude, contributes to team success, actively seeks and applies feedback, and takes initiative to follow things through. The role offers opportunities to broaden your contribution and responsibility as you demonstrate sound judgment, consistent delivery and impact.

  

**Key Accountabilities and Duties**

* Provide quality, timely and professional P&C advice to managers and employees on established people processes and policies and build effective working relationships with stakeholders across assigned functions.

* Partner with managers to understand business priorities, team capability needs, employee motivations and retention risks, and help translate these into practical people actions for their teams.

* Support the delivery of performance and development processes, including goal and review cycles, development plans, talent discussions and follow-up on agreed actions.

* Work with managers to interpret engagement survey results and employee feedback, identify themes, agree relevant actions and monitor progress.

* Be accountable for the onboarding experience for employees, including Energy Exemplar’s sign-to-start programme, manager readiness, induction coordination and probation follow-up. Identify opportunities to improve the new-joiner experience.

* Conduct 30, 60 and 90 day new-joiner check-ins to assess the onboarding experience, identify issues requiring follow-up and share themes with managers and P&C leadership.

* Coordinate employee changes and offboarding, conduct exit interviews where appropriate, and identify themes and recommendations for action.

* Ensure the accurate and timely administration and safekeeping of employee records, HRIS information and documentation in line with local requirements and Global P&C processes.

* Produce accurate and informative reports, including headcount, attrition, onboarding, engagement and employee movements, and share insights and recommendations with relevant stakeholders.

* Collaborate with the Global P&C team and internal partners to deliver consistent people processes and employee experiences across locations and suggest improvements to established practices.

* Escalate sensitive employee relations matters, disciplinary issues, separations, compensation or policy exceptions, and significant people risks to the Senior Director, P&C for review and decision.

* Use approved AI tools where appropriate to improve the quality and efficiency of P&C communications, reporting, analysis and routine workflows; verify outputs before use and protect confidential employee information.

  

**Candidate Requirements**

* Constructive attitude and teamwork: Approaches challenges with a practical, solution-focused mindset, supports colleagues and contributes to shared outcomes. Willingly takes on the detailed and routine work needed to deliver a strong employee experience.

* Coachability and self-awareness: Actively seeks feedback, listens openly, takes responsibility for errors and demonstrates how learning translates into improved performance.

* Initiative and follow-through: Identifies what needs attention, recommends practical action and follows through on commitments without repeated prompting. Knows when to act independently and when to seek guidance.

* Learning and growth: Shows curiosity about the business and the P&C profession, applies new learning and builds credibility through the quality and impact of their work.

* Collaborative confidence: Listens to different perspectives, shares credit and adapts their approach when presented with better information. Can respectfully question an approach and offer an alternative.

* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in an HR generalist or people advisory role, including direct support to managers; experience in a product technology or software environment is an advantage.

* Working understanding of India employment practices, HR compliance and relevant labour legislation, with the judgment to recognise when specialist advice is needed.

* Experience supporting employee lifecycle processes, performance and engagement programmes, and interpreting people data to recommend actions.

* Ability to build trust with managers and employees, ask thoughtful questions, communicate clearly and follow issues through to resolution.

* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to balance portfolio priorities and deliver accurate work in a changing environment.

* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with BambooHR or a similar HRIS is desirable.

* AI readiness: confidence using approved AI tools for drafting, analysis and routine workflows; ability to write useful prompts, verify results against source information, recognise errors or bias, and handle employee data in line with company requirements.

  

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resource Management or related field

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.

title: Director of Platform Engineering
description:
**Who are Evotix?**
===================

We're a growing global EHS SaaS company with a clear ambition: to combine world-class software, data and AI to help our customers operate smarter, safer and more efficiently. For exceptional talent, Evotix offers something rare-the pace of a growth company, the scale to make a real difference, and the opportunity to influence strategy, technology and outcomes at a global level.

At Evotix, we're creating the future of workplace health, safety and wellbeing—and we need ELITE people to help us do it. People who pursue **Excellence**, show **Leadership**, deliver **Impact**, earn **Trust**, and **Empower** those around them.

**Role purpose**
----------------

The Director of Platform Engineering is the single accountable owner for the platform and data engineering capabilities used across every product domain in the business. The role consolidates Platform Engineering and Data Platform under one senior leader, and runs those capabilities as internal products with named service expectations, a published roadmap, and a regular review cadence with Domain Directors. This is a new role, created to separate architectural authority from operational delivery. The Chief Architect sets technical direction; this role owns the delivery, reliability, and adoption of the shared capabilities that direction depends on. The two roles are peers.

**Reporting and scope**
-----------------------

* **Direct reports:** Platform Engineering Manager, Data Platform Lead. Indirect organisation of approximately 15 engineers at steady state.
* **Internal customers:** Three product domains (360, Assure and Learn) plus internal engineering and operations teams.
* **Peer relationships:** Chief Architect, Domain Directors, Product Directors, Head of Business Technology

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Run shared capabilities as products.** Define service expectations, roadmaps, and adoption metrics for Platform Engineering and Data Platform. Be the single named owner for operational performance: incident response, SLOs, capacity, cost-to-serve, and roadmap delivery.

**Earn the trust of Domain Directors.** Treat domain teams as customers. Establish a regular review cadence with each Domain Director. Where a shared capability is not fit for a domain's needs, lead the work to fix it rather than defending the status quo.

**Partner with the Chief Architect.** Translate architectural direction (multi-tenancy, AI paved roads, Technology Radar) into deliverable platform capabilities on a documented timeline. Surface implementation realities that should inform the architectural roadmap.

**Manage cloud cost.** Own the FinOps practice for the platform estate. Drive unit cost down without compromising reliability and give domain teams the visibility they need to manage their own consumption.

**Build the team.** Coach, develop, and where needed recruit the sub-function leads. Build a team that can operate the function without the Director being the bottleneck for every decision.

**What success looks like at twelve months**
--------------------------------------------

* Platform Engineering and Data Platform operate under published service expectations, with a regular review cadence with each Domain Director.
* Incident response, SLO attainment, and cloud unit cost are tracked, reported, and trending in the right direction.
* Platform compliance evidence for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and IRAP is generated as a by-product of normal operations rather than as a separate audit project.
* The two sub-function leads are operating as a coherent leadership team with clear ownership of their domains.

**Essential experience**
------------------------

* Five or more years of engineering leadership, with at least three years owning a platform, infrastructure, or shared services function at director level or above.
* Demonstrated experience running engineering capabilities as internal products, including setting service expectations, managing roadmaps, and being accountable for adoption.
* Track record in a multi-product SaaS environment, with credible experience of the trade-offs between centralised platform investment and domain team autonomy.
* Direct accountability for AWS cloud infrastructure at scale, including FinOps practices and unit cost management.
* Experience as the engineering owner for at least one of SOC 2, ISO 27001, or an equivalent regulated compliance regime.
* Track record of building and developing engineering teams, including hiring at managerial level.

**Desirable experience**
------------------------

* Exposure to data platform engineering, including the operational realities of running analytics and data pipelines as a shared capability.
* Experience in EHS, GRC, or another regulated B2B SaaS domain.
* Experience leading a transition from federated to centralised shared services, including the change management involved.

**How you work**
----------------

* **Comfortable with productive friction.** Architecture and delivery are inherently in tension. You see that tension as where the work gets done, not as a problem to be eliminated.
* **Customer mindset toward internal teams.** You earn adoption by being genuinely useful, not by mandate. You would rather change a shared capability than win an argument about it.
* **Operationally credible.** You can be in the detail of an incident or a roadmap commitment when the situation requires it, without making yourself the bottleneck for normal operations.
* **Direct.** You give and receive feedback clearly, and you are willing to disagree with peers in the room rather than after the meeting.

**Why join Evotix?**

* **Competitive Compensation:** Enjoy a competitive base salary and company-based performance bonus.
* **Time to Recharge:** Unlimited Annual Leave because we trust you to balance your work and wellbeing. (AMER/EMEA)
* **Financial Future:** Generous tiered 401k plan that increases over time. (AMER)
* **Support for You:** Access to our Employee Assistance Program, including mental health, legal, and financial guidance.
* **Growth Opportunities:** Educational benefits to help you keep learning and growing.
* **Team Culture:** Regular team events, an inclusive environment, and a shared commitment to making an impact.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**  
If you’re a bold, results-driven leader who thrives on challenges, loves scaling success, and is passionate about making a difference—we want to hear from you!  
  
*Thank you for your interest. Please note, we are not seeking support from external recruitment agencies at this time. Direct applications from candidates are warmly welcomed.*

title: Director, Software Engineering
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
===============

The Acceptance Solutions Product Development team are the engineers responsible for a portfolio of products that drive diversification of Visa revenue, differentiate our network, and deliver value-added solutions across other rails. This is part of a strategy to increase total merchant value by developing solutions that address complex and emerging needs of both merchants and acquirers. Our mission is to drive the future of payment acceptance, helping our clients navigate digital commerce complexities and address an increasing need for flexibility and agility.

The goal of the Visa Acceptance Platform is to be the world’s most open payment platform by delivering market leading, globally relevant, omnichannel acceptance componentry through open, composable, modular APIs delivered with Visa-grade resilience, security, maintenance, and scale.

We are seeking a dynamic, hands-on engineering leader to lead teams building secure, high-performing distributed systems for payment acceptance. Our technology stack includes Java, Containers, Kafka, relational databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern cloud-native engineering practices. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering depth, proven people leadership, and the ability to stay close to day-to-day design, code, architecture, delivery, and operational decisions while partnering with architecture, product, security, and operations teams to deliver resilient platforms at scale.

This role requires a leader who can balance strategic direction with active hands-on engineering involvement, apply AI/ML and Generative AI to improve engineering productivity and business outcomes, and mentor engineers to grow their technical capabilities and careers. This is an opportunity to lead talented teams while remaining deeply engaged in the technical details that shape secure, scalable payment acceptance. Be a part of our mission to shape the future of secure payments.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

* Serve as the hands-on technical lead for Payment Processing Platform across the Visa Acceptance Platform, providing technical direction across architecture, design, implementation, scalability, resiliency, and operational readiness.
* Lead the design, implementation, and deployment of secure, reliable, robust, and interoperable payment acceptance products.
* Provide engineering leadership to ensure solutions align with platform principles, architecture standards, and Visa-grade availability, resiliency, and operational excellence expectations.
* Remain actively hands-on with architecture, design reviews, code reviews, proof-of-concepts, performance analysis, debugging, technical troubleshooting, production-readiness, and critical delivery decisions on a day-to-day basis.
* Apply AI/ML, Generative AI, automation, and intelligent engineering practices to improve software delivery, search relevance, analytics capabilities, operational insight, developer productivity, and business outcomes.
* Define and execute the technical strategy for payment processing and acceptance platforms in alignment with product vision, business priorities, and long-term platform evolution.
* Drive delivery of fit-for-purpose products and platform capabilities that improve time-to-market while maintaining security, quality, scalability, and reliability.
* Design and evolve secure, reliable, and scalable search, indexing, analytics, enrichment, and data-processing capabilities that support high-volume payment acceptance use cases.
* Provide technical leadership for modern, intuitive, secure, and performant user interfaces that enable search, analytics, reporting, operational insights, and data-driven workflows for internal and external users.
* Set technical direction for event-driven data flows, transaction enrichment, search indexing, analytics pipelines, user-facing dashboards, observability, and operational insights in alignment with product, platform, security, user experience, and business objectives.
* Lead technical design for event correlation, transaction matching, retry handling, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, exactly-once processing considerations, and high-throughput data movement.
* Establish and continuously improve engineering best practices for application development, testing, deployment, observability, monitoring, incident response, and operational readiness, strengthening reliability, performance, maintainability, developer productivity, and operational excellence across Search and Analytics capabilities.
* Partner with application, data, platform, product, regional, business, client-facing, security, privacy, risk, governance, compliance, and operations teams to translate requirements into high-quality solutions that meet functional and non-functional requirements (security, latency, availability, compliance, maintainability) and applicable policies, standards, regulatory expectations, and customer commitments.
* Communicate and present technical strategy, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, delivery progress, and recommendations clearly, adapting to audiences that include executive leaders, business partners, product partners, architecture forums, and engineering teams.
* Coach, mentor, and develop engineers, senior engineers, technical leads, and engineering leaders through regular feedback, design reviews, architecture discussions, hands-on problem solving, technical deep dives, brown bag sessions, tech talks, production troubleshooting, and career development conversations.
* Build and lead high-performing teams by promoting collaboration, constructive debate, accountability, inclusion, and execution excellence consistent with Visa Leadership Principles.
* Bring forward new ideas, engineering improvements, and technology recommendations that increase team effectiveness, improve developer productivity, and advance platform capabilities.
* Influence technical strategy across teams without relying on formal reporting authority, using strong engineering judgment, collaboration, credibility, and hands-on technical depth.

**Qualifications**

**Basic Qualifications**
========================

* 10+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 13+ years of relevant work experience.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD.
* Demonstrated success leading high-performing, multi-disciplinary, and geographically distributed software engineering teams, including people management, coaching, performance development, delivery accountability, and hiring, developing, and retaining senior technical talent.
* Deep experience designing, building, and operating globally distributed, mission-critical systems that require high availability, scalability, resiliency, and security, and that support very high transaction volumes with strict availability, latency, security, and compliance requirements.
* Proven ability to solve complex technical and organizational problems across multiple domains, systems, and teams.
* Experience setting technical direction, influencing architecture and delivery strategy, and aligning engineering execution with product and business objectives.
* Strong proficiency in modern software engineering practices, programming languages, API design, system design, testing, deployment, and operational excellence, with a strong hands-on background in API-first software product development using technologies such as Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Vert.x, REST, Kafka, Hazelcast, Git, Maven, CI/CD pipelines, and test automation.
* Recent hands-on experience with architecture, design, coding practices, code reviews, debugging, production support, and technical decision-making in complex software systems.
* Experience with cloud platforms, Kubernetes, containerized deployment models, and modern DevOps practices.
* Experience with event-driven architecture, streaming platforms such as Kafka, and high-throughput transaction or data processing systems, including resilient patterns such as event correlation, transaction matching, retry mechanisms, dead-letter queues, replay, idempotency, and exactly-once processing considerations.
* Experience delivering secure software platforms, including familiarity with authentication, authorization, encryption, identity, and secure engineering practices.
* rack record of mentoring engineers, developing technical leaders, and building strong engineering culture.
* Experience applying AI-enabled engineering practices, automation, or developer productivity improvements across software delivery teams, and implementing, deploying, or governing AI/ML, Generative AI, or agentic AI capabilities in production environments or engineering workflows.
* Experience in payments, financial services, fintech, or high-scale transaction processing environments, including payment processing, transaction lifecycle concepts, payment network protocols, and acceptance workflows.
* Experience partnering with executive leadership, product leaders, technical product managers, regional teams, and business stakeholders to define strategy, roadmaps, requirements, priorities, and delivery plans.
* Experience with financial services compliance, risk, and control requirements such as PCI-DSS, SOX, security standards, audit readiness, and operational controls.
* Strong experience with agile delivery, software development lifecycle practices, engineering metrics, continuous improvement, developer productivity, and operational performance management.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to form, advocate, and communicate an independent technical viewpoint grounded in hands-on engineering experience.
* Long-term strategic thinker who stays current with emerging technologies and translates them into practical engineering and business outcomes.
* Highly driven, resourceful, results-oriented, and collaborative, with strong communication skills and a focus on durable, win-win outcomes.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Data Management & Governance Program Lead
description:
**Data Management & Governance Program Lead**

**Role summary**

**Job title**

Data Management & Governance Program Lead

**Engagement**

Enterprise data management programme for a life insurer: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI readiness and BAU handover

**Reports to**

Engagement Director - Capvirge; works day to day with the client’s Deputy CTO

**Leads**

Project Manager, Project Coordinator, Data Governance Analyst, Data Quality & Lineage Analyst, Business Analyst, Power BI Developers and Snowflake Data Engineer (with the client EDO team)

**Experience**

12–15+ years in data and analytics; 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes

**Purpose of the role**

The Program Lead designs, gets approved and hands over a complete data management framework, so the business trusts its numbers and can run it without the vendor after Go-Live.

The role owns nine strategic deliverables, from KPI definitions to BAU transition, and steers the client’s EDO team on day-to-day data operations and dashboard delivery. Success means one agreed meaning for every KPI, a named owner for every data asset, proven data quality, and a client team that runs it all on its own.

The role also oversees delivery of the **16 tactical dashboards** (Power BI on Snowflake), from BRD and build to UAT sign-off, Production and BAU.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and frameworks**

* Write and maintain the data management frameworks: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI and automation readiness, handover, committee governance and BAU transition.

* Present frameworks and decision papers to the Steering Committee, the Data Management Committee and the Design Authority, and secure approval at each gate.

**KPIs and data governance**

* Run KPI definition workshops with each department; agree one definition, formula and owner per KPI; build the KPI Dictionary.

* Set up the governance operating model: Data Owners and Stewards, decision rights, policy, standards, data classification and committees.

**Data quality, lineage and platform**

* Identify critical data elements, define quality rules and thresholds, and set up monitoring, issue management and lineage.

* Assess the data platform (Snowflake, AWS, Power BI) for architecture, security, cost and environments; recommend a future state and remediation roadmap.

**Analytics and AI readiness**

* Map customer journeys and funnels; design reusable shared data sets for dashboards and reports.

* Assess AI readiness, rank automation and AI use cases, and set responsible AI and GenAI safety rules.

**Delivery and operations**

* Own the programme plan, RAID log, decision log, evidence repository and status reporting.

* Oversee the dashboard pipeline from BRD to UAT, Production and hypercare; unblock sign-offs with business owners.

* Guide the client EDO team on platform stability, incident and change processes, and the data request SOPs.

**Handover and BAU**

* Design BAU services, SOPs and service levels; train owners, stewards and the EDO team; lead handover acceptance and Go-Live readiness.

**Team the role leads**

**Role**

**Focus**

**Project Manager**

Programme plan, RAID log, action tracker and status reporting

**Project Coordinator**

Meetings, follow-ups, minutes and document control

**Data Governance Analyst**

Data Owners and Stewards, business glossary, policies and standards (D2)

**Data Quality & Lineage Analyst**

Data inventory, quality rules, monitoring and lineage (D3)

**Business Analyst (insurance)**

BRDs, KPI definitions and dashboard requirements (D1, D5)

**Power BI Developers**

Build, UAT and BAU support for the 16 dashboards

**Snowflake Data Engineer**

Data models, pipelines and platform remediation (D4)

**Required experience and qualifications**

* 12–15+ years in data and analytics, including 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes end to end.

* 5+ years in insurance or financial services; life insurance strongly preferred.

* Has set up a data governance operating model (owners, stewards, decision rights, committees) and taken it through executive approval.

* Has standardized KPIs across business units and built a KPI or business glossary used in production reporting.

* Has delivered a data quality programme with critical data elements, rules, thresholds and lineage.

* Has led a platform or architecture assessment and a remediation roadmap on a modern cloud data stack.

* Has handed a programme over to a BAU team, with SOPs, training and acceptance.

* Experience as a consultant or vendor lead working with client executives.

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, statistics, business or a related field; a master’s degree is a plus.

**Technical and domain skills**

**Area**

**Must have**

**Good to have**

**Data governance**

DAMA-DMBOK, federated operating models, RACI and decision rights, data classification

DCAM, data catalogue tools

**KPIs and metrics**

KPI trees, SMART definitions, certification and change control

Management scorecards and target setting

**Data quality and lineage**

Critical data elements, quality dimensions, rules and thresholds, issue management, column lineage

Automated quality checks in pipelines (Airflow), logical data models

**Data platforms**

Snowflake, AWS (S3), Power BI; environments, access control, cost (FinOps)

AWS Well-Architected, TOGAF, privileged access (CyberArk)

**Analytics**

Dashboard delivery lifecycle (BRD, UAT, hypercare), semantic models, shared data sets

Customer journey and funnel analytics

**AI readiness**

Use-case scoring; Predictive, Generative and Agentic AI concepts; responsible AI

NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001

**Insurance domain**

Life and ILP products, persistency, APE, claims, IFRS 17 and statutory reporting, bancassurance and digital partners

Group insurance

**Regulation (Philippines)**

Data Privacy Act (RA 10173), Insurance Commission requirements, RA 11765 consumer protection

AML (RA 9160)

**Delivery and service**

Programme planning, RAID, gates, change control; BAU service design, SOPs, incident and change processes

ITIL, ADKAR change management

**Behavioural competencies**

* **Executive influence:** gets decisions and sign-offs from senior leaders and busy business owners, and keeps approvals moving.

* **Plain-language communication:** turns frameworks into short material executives can read and act on.

* **Facilitation:** runs workshops where departments disagree, and brings them to one agreed definition.

* **Pragmatism:** balances good-practice governance with what a small team can actually run.

* **Ownership:** works without close supervision, and tracks commitments to closure.

* **Coaching:** builds capability in client teams so they can run the work after handover.

**Preferred certifications**

None is mandatory; proven delivery counts for more.

* CDMP (DAMA) or DCAM: data management

* PMP or PRINCE2: programme delivery

* SnowPro Core, or Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst: platforms

* ITIL 4 Foundation: BAU services

* An AI governance certification (for example IAPP AIGP): responsible AI
