title: Associate Director — PR&D Delivery & Operations
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
At Lilly, the data and digital capability that underpins every regulatory submission, batch investigation, and process decision across CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) is being rebuilt rather than maintained. Time-to-insight for scientists and process engineers, audit- and inspection-readiness, and the cost of running PR&D's platforms all depend on these capabilities. This role is the mechanism by which the portfolio moves from sustaining the current estate to reshaping it: from request-taking to business partnership, from manual data and process work to AI- and agent-supported execution, and from vendor dependence to retained Lilly capability.
  
The Associate Director, PR&D Delivery & Operations leads broader delivery teams across CMC data platform modernization (structured and unstructured data, platform operations), scientific workflow automation (LIMS, MES, ELN), data governance and business alignment, and AI & Analytics (AI-use-case delivery) — accountable for delivery, technical direction, team capability and measurable business outcomes across all three. The role sits where CMC scientific and data process meets engineering: credible enough to lead a design review and challenge an architecture, fluent enough in regulated CMC data work to shape how a scientific or process team actually works. Split roughly 60% delivery and technical leadership and 40% strategy, business partnership and vendor leadership, it owns the demand relationship with PR&D business owners, directs the partner teams delivering a material share of the work, and supports the portfolio's AI and agentic capability agenda as one part of a broader delivery mandate.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Portfolio Delivery Ownership — own delivery across the portfolio — scope, schedule, quality, dependencies, release readiness and production health — for CMC data and semantic infrastructure (knowledge graph, ontology, document and structured-data ingestion), platform modernization and operations, and AI-use-case delivery, directing the broader teams accountable for each track. Run delivery on real signals: flow, predictability, defect escape and adoption by scientific and process teams, not status reporting.
* Technical Direction & Engineering Standards — set and defend the technical direction of the portfolio, contributing to how CMC data platforms support the goals of the wider PR&D business area; review architecture and design, challenge weak decisions, and own standards for APIs, data contracts, ontology and knowledge-graph modeling (RDF/OWL/SPARQL, property graphs), and tool-calling interfaces (MCP) across CMC data platforms. Raise the engineering bar on test automation, CI/CD, observability and the deliberate reduction of technical debt, staying close enough to the work to judge trade-offs credibly.
* AI & Agentic Delivery Support — support delivery of AI and agentic use cases already on the portfolio roadmap — document and schema intelligence, retrieval over CMC content, and knowledge-graph-powered Q&A or summarization agents — ensuring these initiatives get the same delivery rigor, resourcing and release discipline as any other workstream. Help the team bring new use cases forward for evaluation, and support them through validation and into production with appropriate guardrails and human-in-the-loop review. Build AI-assisted engineering into the team's everyday practice, in step with the broader AI strategy set elsewhere in the portfolio.
* Business Partnership & Stakeholder Management — act as the technology partner for PR&D business owners and domain product managers across the portfolio's data, platform and AI-use-case tracks — the person they call first, and the person who tells them when an idea will not work. Capture and challenge incoming demand, agree priorities against capacity, and keep one honest view of the roadmap and what has been traded away. Translate CMC and scientific need into technical options and constraint, risk and cost into language a business owner can act on; set a rhythm of business reviews and early warning so there are no surprises at release; and build the case for modernization investment, with the benefit measurement that follows it.
* Vendor & Partner Delivery Management — get the work done through partner teams: define scope, outcomes and acceptance criteria, and hold suppliers to the same engineering, quality and GxP standards as internal teams. Shape the sourcing mix for the portfolio, plan partner ramp-up and ramp-down against the roadmap, manage supplier performance on predictability, quality and knowledge retention, and work with sourcing, legal and finance on statements of work, capacity models and change requests. Integrate partner engineers into one team, one backlog and one set of standards, and protect institutional knowledge through documentation, code ownership and cross-training.
* Quality, Risk & GxP Compliance — deliver in a GxP-regulated environment — computer system validation, 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity, inspection and audit readiness. Design for security and data privacy from the start, meet architecture and security review obligations early rather than at release, and own incident response and service levels for the products the teams run.
* People Leadership & Capability Building — manage, coach and grow broader delivery teams spanning multiple sub-teams and disciplines: clear expectations, specific feedback, honest check-ins and a development plan each person recognises as their own. Hire for the capability the portfolio needs next — engineering depth across data, knowledge-graph and AI-use-case delivery, product thinking, CMC domain fluency — address underperformance without delay, build bench strength and succession, and remove single points of failure. Hold high standards and psychological safety at the same time across a distributed team.
* Decision-Making Authority — make design, tooling, sequencing and sourcing decisions within the guidelines set by architecture, engineering and validation standards; challenge product, engineering or vendor approaches where delivery or compliance risk exists; forecast resource needs across the portfolio and manage the allocated budget against plan; contribute to PR&D's business-area plans by translating the modernization roadmap into resourced, executable delivery cycles; and escalate policy-level or cross-platform decisions with a recommendation rather than a question.

Technical & Capability Areas
  
  
CMC Data Systems (LIMS, MES, ELN) · Data Engineering & Data Platforms · Knowledge Graph & Ontology Engineering (OWL/RDF/SPARQL, Neo4j/property graphs) · Semantic Layer & Retrieval (Vector Databases, Hybrid/Graph-RAG) · AI/ML & Agentic Systems (LLMs, Multi-Agent Orchestration, Model Context Protocol) · Modern Software Development Practices (SDLC, CI/CD, Test Automation) · Cloud Platforms (Azure/AWS) · API & Integration Architecture · Clinical/Scientific Data Standards & Governance · Agile & Product Operating Model · Security & Compliance (GxP, CSV, 21 CFR Part 11) · Vendor & Delivery Governance · Business Stakeholder Management · People Leadership & Coaching
  
  
Basic Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field (Master's preferred).
* 10+ years in technology delivery or technical leadership, including 4+ years of direct people management across broader or multi-team delivery organizations.
* 4+ years supporting CMC, pharma R&D, or manufacturing data and process technology — LIMS/MES/DMS/ELN systems, batch records, process or regulatory submission data.
* Demonstrated ownership of delivery for a portfolio or platform across multiple concurrent programmes, including work delivered through vendors.
* Broad technology awareness and working strength across cloud platforms, APIs and enterprise integration patterns, data engineering, AI/ML, and agentic systems — enough to review a design, engage credibly with technical teams across all these areas, ask the right questions, and spot delivery or quality risk, without requiring hands-on ownership of any single one.
* Working familiarity with AI, machine learning or agentic solutions and how they move from proof of concept into governed production use.
* Experience operating in regulated (GxP) environments, including computer system validation and inspection-readiness practices.
* Demonstrated success owning a senior business relationship — shaping demand, negotiating priorities and capacity, and holding credibility through difficult delivery news.
* Demonstrated success governing multi-vendor or managed-service delivery, with clear separation of Lilly-owned and vendor-executed responsibility, and command of the commercial mechanics.
* Strong communication skills, translating technical trade-offs into business, scientific and regulatory language for senior stakeholders.
* Working knowledge of Agile-at-scale and product operating model practices (backlog governance, value-stream mapping) applied to a regulated portfolio.
* Track record of hiring, coaching, performance management and retention across broader, distributed delivery teams.

Additional Qualifications / Competencies
  
  

* Experience with knowledge graph or ontology engineering platforms (Neo4j, GraphDB, Protégé, or comparable), or semantic layer/retrieval tooling; platform training or certification.
* Exposure to CMC, manufacturing, or process data domains — batch records, equipment/material master data, or regulatory submission content.
* Strategic and analytical thinking — preparing decisions ahead of delivery rather than reacting to them.
* Strong vendor governance and negotiation skills; ownership mindset managing multiple priorities, stakeholders and concurrent programmes.
* Influence with internal and external customers and management — with business stakeholders who do not report to them and partner teams they do not employ; comfort driving clarity in ambiguity.
* Learning agility and continuous-improvement leadership — challenging the status quo and growing technical capability around them.
* Experience of shared ownership models between India-based and global organisations.

title: Lead Data Steward
description:
**About us**

  

At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living while reducing emissions. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for.

  

The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower-emissions technologies.

  

We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about **our What and our Why** and how we canwork **together**.

  

**Job Summary**

  

Lead Data Specialist act as delegates of the Data Owner and are responsible for protecting, managing, and enhancing the data assets under their domain. They collaborate closely with cross-functional data stakeholders including business teams, data governance, data quality, and technology partners-to ensure data is trustworthy, well-defined, and effectively used. Lead Data Specialist proactively identify data issues, drive root‑cause resolution, and champion data standards and governance practices across the organization.

  

**What you will do**

  

* Act as the delegate of the Data Owner to safeguard, manage, and optimize critical data assets, ensuring adherence to data governance policies, business rules, and regulatory requirements.
* Provide strategic direction and expert guidance to Data Product Managers and Data Stewards, influencing the design, implementation, and maintenance of high‑quality, trusted data products.
* Review, validate, and approve data governance artifacts—including business rules, data definitions, data quality requirements, and metadata standards—and hand over endorsed rules to the Data Quality team for operationalization.
* Lead and mentor the Data Stewardship team, offering tactical guidance, monitoring execution, and ensuring consistent adoption of data governance practices across business functions.
* Drive data quality improvements and master data integrity, partnering with cross‑functional teams to identify data issues, assess current-state maturity, and prioritize remediation and sustainment activities.
* Report data governance and stewardship progress to the Data Governance Council, including key metrics, risk implications, adoption challenges, and proposals for policy updates or enhancements.
* Evaluate cost, benefits, and business value for governance initiatives, supporting decision-making, resource planning, and long‑term sustainability of data governance programs.

  

**About you - Skills and Qualifications**

  

**Essential :**

* Strong experience in Business Capability frameworks and understanding how data supports end‑to‑end business processes.
* Hands‑on experience with Data Governance practices, including data quality, metadata, and stewardship activities.
* Working knowledge of Collibra or similar data governance platforms.

  

**Preferred Qualifications/ Experience**

  

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 6+ years of experience in Data Governance, Data Management, Data Quality, or related functions.
* Proven track record working as a Data Coordinator or Lead Data Steward, Data Governance Lead, or similar role.
* Experience collaborating with Data Owners, Data Product Managers, and enterprise governance bodies.
* Demonstrated success implementing or enhancing enterprise data governance programs.
* Prior experience leading data stewardship teams or cross‑functional workgroups.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills; ability to influence without authority.
* Excellent analytical and problem‑solving abilities, particularly in identifying data quality issues and root‑cause analysis.
* Skilled in creating, reviewing, and validating data governance artifacts (business rules, definitions, DQ metrics, lineage).
* Exceptional communication skills to articulate data governance principles to both business and technical audiences.
* Ability to drive alignment across diverse teams and lead change management for governance adoption.
* Self‑driven, with the ability to proactively identify priorities and move initiatives forward with minimal direction.
* Comfortable creating clarity in ambiguous situations by breaking down complex problems, defining structure, and driving actionable outcomes.

  

**Certifications (Nice to Have):**

  

* Certified Data Management Professional (CDMP – DAMA)
* Collibra Ranger / Steward / Data Governance Certification
* SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) certification
* Any relevant Data Governance, Data Quality, or Analytics certifications

title: Mainframe CICS Systems Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

Success in this role means delivering a secure, highly available, and high-performing CICS environment that supports mission-critical business applications while driving modernization, automation, and operational excellence.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Install, configure, administer, and support IBM CICS Transaction Server environments across enterprise z/OS platforms.
* Perform CICS upgrades, migrations, maintenance, and lifecycle management while ensuring platform stability, availability, and security.
* Manage and support CICS regions, including AOR, TOR, FOR, COR, and complex CICSplex environments.
* Monitor, analyze, and optimize transaction performance, response times, CPU utilization, storage consumption, and workload distribution.
* Configure and maintain CICS resources, system definitions, startup procedures, CSD/BAS definitions, and operational infrastructure.
* Ensure high availability, resiliency, and disaster recovery readiness through proactive capacity planning, recovery testing, and business continuity strategies.
* Administer and support CICS security controls in partnership with RACF and security teams, including transaction, program, command, resource, and surrogate security.
* Support enterprise connectivity and integration technologies such as MQ, EXCI, DPL, MRO, ISC, IPIC, Web Services, REST APIs, and TCP/IP.
* Serve as the highest level technical escalation point for critical incidents, performing root cause analysis, dump and trace analysis, and resolution of complex CICS abends and system issues.
* Collaborate with application development teams to support testing, deployments, modernization initiatives, and production support for business-critical applications.
* Lead strategic initiatives including CICS TS upgrades, API enablement, modernization programs, hybrid cloud integration, DevOps adoption, and observability enhancements.
* Develop and implement automation solutions using REXX, System Automation, NetView, and OPS/MVS to improve operational efficiency and reliability.
* Administer monitoring and observability platforms such as OMEGAMON, MainView, Dynatrace, Tivoli, SMF, and RMF to proactively identify and resolve issues.
* Provide technical leadership, mentoring, architectural guidance, and best practices to system programmers, engineers, and support teams.
Ensure compliance with operational, security, audit, and service delivery standards while driving continuous improvement across the CICS platform.  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 8+ years of relevant hands-on experience in Mainframe CICS System Programming or CICS infrastructure support.
* Good working knowledge of IBM CICS Transaction Server, including CICS regions, system configuration, administration, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting.
* Experience supporting CICS production environments, including incident resolution, service requests, planned changes, and system maintenance activities.
* Working knowledge of CICS installation, maintenance, upgrades, or migration activities.
* Experience or exposure to CICS-related IBM and third-party products and monitoring tools such as IBM OMEGAMON for CICS, BMC MainView, ASG TMON/CICS, CICS Performance Analyzer, Abend-AID, Xpediter/CICS, InterTest, SymDump, or similar products.
* Understanding of CICS integration with technologies such as IBM MQ, Db2, VSAM, and other Mainframe application components.
* Working knowledge of CICS performance monitoring, transaction analysis, region health monitoring, and basic performance troubleshooting.
Ability and willingness to participate in rotational on-call support, planned maintenance activities, and Disaster Recovery exercises as required.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Exposure to CICS Web Services, API enablement, Java integration, or other CICS modernization technologies.
* Experience supporting CICS maintenance using SMP/E and applying IBM PTFs, APAR fixes, or related maintenance.
* Exposure to CICSplex System Manager, CICSPlex SM, Workload Management, or multi-region CICS environments.
* Experience with CICS performance analysis, workload balancing, capacity monitoring, or tuning activities.
Ability to contribute effectively to projects, upgrades, migrations, maintenance activities, and continuous improvement initiatives as part of a broader technical team.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Digital CX Tech Specialist
description:
**About the Role**

  

The Digital CX Technology Analyst prepares and manages the data, systems and processes that power our digital customer success strategy. The role identifies, collects and prepares data, primarily from Snowflake, and enables its effective use across Gainsight CS, Gainsight PX and Journey Orchestrator. Working closely with functional leaders, the analyst supports projects spanning planning, reporting, goal setting, customer health, business process optimisation and the operational metrics required to scale Customer Success. The role owns platform data integrity, helps design business rules that analyse customer data and trigger digital customer success actions, and contributes to a scalable customer lifecycle from onboarding through renewal. This is a cross-functional role partnering with Customer Success Operations, Sales Operations, Corporate Technology Data Enablement and Sales Technology, Marketing, Product, Support, Sales Strategy and Execution, and other teams to ensure technology initiatives are prioritised against Customer Success objectives. It combines solution design with hands-on work across backend data systems and customer-facing journey orchestration, and provides development towards a solution architecture career path.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Develop and maintain the roadmap of systems, tools and data capabilities needed to support Customer Success, including resource planning, project management, customer health tracking and operational business metrics.

* Identify opportunities to improve Customer Success effectiveness, efficiency, scalability and financial performance, and translate those opportunities into practical technology and process improvements.

* Own platform data integrity and coordinate the sources, metrics, frequency and level of data required for digital customer success use cases.

* Identify, extract, transform and prepare data, primarily from Snowflake, so it can be used effectively within Gainsight CS, Gainsight PX and Journey Orchestrator.

* Configure and deploy Gainsight and Salesforce capabilities for internal users, including system configuration, integrations, reports, dashboards, workflows and business rules.

* Design and manage rules that analyse customer data and trigger scalable digital programmes across the customer lifecycle, from onboarding through adoption, health management and renewal.

* Partner with Sales Operations and Customer Success Operations to establish and maintain role-based metrics and insights, including customer health indicators, renewal performance, territory and account planning, organisational performance, customer lifecycle measures and Voice of Customer feedback.

* Enable colleagues to use customer data effectively within Gainsight, particularly through Journey Orchestrator, and prepare Customer Success teams for new processes, tools and functionality.

* Coordinate delivery of Customer Success enablement programmes, tools and processes, clearly communicating priorities, activities, dependencies and outcomes to stakeholders.

* Establish practical processes that help CSMs work effectively with cross-functional teams, including onboarding plans that bring new CSMs up to speed efficiently.

* Translate data into scalable customer journeys and product messaging, balancing technical design, customer experience and operational requirements.

* Structure data and solutions in an efficient, lean and cost-conscious way so digital journeys can scale across Data & Analytics and Risk Intelligence product suites.

* Recommend and support adoption of best practices and standardised procedures that improve consistency and reduce manual effort.

* Provide second-line platform support and coordinate issue resolution with Gainsight Support, the Gainsight Technical Account Manager and Corporate Technology partners.

Manage multiple strategic and operational projects in a fast-paced environment, adapting priorities as business needs evolve and supporting the team’s ambition to operate natively with AI.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

  

* Bachelor’s degree preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.

* Experience in a SaaS or recurring-revenue business, ideally within Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations or a related operational function.

* Hands-on Gainsight administration experience, including Gainsight CS and Gainsight PX, with experience maintaining a Gainsight and Salesforce Customer Success platform model.

* Gainsight Administration certification required; Salesforce Administration certification preferred.

* Experience with Snowflake or a similar cloud data warehouse, including extracting and preparing data for downstream use.

* Strong SQL skills and experience working across backend data systems, integrations, reports, dashboards and workflows.

* Experience with Journey Orchestrator or a similar journey or workflow orchestration tool.

* Strong data analysis, reporting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn business requirements into scalable technology solutions.

* Demonstrated ability to understand and meet internal or external customer needs.

* Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple and competing priorities.

* Sound business judgement, with the ability to see the bigger picture, prioritise effectively and act in an environment of change and ambiguity.

* Comfort working with high-performing teams in an indirect and matrixed capacity, taking initiative and maintaining disciplined execution.

Interest in solution architecture and in designing data and technology structures for long-term scalability, not only immediate delivery needs.  

  

**Working at LSEG**

  

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce. You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas and are committed to sustainability across our global business. You will experience the critical role we have in helping to re-engineer the financial ecosystem to support and drive sustainable economic growth. Together, we are aiming to achieve this growth by accelerating the just transition to net zero, enabling growth of the green economy and creating inclusive economic opportunity.

title: Technical Delivery Manager
description:
**"ABOUT US:**

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a commitment to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, handle risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years.

Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

  

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 70 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia PaDecific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

  

**OUR PEOPLE:**

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.

  

We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

  

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and exciting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.

**PROGRAMME SUMMARY:**

LSEG are embarking on a large transformation programme to streamline and optimise our current capabilities, and to deliver next-generation, industry-standard Financial Crime (FC) processes, technologies and tools to support our Customer and Third-Party onboarding. While continuing to meet internal stringent policies and our external obligations, this programme shall introduce new ways of working and standards, drive efficiencies and transforme the way we deliver value towards customer journey lifecycle at LSEG.

  

**ROLE PROFILE:**

A fantastic opportunity for a proven and experienced Technical Delivery Manager with a background in Know Your Customer (KYC), Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Financial Crime (FC), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Sanctions, Transaction Monitoring and Regulatory Transformation, to lead and support the delivery of key technology initiatives underpinning the FC Transformation programme.

The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of business, technology and programme delivery, driving requirements definition, collaborator alignment, execution governance and change implementation. This individual will act as a trusted partner to business leaders, technology teams, architects, vendors and programme leadership, ensuring the successful delivery of strategic and regulatory initiatives through the full delivery lifecycle.

  

RESPONSIBILITIES

**Lead Business and Technology Transformation**

* Partner with business, operations, risk and technology stakeholders to define strategic objectives, business requirements and delivery outcomes.

* Analyse business processes, operating models, systems and data flows to find opportunities for optimisation and transformation.

* Lead requirements definition activities including workshops, process mapping, user story development and acceptance criteria definition.

* Ensure business requirements are traceable through design, testing and implementation.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

* Lead end-to-end delivery of complex technology initiatives from discovery through implementation.

* Develop delivery plans, manage dependencies and ensure alignment across multiple teams and workstreams.

* Identify and proactively manage risks, issues and delivery challenges.

* Monitor progress against achievements and ensure successful execution of programme commitments.

* Champion Agile delivery approaches, selecting the most appropriate methodology for each initiative.

**Build Strong Partnerships**

* Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology stakeholders.

* Facilitate alignment across teams with differing priorities and objectives.

* Provide clear communication and regular reporting to programme leadership and senior stakeholders.

* Influence decision-making through data-driven insights and thoughtful recommendations.

**Lead High-Performing Teams**

* Manage, coach and develop a team of Business Analysts and delivery professionals.

* Create an inclusive environment where individuals can grow, develop and perform at their best.

* Support career development, succession planning and capability building across the team.

* Ensure resources are effectively allocated to meet programme and organisational priorities.

**Deliver Sustainable Technology Solutions**

* Collaborate with architecture, engineering and product teams to design and implement scalable solutions.

* Support delivery of Financial Crime technology capabilities including onboarding, KYC, CDD, screening, monitoring and reporting solutions.

* Ensure solutions align with governance, security, data and regulatory requirements.

* Promote continuous improvement and adoption of standard methodologies across delivery teams.

**Enable Data-Driven Decisions**

* Partner with data, reporting and engineering teams to define information requirements and reporting solutions.

* Support delivery of management information, operational insights and performance reporting.

* Ensure data quality, integrity and consistency across delivered solutions.
  

**What You'll Bring**

**Experience**

* Significant experience leading business analysis and technology delivery within Financial Services, Risk, Compliance or Financial Crime domains.

* Demonstrated success delivering large-scale business and technology transformation initiatives.

* Experience leading and developing teams in a people management capacity.

* Experience working with senior stakeholders across business, operations and technology organisations.

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a complex, fast-paced environment.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong understanding of Financial Crime processes including KYC, Customer Due Diligence, Sanctions Screening and Transaction Monitoring.

* Excellent business analysis, process improvement and requirements management capabilities.

title: Mainframe CICS & MQ System Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

We are seeking an experienced Mainframe MQ System Programmer responsible for the installation, administration, support, performance tuning, security, automation, and high availability of IBM MQ for z/OS environments. The successful candidate will work closely with application development, infrastructure, operations, security, and architecture teams to design, implement, and maintain enterprise messaging solutions supporting mission-critical business applications across global environments.

**What You Will Do**

  

* Install, configure, upgrade, and maintain IBM MQ for z/OS environments, ensuring secure, stable, and highly available messaging services.
* Administer MQ Queue Managers, Queues, Channels, Clusters, Queue Sharing Groups, and related infrastructure components across enterprise environments.
* Monitor system health, analyze performance metrics, perform capacity planning, and optimize MQ environments for reliability, scalability, and business growth.
* Troubleshoot complex MQ infrastructure and application messaging issues, conduct root cause analysis, and drive timely resolution of production incidents.
* Design and support high-availability, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions, including Sysplex and multi-region architectures.
* Implement and maintain MQ security controls, including RACF integration, SSL/TLS configurations, access management, and compliance requirements.
* Develop automation, scripting, and monitoring solutions to improve operational efficiency, incident response, and proactive system management.
* Architect and enhance MQ infrastructure solutions, providing technical leadership for modernization, clustering, workload balancing, and hybrid integration initiatives.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, and system programming teams to support application onboarding, deployments, migrations, and messaging connectivity solutions.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and recovery plans while participating in change management, audits, and knowledge-sharing activities.
Provide on-call support in a 24x7 production environment, responding to critical incidents and supporting maintenance activities as needed.  

  
  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

  

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Skills**

  

* 5+ years of IBM MQ for z/OS System Programming experience
* IBM MQ for z/OS administration, including Queue Managers, QSGs, MQ Clusters, and Distributed Queueing
* Strong experience with MQ Channel Administration, Publish/Subscribe, and Workload Balancing
* Solid understanding of z/OS system programming, SMP/E, JES2, TSO/ISPF, JCL, USS, and SDSF
* Experience with MQ monitoring and performance tools such as OMEGAMON, MainView, and SYSVIEW
* Knowledge of RACF, MQ security, SSL/TLS, digital certificates, and compliance controls
* Proficiency in automation using REXX and tools such as SA z/OS, OPS/MVS, and NetView
* Expertise in troubleshooting, including dump/trace analysis, SMF analysis, and performance tuning
Strong incident management and root cause analysis skills  

  

**Preferred Skills**

  

* Experience supporting large-scale enterprise MQ environments and Queue Sharing Groups (QSGs)
* Knowledge of Parallel Sysplex, high-availability, and disaster recovery architectures
* Familiarity with CICS, DB2, IMS, and other mainframe subsystems
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills; ITIL certification preferred  

  

**Key Competencies**

  

* Problem Solving & RCA
* Leadership & Mentoring
* Customer Focus
* Global Team Collaboration
* Change & Release Management
* Automation & Continuous Improvement
Operational Excellence & Resilience under Pressure  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Deputy General Manager- Account Management- Tech Staffing
description:
**Job Description: Account Manager – Technology Staffing**

**Role Summary:**

We are looking for a commercially driven **Account Manager – Technology Staffing** to manage and grow strategic client accounts. The role will be responsible for building strong client relationships, generating staffing requirements, driving fulfilment in partnership with recruitment teams, and expanding revenue across existing accounts. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in **IT/Technology Staffing, Contract Staffing and C2H**, with the ability to engage senior stakeholders across Talent Acquisition, HR, Procurement and Business/Technology teams.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own and grow assigned Technology Staffing accounts**, with accountability for revenue, gross margin, fulfilment and overall account performance.
* Drive **end-to-end Account Management**, covering client relationships, requirement generation, delivery coordination, commercial discussions and issue resolution.
* Build deeper relationships across **Talent Acquisition, HR, Procurement, Hiring Managers and Business/Technology stakeholders**.
* Actively generate new requirements by understanding clients' current and upcoming **technology hiring and workforce needs**.
* Partner closely with recruitment and delivery teams to drive **speed, quality and fulfilment** against client requirements.
* Develop structured **account growth plans** and identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling and expanding into new business units, locations and skill areas.
* Build strong visibility into client demand across technology skill areas and proactively align internal recruitment capacity.
* Track and drive key account metrics including **requirements, submissions, interviews, selections, joining/conversion, revenue, gross margin and fulfilment**.
* Lead regular client reviews and governance discussions, ensuring effective follow-through on agreed actions.
* Manage client escalations proactively and ensure strong customer experience and long-term account relationships.
* Lead/support **rate negotiations, commercials, renewals, contract extensions and pricing discussions** while protecting business margins.
* Identify whitespace opportunities within existing accounts and convert relationships into incremental staffing business.
* Maintain an accurate account pipeline and provide visibility on **business opportunities, demand forecasts, risks and growth potential**.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders across Sales, Recruitment, Operations, Finance and Compliance to ensure smooth execution and account governance.

**Required Experience & Skills:**

* Strong experience in **Technology/IT Staffing, Contract Staffing and/or Contract-to-Hire (C2H)**.
* Proven track record in **Account Management, Client Management and Account Growth** within the staffing industry.
* Experience managing **enterprise technology hiring requirements** and working with recruitment/delivery teams.
* Strong understanding of contemporary technology skill areas and the ability to have credible conversations around client hiring demand.
* Experience engaging multiple client stakeholders, particularly **Talent Acquisition, HR, Procurement and Hiring Managers**.
* Strong commercial orientation with an understanding of **revenue, gross margin, pricing and staffing economics**.
* Demonstrated ability to generate requirements and expand existing client relationships.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work in a **high-volume, target-driven staffing environment**.
* Strong ownership mindset with the ability to independently manage client situations and drive closure.

**Key Success Measures-**The incumbent would be measured on:

* Account revenue and gross margin growth
* Requirement generation
* Fulfilment and conversion
* New business / account penetration
* Client retention and relationship expansion
* Delivery performance
* Commercial and margin discipline
* Client satisfaction and escalation management

**Posting date:** 22-10-2026

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
**About Tarento:**

Tarento is a fast-growing technology consulting company headquartered in Stockholm, with a strong presence in India and clients across the globe. We specialize in digital transformation, product engineering, and enterprise solutions, working across diverse industries including retail, manufacturing, and healthcare. Our teams combine Nordic values with Indian expertise to deliver innovative, scalable, and high-impact solutions.

We're proud to be recognized as a **Great Place to Work**, a testament to our inclusive culture, strong leadership, and commitment to employee well-being and growth. At Tarento, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment where ideas are valued, learning is continuous, and careers are built on passion and purpose.

**About the role.** Our existing clients are where the fastest growth is. Many know us for supplying skilled people; few yet know us for delivering outcomes. You will turn those relationships into larger, longer-term Build work, starting with our Nordic and India accounts.

**What you will do**

  

* Own revenue growth across existing accounts: renewals, extensions and new Build projects
* Write and run an account plan for each priority account: decision makers, problems, offers, next steps
* Get Tarento in front of the people who own outcomes (CIOs, heads of apps, data and business units), beyond procurement
* Turn existing relationships into Build work, for example moving on-site teams into managed services (AURORA) or selling fixed-price assessments
* Work with account managers from other business units for cross-account selling
* Lead, coach & grow a young team, with monthly account reviews
* Run quarterly business reviews with clients, focused on outcomes delivered and what comes next
* Take over new clients from New Business after their first project and grow them

**What success looks like in year one**

  

* Contracts signed in existing accounts against target
* An account plan and named senior contact for every priority account
* Paid assessments or new Build projects in at least five accounts where we mainly supplied people before
* Renewal rate of existing revenue at or above plan

**Who you are**

  

* You have grown accounts by selling new kinds of work, not only by renewing what was there
* You build trust with senior client leaders and are comfortable asking for introductions
* You understand delivery well enough to shape realistic proposals with presales and delivery leads
* You coordinate across sales, delivery and client teams without formal authority over all of them
* You are open to regular international travel, to the US, the Nordics or wider Europe (valid US and Schengen visas are an advantage)
* Useful: experience with Nordic clients or public-sector and GovTech accounts in India

title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

 **Job Description**

About The Role:

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will act as the crucial link between technical development teams and business stakeholders, ensuring the successful delivery of customized financial technology solutions. title: Data Management & Governance Program Lead
description:
**Data Management & Governance Program Lead**

**Job title:** Data Management & Governance Program Lead

**Engagement**: Enterprise data management programme for a life insurer: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI readiness and BAU handover

**Location**: Manila, Philippines (hybrid) – to confirm

**Reports to**: Engagement Director (vendor); works day to day with the client’s Deputy CTO

**Leads**: Project Manager, Project Coordinator and client EDO technical leads (BI, Snowflake, Power BI)

**Experience**: 12–15+ years in data and analytics; 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes

**Purpose of the role**

The Program Lead designs, gets approved and hands over a complete data management framework, so the business trusts its numbers and can run it without the vendor after Go-Live.

The role owns nine strategic deliverables, from KPI definitions to BAU transition, and steers the client’s EDO team on day-to-day data operations and dashboard delivery. Success means one agreed meaning for every KPI, a named owner for every data asset, proven data quality, and a client team that runs it all on its own.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and frameworks**

* Write and maintain the data management frameworks: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI and automation readiness, handover, committee governance and BAU transition.
* Present frameworks and decision papers to the Steering Committee, the Data Management Committee and the Design Authority, and secure approval at each gate.

**KPIs and data governance**

* Run KPI definition workshops with each department; agree one definition, formula and owner per KPI; build the KPI Dictionary.
* Set up the governance operating model: Data Owners and Stewards, decision rights, policy, standards, data classification and committees.

**Data quality, lineage and platform**

* Identify critical data elements, define quality rules and thresholds, and set up monitoring, issue management and lineage.
* Assess the data platform (Snowflake, AWS, Power BI) for architecture, security, cost and environments; recommend a future state and remediation roadmap.

**Analytics and AI readiness**

* Map customer journeys and funnels; design reusable shared data sets for dashboards and reports.
* Assess AI readiness, rank automation and AI use cases, and set responsible AI and GenAI safety rules.

**Delivery and operations**

* Own the programme plan, RAID log, decision log, evidence repository and status reporting.
* Oversee the dashboard pipeline from BRD to UAT, Production and hypercare; unblock sign-offs with business owners.
* Guide the client EDO team on platform stability, incident and change processes, and the data request SOPs.

**Handover and BAU**

* Design BAU services, SOPs and service levels; train owners, stewards and the EDO team; lead handover acceptance and Go-Live readiness.

**Required experience and qualifications**

* 12–15+ years in data and analytics, including 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes end to end.
* 5+ years in insurance or financial services; life insurance strongly preferred.
* Has set up a data governance operating model (owners, stewards, decision rights, committees) and taken it through executive approval.
* Has standardized KPIs across business units and built a KPI or business glossary used in production reporting.
* Has delivered a data quality programme with critical data elements, rules, thresholds and lineage.
* Has led a platform or architecture assessment and a remediation roadmap on a modern cloud data stack.
* Has handed a programme over to a BAU team, with SOPs, training and acceptance.
* Experience as a consultant or vendor lead working with client executives.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, statistics, business or a related field; a master’s degree is a plus.

**Behavioural competencies**

* **Executive influence:** gets decisions and sign-offs from senior leaders and busy business owners, and keeps approvals moving.
* **Plain-language communication:** turns frameworks into short material executives can read and act on.
* **Facilitation:** runs workshops where departments disagree, and brings them to one agreed definition.
* **Pragmatism:** balances good-practice governance with what a small team can actually run.
* **Ownership:** works without close supervision, and tracks commitments to closure.
* **Coaching:** builds capability in client teams so they can run the work after handover.

**Preferred certifications**

None is mandatory; proven delivery counts for more.

* CDMP (DAMA) or DCAM: data management
* PMP or PRINCE2: programme delivery
* SnowPro Core, or Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst: platforms
* ITIL 4 Foundation: BAU services
* An AI governance certification (for example IAPP AIGP): responsible AI

**Success in the first 6 months**

**By**

**Measure**

**Month 1**

Data Owners and Stewards named; access in place; plan, RAID and decision log running

**Month 2**

KPI, governance and data quality frameworks approved by the committees

**Month 3**

Platform roadmap approved; monthly data quality score live

**Month 4**

Growth blueprint and AI readiness plan approved

**Month 5**

Committee charter approved; handover items accepted by named owners

**Month 6**

Go-Live: BAU team runs the services without vendor support; Enterprise KPIs certified where a source exists

Work Location: In person

title: Lead Release Manager
description:
**As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.**
===============================================================

**Why Join Q2?**

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.

**What Makes Q2 Special?**

Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.

Q2 is seeking a **Lead Release Manager** to ensure software changes are delivered safely and predictably across our digital banking platform. You'll play a pivotal role in release governance and customer delivery while navigating complex environments and evolving technologies.

As part of our Software Delivery organization, you'll work across Engineering, Product, and customer-facing teams to drive informed decisions and effective coordination. We're looking for someone with sound judgment, exceptional organizational skills, and the curiosity to challenge existing practices and make software delivery simpler, safer, and more efficient.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------

  

* Lead release readiness reviews, challenge unresolved risks, and ensure approval requirements are met.
* Co-lead the Change Advisory Board (CAB) as a regional champion, driving risk-based decisions and consistent change governance.
* Coordinate release readiness across multiple product lines, ensuring dependencies, documentation, and communications are addressed.
* Coordinate customer-specific software updates by validating scheduling data, identifying inconsistencies, and confirming dependencies with accountable teams.
* Deliver clear, timely communications to customers and internal stakeholders regarding releases and planned updates.
* Facilitate alignment between Support, Product, and Engineering on customer-impacting defect priorities and their implications for upcoming releases.
* Challenge existing release workflows and drive measurable improvements in delivery reliability and efficiency.
* Partner with Engineering and AI enablement teams to identify automation opportunities, define requirements, and validate solutions that reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Required**

  

* Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in a related field and 9–12 years of relevant experience in software release management, software engineering, product delivery, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated success independently coordinating complex software releases or production delivery across multiple product teams and organizations.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), CI/CD pipelines, software testing, deployment workflows, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience with Change Advisory Boards (CAB), production change approvals, and higher-risk changes, including risk assessment and mitigation.
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, engage technical experts, and drive decisions and accountability across teams.
* Strong analytical skills with experience validating operational data, identifying inconsistencies, and managing competing schedules and priorities.
* Demonstrated success challenging existing processes, identifying inefficiencies, and driving measurable operational improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey release risks, changes, and impacts to technical teams, customers, and executive leadership.

**Preferred**

  

* Experience with progressive delivery, phased rollouts, artifact promotion, or cell-based architectures.
* Experience with automated release controls, quality gates, or deployment governance.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled workflows, MCP integrations, or process automation.
* Knowledge of DORA metrics and software delivery performance measurement.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Jenkins, or similar tools.
* Experience in financial technology, digital banking, or regulated SaaS environments.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES:** • Coordinate with Engineering groups and monitor associated software release notes for all component parts of the Q2ebanking software solutions • Establish Engineering completeness criteria including component dependencies to gate the delivery of releases into QA for testing • Coordinate with QA group and monitor releases in testing • Establish QA completeness criteria for release of successfully tested software component and their dependencies to gate the delivery of releases to Implementation groups • Maintain release baselines (versions of all compatible solution components) and updates for new and existing external customers • Serve as a liaison between business units to guarantee smooth and timely delivery of software packages to our Implementations and Support teams • Promote updates to administrative Windows application in a Data Center environment • Maintain records to identify cross-module compatibility of software versions • Responsible for ensuring that all security, availability, confidentiality and privacy policies and controls are adhered to • Answer questions and serve as source of knowledge for application releases **EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE:** • Bachelor’s degree in related field and 9-12 years in a software release management role • Experience managing, controlling and tracking releases with successful delivery • Experience with and knowledge of the following concepts and technologies: • Software Configuration Management • Software Release Management • Release notes and documentation processes • Windows 7, Windows 2003/2008 Server • SVN (preferred), GIT, and other Source Repository tools • Salesforce or other Case Management software • General knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC) processes • Manage multiple product releases in a fast pace environment

*This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.*

**Health & Wellness**

* Hybrid Work Opportunities
* Flexible Time Off
* Career Development & Mentoring Programs
* Health & Wellness Benefits, including competitive health insurance offerings and generous paid parental leave for eligible new parents
* Community Volunteering & Company Philanthropy Programs

We’re proud to foster a supportive, inclusive environment where career growth, collaboration, and wellness are prioritized. And our benefits go beyond healthcare—offering resources for physical, mental, and professional well-being. Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer. Q2 employees are encouraged to give back through volunteer work and nonprofit support through our Spark Program (see more). We believe in making an impact—in the industry and in the community.

title: Director of Product
description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

  

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.  

  

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.  

  

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.  

  

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.  

  

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.  

  

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
* Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insights, and what makes process KPIs meaningful to an enterprise buyer.
* You understand how AI and ML get applied in operational intelligence products. Not just the theory. You have worked through the practical realities of model development, validation, and how insights actually reach end users.
* You have shipped products used by large enterprises. You understand procurement cycles, compliance requirements, and what it takes to get something adopted at scale inside a Fortune 500 organization.
* You have led product teams before. People grew under your management. You know how to give teams real ownership while keeping everyone pointed in the same direction.
* You are technically credible. You can have a substantive conversation with engineers and data scientists about architecture decisions, API design, and data pipeline trade-offs without needing someone to translate.
* You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically about what you use them for and what impact they have had. This is a real expectation, not a checkbox.
* You communicate clearly across very different audiences, from a technical spec reviewed by engineers to a roadmap presentation in front of a board.
You can operate in ambiguous situations without becoming paralyzed. Fast-moving, early stage environments energize rather than frustrate you.  

  

**Education**

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field is required. An MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative or business discipline is a strong plus.

  

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**

* You have built a product roadmap that the whole company believes in and that customers are genuinely excited about.
* You have shipped meaningful improvements to the process intelligence platform that customers are using, talking about, and renewing because of. • The product team is operating well. People have clear ownership, they are growing in their roles, and there is a culture of honest feedback and continuous learning.
* Skan's process intelligence story is sharper and more differentiated in the market. That is visible in customer conversations, analyst coverage, and competitive win rates.
* You have introduced AI-assisted ways of working into how the team runs discovery, writes specifications, and tracks the competitive landscape. It has made a measurable difference.
People across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and leadership come to you when they need the product perspective. You have earned that trust through good judgment and clear communication.  

  

Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate. We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.
