Identify potential risks in data engineering processes and develop strategies to mitigate them, ensuring continuity and reliability of data services. - (15%)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Apache Hadoop

* Team Management
* Strategic Thinking

  
**Reports To** : Director and above
  
  
**Direct Reports** : 6 - 10
  
  
**Work Environment**Normal office environment, hybrid.  

  

**Other Duties**

This job description is illustrative of the types of duties typically performed by this job. It is not intended to be an exhaustive listing of each and every essential function of the job. Because job content may change from time to time, the Company reserves the right to add and/or delete essential functions from this job at any time.

**About Bread Financial®**

At Bread Financial, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community, and be part of our award-winning culture. title: AI Project Specialist
description:
Req ID:520173

  

At Alstom, we understand transport networks and what moves people. From high-speed trains, metros, monorails, and trams, to turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signalling and digital mobility, we offer our diverse customers the broadest portfolio in the industry. Every day, more than 80 000 colleagues lead the way to greener and smarter mobility worldwide, connecting cities as we reduce carbon and replace cars.

  

As part of Alstom’s global digital transformation, our Data Science & AI team plays a strategic role in accelerating innovation, operational excellence, and enterprise‑wide adoption of AI‑driven solutions.

**Your future role**

Take on a new challenge and apply your **Project Management** skills in the exciting cutting-edge field of Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. You’ll work alongside collaborative and forward-thinking teammates. You'll play a pivotal role in ensuring effective delivery of enterprise grade digital and AI‑enabled initiatives to support operational excellence at Alstom.

Day‑to‑day, you’ll collaborate with cross‑functional stakeholders to shape AI use cases end‑to‑end — from problem framing and feasibility, through requirements and backlog refinement, to planning and tracking project activities, managing timelines and milestones, and supporting coordination across business, PMO, and delivery teams. You’ll contribute to solution design discussions, assist in backlog refinement, and help ensure smooth execution and adoption of digital initiatives.

**We’ll look to you for:**

* Translating business needs into clear, functional and non‑functional specifications and high‑quality documentation
* Scoping AI use cases with stakeholders and defining success metrics/KPIs and acceptance criteria
* Supporting project planning, scheduling, milestone tracking and dependency management
* Managing end-to-end project from identifying Make vs Buy, RFP launching & processing and lead the project
* Organising discovery workshops and design thinking sessions to identify, prioritise and refine AI opportunities
* Conducting stakeholder analysis, gap and impact assessments, and maintaining traceability across requirements
* Collaborating with Data Scientists and Data Engineers, Architects, development teams and PMO to ensure alignment
* Ensure alignment on feasibility, requirements, dependencies and delivery constraints across teams
* Managing product backlogs (epics, features, user stories) and supporting Agile ceremonies in Jira/Azure DevOps/Confluence
* Preparing project artefacts (RAID logs, dashboards, status reports, documentation)
* Coordinating with cross‑functional teams to track deliverables and resolve issues. Driving UAT planning, test coordination, defect management, training and adoption activities
* Identifying and tracking risks across scope, timelines, resources, governance and compliance.
* Supporting change management activities: communication, training coordination, onboarding and post‑deployment follow‑up
* Demonstrating curiosity, resilience, and a continuous‑learning mindset to evaluate new tools while ensuring value delivery
* Exposure to agentic AI platforms like Copilot Studio, M365 Copilot, Dataiku and LibreChat to support development of AI prototypes/PoCs will be a plus

**All about you**

We value curiosity, ownership and a growth mindset. That’s why we don’t expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we’ve listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data/Analytics, or equivalent with technical exposure
* 5–10 years experience as a Project Manager, Business Analyst or similar role in enterprise‑scale initiatives
* Proven experience in requirements engineering (BRD/FRD, user stories, process modelling such as BPMN/UML, prioritization techniques, acceptance criteria)
* Experience planning and coordinating multi‑stakeholder projects, including RAID and project dashboards
* Proficiency with BA/PM tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Project, Excel and PowerPoint
* Strong communication and facilitation skills to interact with business and technical teams and translate complex AI/technical topics for non‑technical audiences
* Good understanding of Agile and/or Waterfall project delivery frameworks
* Experience supporting UAT, change management and user training for digital solutions
* Familiarity with data analytics and reporting tools like Power BI and Qlik Sense
* Understanding of AI/ML concepts and lifecycle (use‑case framing, data pipelines, evaluation metrics, model limitations) is expected.
* **Good To have:**
  + Experience with agentic AI platforms (e.g., Copilot Studio, M365 Copilot, Dataiku, LibreChat) and Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate)
  + Technical foundations (good to have): basic SQL, understanding of APIs/integrations, data structures and data quality concepts;
  + Certifications (good to have): PMP, PRINCE2, CSM, CBAP, PMI‑PBA

**Things you’ll enjoy**

Join us on a transformative journey – the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. You’ll also:

* Collaborate with transverse teams and supportive colleagues across a global enterprise
* Contribute to innovative AI programmes and work with cutting‑edge platforms to deliver solutions for business needs across Alstom
* Utilise a dynamic, learning‑oriented environment that fosters adaptability and technical curiosity
* Shape and influence digital delivery, stakeholder engagement and governance, with clear progression paths in Project Management, Business Analysis, Digital Transformation and Data & AI careers

  

You don’t need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, you’ll be proud. If you’re up for the challenge, we’d love to hear from you!

  

**Important to note**

As a global business, we’re an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. We’re committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

  

Job Type:Experienced

**Job Segment:** Business Analyst, Computer Science, Change Management, Pre-Sales, RFP, Technology, Management, Sales

description:
**Senior Engineering Manager, GG14, Software and Platform Engineering**

Are you an experienced engineering leader passionate about modernising complex, data-intensive platforms?

Do you want to lead engineering teams that support the sourcing, validation, enrichment and delivery of high-value Commodities pricing and fundamentals data? If yes, we would love to talk to you.

  
  

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead the engineering teams that power Commodities Content Operations in LSEG. This role sits at the intersection of Engineering, Product, Data and Operations, with responsibility for modernising platforms, improving data quality and reliability and accelerating the adoption of AI-driven and cloud-based capabilities across content operations.

You will lead teams responsible for the applications, platforms and automation capabilities that support the onboarding, management, transformation and distribution of Commodities pricing and fundamental data. The role combines people leadership, engineering strategy, platform modernisation and operational excellence.

  
  

**What You Will Do**

* Lead and develop high-performing software and data engineering teams.
* Define and implement engineering roadmaps aligned to business, product and customer priorities.
* Drive modernisation of legacy applications and services while ensuring operational stability.
* Partner with Content Operations, Product, Data Strategy, Engineering and Architecture teams to deliver scalable and resilient solutions.
* Build platforms and automation capabilities that improve operational efficiency, data quality and customer outcomes.
* Establish standard methodologies across software engineering, DevOps, observability and service management.
* Drive adoption of AI and intelligent automation to reduce manual effort and improve productivity.
* Develop and implement technical debt reduction strategies, including application rationalisation, code modernisation and technology upgrades.
* Improve platform reliability, resilience, monitoring and recovery capabilities.
* Foster an engineering culture focused on innovation, teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement.

* Microsoft Azure and cloud-native services
* Databricks and modern data platforms
* Python and API-driven architectures
* Data engineering and large-scale data processing pipelines
* CI/CD, DevOps and Infrastructure-as-Code practices
* Observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog
* AI, automation and intelligent workflow solutions
* Legacy platform modernisation and cloud migration programmes

* Significant experience leading software, platform or data engineering teams (6-7 years).

* Strong understanding of software engineering, cloud technologies, platform engineering and operational resilience.

* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence across Engineering, Product and Business teams.
* Experience building and developing high-performing engineering organisations.
* Passion for innovation, customer outcomes and continuous improvement.

This is a unique opportunity to help shape the future of Commodities data platforms, leading engineering transformation in a business that delivers critical content and

insights to global financial markets. You will play a key role in driving cloud adoption, AI-enabled operations, platform modernisation and engineering excellence while developing teams and capabilities that will support long-term business growth.

* Ability to analyze logs, traces, and runtime errors.
* Understanding of application architecture (frontend, backend, services).
* Experience in fixing bugs and supporting live applications.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines for application deployment.
* Hands-on experience with Git for version control.
* Experience managing deployments across multiple environments.

  

**Security & Access Management, Platform & Operations, Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of authentication and authorization concepts.
* Experience with IAS integration and SSO configurations.
* Experience managing role collections and user roles in SAP BTP.
* Knowledge of OAuth, SAML, and token-based authentication.
* Experience handling production support and escalations.
* Understanding of monitoring tools and alert handling.
* Ability to manage multiple tickets across customers simultaneously.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently investigate and resolve complex issues.
* Proactive mindset with ownership of issues and escalations.
* Strong communication skills to interact with global teams and customers.
* Ability to provide clear and structured RCA documentation.
* Good understanding of support processes and incident management.
* Ability to work in a structured and disciplined manner.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

title: Sr Advanced Project Engr
description:
Be part of the Program Management Office (PMO) that is integral to our Honeywell Connected Enterprise (HCE) portfolio with responsibility over Engineering Operations across all our global sites determining Management Operating Systems (MOS) and implementing best practices for elements such as: Strategic Planning (STRAP), Annual Operating Plans (AOP), life cycle management, metrics, scrum, and agile techniques that supports the development and integration of highly complex software functions within HCE. You will partner with world class engineering and leaders to implement product strategies, develop program schedules and milestones, and define technology. You will also generate innovative solutions in work situations; trying different and novel ways to deal with problems and opportunities.

The Senior Advanced Project Engineer will assist in creating and executing on Connected Enterprise engineering management operating system, manage projects as required, and contribute to strategy deployment of Connected Enterprise business. This position will provide support for a variety of products, processes, and system development programs across customer platforms. You will be responsible for programs including technical, financial, and organizational elements.

You will work in close coordination with the PMO, technical managers, software engineers as well as support functions. You will be responsible for close interaction and support of strategic business initiatives including proposal development, strategic planning and customer support and product development. You will achieve breakthrough improvements in program performance through development and deployment of cost effective and proactive processes.

  

YOU MUST HAVE

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering

* 5-6 years of software program management experience; managing complex projects or multiple projects combined into a program with demonstrated success.

* 5-6 years technical product development.

* 4 years of experience managing the development of one or more enterprise class software development projects.

* 4 years of experience in leading programs utilizing the Agile product development process.

WE VALUE

* Minimum 5-6 years of relevant engineering and program management experience with a track record of delivering successful results on significant, well tracked software, mechanical, electronics and/or services programs.

* Experience in all aspects of the engineering development life cycle, and program management including key Agile tools and techniques such as scrum, Kanban, sprints, epics, and story point estimating.

* Advanced Degree (MBA, Engr).

* Scaled Agile Framework – SAFe Certification.

* PMP, Agile Certification (scrum master PSM, CSM) or equivalent certification preferred.

* Tools: Jira, Confluence, Other Portfolio/ Program Management Tools (Jira Align, MSFT Project, etc.)

* Prior experience with SaaS based cloud products.

  

Essential Responsibilities:

* Generate and implement MOS, programs and other requirements using SAFe and CCMI techniques;

* Understand and support both the Support strategic planning (STRAP) and annual operation plan (AOP) and are comfortable assisting in formally establishing these processes

* Understands the SW development life cycle, both waterfall and agile.

* Oversee various portfolios and/or programs focusing on PI iterations and sprints stages.

* Employ PM tools and development processes, including statement-of-work (SOW), work-breakdown- structure (WBS), basis-of-estimate (BOE) management, scope / requirements management, scheduling, and cost management

* In an agile fashion - Execute on scope, schedule, cost, delivery, and quality while demonstrating program management skills in the following areas:

o Portfolio Backlog management; PI Requirements Management and Fulfillment; Planning / Estimation, including resource, material, capital, and other needs

o Scheduling, including resource-loading and critical path analysis for any assigned projects

o Financials (ex. RDE, spend, forecast, variance); Risk Management (Identification & Mitigation);

o Reporting / Reviews, and Communications;

* Collaboration … capability to work across and influence multiple groups;

* Facilitate forecasting and capacity analysis related to delivery requirements

* Establish and maintain the channels of communication necessary to assure timely management awareness of program progress and issues, including external communications

* Consistently present programmatic details, requirements, actions, and status to (senior) leadership, technical, and functional audiences

* Vendor interface

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. * Leverage technical expertise in IT Operations Management (ITOM) to drive business outcomes and value realization for customers.
* Drive customer retention, expansion, and growth opportunities in conjuction with Account Sales
* Manage and grow customer relationships within enterprise and matrix organizations, aligning technical solutions with business goals.
* Help customers navigate business transformation and adopt innovative strategies for success.
* Drive NPS and customer satisfaction in your territory of assigned accounts.
* Demonstrate strong business acumen and a proactive approach to identifying growth opportunities.
* Balance technical problem-solving with a focus on business impact and results.
* Excel in time management, effectively juggling multiple priorities and navigating ambiguous situations while delivering high-quality outcomes
* Bring a passion for technology, attention to detail, and the ability to adapt and learn on the go.
* Thrive in a collaborative team environment and foster a positive, growth-focused workplace culture.

**Knowledge and Skills:**

title: Director Product Management
description:
**About Target:**

As a Fortune 50 company with more than 350,000 team members worldwide, Target is an iconic brand and one of America's leading retailers.

Working at Target means the opportunity to help all families discover the joy of everyday life. Caring for our communities is woven into who we are, and we invest in the places we collectively live, work and play. We prioritize relationships, fuel and develop talent by creating growth opportunities, and succeed as one Target team. At our core, our purpose is ingrained in who we are, what we value, and how we work. It’s how we care, grow, and win together.

Fueling the continued success of one of the world’s most beloved and recognized brands is a distinctly capable, creative and innovative Servicing organization well known for inspiring and surprising guests, and we pride ourselves on connecting them to the products and experiences they expect and deserve from Target.

**About Team & Role:**

Target Enterprise Services (TES) is a globally integrated organisation focused on delivering operational excellence and enterprise transformation through service operations, procurement, finance, product, analytics, automation, and AI. Operating through a highly collaborative, cross-functional model, TES partners across the enterprise to simplify processes, improve experiences, reduce friction, create scalable capabilities and unlock business value for Guests, team members, vendors, and business partners.

Product Teams at TES are accountable for the delivery of business outcomes enabled through technology, data science and analytic products that are easy to use, easily maintained and highly reliable. Product teams have one shared backlog that is inclusive of all products, technology and design work.

As a Director of Product Management, you will set the overall strategic vision for your product portfolio and lead the team in delivering measurable business outcomes. You will establish short- and long-term product goals, define quarterly Objectives and Key Results, prioritise investments, and manage product budgets and financials.

The Director of Product Management based in India is a strategic product leader responsible for accelerating Service Centre product capabilities and AI adoption, strengthening execution rigour, prioritising investments, enabling operational efficiency, and providing leadership across Product, Technology, Data, Design, and Operations teams globally and locally.

Further the role will be responsible for

* Driving day-to-day product excellence and velocity of Cross-functional teams
* Ensuring strong alignment between global product strategy and local execution, especially faster decision making
* Elevating product thinking, maturity, innovation, and data-driven decision-making leveraging Digital-first mindset.
* Serving as the site leader for product team functionally reporting to the US product leader

**Detailed Job Description:**

Success in this role requires balancing strategic thinking with execution excellence, fostering strong product and engineering practices, and building high-performing teams. This leader will transform servicing data into actionable enterprise insights, accelerate digital adoption, reduce friction across customer journeys, and create scalable, reusable platforms that strengthen loyalty, improve productivity, and unlock enterprise value.

You will build, coach, and mentor a strong team of Product Managers while fostering a culture of progress, transparency, accountability, and efficiency. You will elevate the team’s performance by providing insightful, motivating, and constructive feedback and by partnering with senior leaders and peers across pyramids to resolve execution-related barriers.

You will lead product discovery with key stakeholders, validating hypotheses and concepts with customers before committing engineering capacity. You will guide complex work across multiple pyramids and interrelated specialities. You will use data and analytics to assess market context, inform decisions, evaluate product health and effectiveness, understand P&L impact, and provide clear recommendations to key stakeholders.

You will possess or develop a strong understanding of servicing platforms and systems, including data flows, transaction sequences, relevant technologies, and design principles, to enable innovative and scalable solutions across Target.

Core responsibilities of this job are described within this job description. Job duties may change at any time due to business needs.

**About you:**

* Four-year degree or equivalent experience.
* 10+ years of product management experience, including experience leading product teams, preferably within retail, consumer, or servicing environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading product-driven business transformation.
* Experience managing product portfolios, investment priorities, budgets, financials, and business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of technology, data, analytics, and digital product development.
* Proven ability to influence senior leaders and align stakeholders across complex, cross-functional organisations.
* Expertise in establishing product vision, outcome-based roadmaps, OKRs, and success measures.
* Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and lead high-performing product teams.
* Expertise in agile product-development practices, including iterative development, discovery, experimentation, and backlog management.

title: Senior People Development Partner
description:
At SolarWinds, we're a people-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.

The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We're looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world-class solutions in a fast-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you're looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you've come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!

The Senior People Development Partner designs and delivers practical, scalable talent development solutions that build capability, strengthen performance, and support employee growth. This role partners with business leaders and People Partners to diagnose capability needs and translate business priorities into engaging learning experiences.

This hands-on role combines instructional design, facilitation, consulting, and project leadership. The Senior People Development Partner independently leads initiatives from needs analysis through implementation and evaluation, contributes to enterprise Talent Development programs, and uses AI and emerging technologies to improve learning effectiveness and efficiency.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Design and facilitate engaging learning programs, workshops, and blended experiences using adult learning, instructional design, and behavior-change principles.
* Create practical learning assets, including facilitator guides, participant materials, job aids, e-learning, microlearning, and pre-work.
* Partner with business leaders and People Partners to identify capability gaps, understand root causes, and recommend targeted development solutions.
* Serve as a trusted advisor, translating business needs into clear learning strategies and practical actions.
* Lead end-to-end People Development projects, including needs assessment, scoping, planning, stakeholder alignment, content development, delivery, evaluation, and sustainment.
* Contribute to enterprise programs across onboarding, career development, performance management, manager development, leadership development, and succession planning.
* Build scalable solutions and resources that can be deployed globally while allowing for appropriate local context.
* Collaborate with stakeholders, subject-matter experts, and vendors to ensure solutions are relevant, inclusive, accurate, and aligned to intended outcomes.
* Support adoption through clear communication, manager enablement, change management, reinforcement, and on-the-job application.
* Define success measures and use feedback, learning analytics, talent data, and business indicators to evaluate impact and improve programs.
* Support the effective use of learning technologies, including the LMS and digital learning platforms, and apply generative AI to improve content development, personalization, accessibility, and efficiency.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5-8 years of experience in Talent Development, Learning & Development, Organizational Development, or a related field.
* Experience designing, developing, and facilitating learning for employees, managers, and leaders.
* Strong knowledge of adult learning, instructional design, facilitation, and behavior-change principles.
* Experience leading end-to-end learning or Talent Development projects and partnering with leaders and People Partners to develop solutions.
* Strong consulting, communication, stakeholder management, facilitation, and project management skills.
* Experience with learning management systems, digital learning platforms, and content development tools.
* Practical proficiency using generative AI to improve learning design, content creation, or workplace productivity.
* Ability to use data and feedback to assess effectiveness, make recommendations, and improve learner experiences.
* Strong critical thinking, organization, adaptability, and ability to work effectively with globally distributed teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in a global SaaS, software, cybersecurity, or technology organization.
* Experience supporting manager development, leadership development, career development, performance management, or onboarding programs.
* Familiarity with talent management platforms, learning analytics, digital authoring tools, and virtual learning technologies.
* Experience designing scalable learning solutions for geographically distributed audiences.
* Familiarity with change management, organizational effectiveness, capability building, and content curation.

SolarWinds is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. SolarWinds will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Job Description**

Role purpose
  
Lead a healthy, capable and outcome-owned engineering group that delivers X3 readiness while protecting quality, customer continuity, people development and sustainable delivery capacity.
  
X3 context
  
Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.
  
The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.
  
Required technical and domain skills
  
- Experience leading software engineering teams delivering commercial, cloud or ERP products.
  
- Technical fluency across modern backend engineering, SQL/databases, APIs, legacy modernisation, SaaS delivery and automation.
  
- Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
  
- Ability to manage distributed teams, dependencies, hiring, performance, development and difficult conversations.
  
- Comfort with delivery metrics, quality gates, reliability, support economics and evidence-based governance.
  
- Strong English communication and the judgement to balance near-term delivery with long-term capability.
  
Modern platform skills for this role
  
- Use developer and operator feedback, platform adoption, delivery flow, reliability, support effort and cost to guide capacity and improvement. Be fluent in secure delivery, identity, telemetry, lifecycle and rollback decisions for the group; implementation depth and tool use remain with the relevant engineers.
  
Preferred skills
  
- Experience scaling India engineering capacity in a global product organisation.
  
- Hands-on exposure to L4G/4GL, Progress 4GL, Web/Syracuse, data migration or batch processing.
  
- Sage X3/Xtrem and enterprise application language experience.
  
- Cloud platform, migration programmes, partner ecosystems or regulated SaaS.
  
- Formal people leadership qualification or Agile coaching experience.
  
Experience and qualifications
  
Typically 10+ years in software delivery, including 3+ years managing or leading engineering teams. Degree or equivalent experience in engineering, computer science or a related field.
  
Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.
  
Expected outcomes / success measures
  
- Squads have named owners, realistic capacity, clear dependencies and a visible path to each evidence gate.
  
- Delivery predictability, quality, retention, engagement and technical capability improve over time.
  
- India delivery owns meaningful outcomes with effective global collaboration rather than serving as a hand-off function.
  
- Customer continuity, supportability and rollback remain protected while modernisation accelerates.
  
\*Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role’s owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities \*\*become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.\*
  
Key stakeholders and collaboration model
  
Works with Product Managers, Architects, Principal Engineers, People teams, Programme Management, Security, Cloud Support/L3, Customer Services, partners and senior leadership across regions. Maintains practical Europe/North America overlap for decisions and escalation.
  
Sage behaviours / leadership expectations
  
Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Accountability, Trust, Developing Talent, Innovation and Collaboration. Creates clarity, gives context, removes blockers and holds a high bar with humanity.
  
Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

Core accountabilities and decision ownership
  
- Own delivery capacity, staffing, prioritisation flow, quality, dependencies, risk and continuity for one or more multidisciplinary squads.
  
- Create the conditions for engineers, automation specialists, product and architecture partners to deliver measurable outcomes rather than activity.
  
- Hire, onboard, coach, develop and retain talent in India while building effective links with Europe, North America and APAC colleagues.
  
- Run transparent delivery and risk reviews; ensure quarterly evidence gates, monthly scorecards and scope guardrails are respected.
  
- Partner with Architects and Product Managers on sequencing, trade-offs, escalation, operational readiness and customer impact.
  
- Ensure incident learning, support knowledge transfer, security, inclusion and psychological safety are part of normal delivery.
  
Decision ownership:
  
People and capacity decisions, delivery sequencing within mandate, risk escalation, team operating model and readiness recommendations. Escalates material product, architecture, security, legal or commercial decisions with evidence.
  
Common capability baseline
  
All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:
  
- Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
  
- Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
  
- Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
  
- Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
  
- Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
  
- Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
  
- Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
  
- Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
  
- Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

title: Service Desk Support
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**  
  
Are you ready to lead and inspire a team of talented professionals towards delivering services that make a real impact? As a Services Delivery Team Lead at Kyndryl, you’ll have the opportunity to take the lead in guiding our squads towards delivering exceptional end-to-end services. As a facilitator of agile practices, you'll be instrumental in optimizing workflows, identifying bottlenecks, and eliminating obstacles to supercharge squad performance. Armed with your deep technical expertise, you'll champion high-quality deliverables throughout the technical services lifecycle, not only meeting but exceeding our customer business needs.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Partner with Delivery Managers to align customer service priorities with operational and business objectives.
* Develop a strong understanding of customer industries, business needs, and desired outcomes to ensure effective service delivery.
* Leverage Kyndryl Bridge insights and data-driven recommendations to improve service performance and stability.
* Lead the troubleshooting and resolution of complex technical and service-related issues as the primary technical resource.
* Manage squad workloads and priorities to ensure alignment with business goals, customer expectations, and SLAs.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders through effective communication, collaboration, and project updates.
* Coach, mentor, and support squad members through feedback, training, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
* Drive cross-functional service improvement projects by collaborating with multiple teams and agile squads to meet evolving customer needs.
Utilize data, AI-driven insights, and platform modernization best practices to deliver innovative solutions and continuous service improvements.  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
  
Kyndryl has a global footprint, which means that as a technical leader at Kyndryl, you will have opportunities to work on projects and collaborate with colleagues from around the world. This role is dynamic and influential – offering a wide range of professional and personal growth opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* Proven experience leading technical team(s) through incident, problem and change management, as well as root cause analysis
* 4.5+ years of Service Desk Operations & Training experience
* Ability to effectively communicate with both technical and customer stakeholders
* Industry recognized certifications in the aligned supporting area (e.g., CompTia A+, ITIL, SDA, SDM, Public/Private Cloud, Mainframe etc.)
* Must be fluent in English language(s)
* Facilitating the smooth transfer of knowledge to the entire team.
* Conduct assessments to identify the specific needs and challenges the team face during the transition
Develop and deliver training programs to equip individuals with the necessary skills and knowledge for their new roles.  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* This position is open for tenured Band 5, Band 6A open for lateral movement, tenured Band 6A and Band 6B open for lateral movement.
* Bachelor's degree in related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Experience with an ITIL driven service organization
Six Sigma, PMP, and/or ITIL certifications  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

The Platform Administrator serves as a trusted advisor and technical administrator for ServiceChannel customers, ensuring platform configurations are maintained, optimized, and aligned to business requirements. * Configure and maintain ServiceChannel platform settings based on customer requirements.
* Modify and manage user access, permissions, and administrative settings.
* Implement customer-requested updates within approved platform modules.
* Maintain dashboard settings, workflows, and issue list configurations.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for platform administration requests.
* Review customer enhancement requests and collaborate with internal stakeholders to evaluate solutions.

* Inventory
* Projects

* Dashboard administration
* Issue List configuration

* 2+ years of experience in SaaS administration, customer support, system administration, facility management technology, or related fields.
* Experience managing customer-facing technology solutions.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer requests simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders.

**Preferred**

* ServiceChannel platform experience.
* Zendesk experience.
* Knowledge of facilities management workflows.
* Experience with workflow automation and business process optimization.
* Experience supporting enterprise customers.

* Customer satisfaction and platform adoption
* Configuration accuracy and quality
* Request turnaround time
* SLA adherence

* Stakeholder satisfaction

description:

Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

The Major Incident Manager plays a critical role in the success of the Optum Technology Command Center. The role involves dynamic responsibilities that shift based on the nature and severity of incidents.

  + Lead war room sessions, coordinate technical troubleshooting, and collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to drive resolution
* Action Planning & Execution
  + Define clear action plans with ownership, timelines, and follow-through to achieve workarounds or permanent fixes
* Process Improvement

    
  + Contribute to continuous improvement of incident management processes and workflows
* Tool & Resource Development
  + Maintain and enhance dashboards, automation assets, and tools used for major incident management
* Metrics & Reporting
  + Produce periodic reports, including metrics, trend analysis, and executive summaries for leadership review
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience
* ITIL Certification
* 7+ years of Major Incident Management / Critical Incident Management experience
* Experience with ServiceNow/ITSM tools (Incident, Change, Problem, CMDB, etc.)
* Solid verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to understand technical discussions during restoration bridges
* Incident Management:\
  + Proficient in ITIL processes, major incident lifecycle management, impact analysis, and prioritization
* Leadership & Coordination:
  + Skilled in war room management, rapid decision‑making, and stakeholder alignment during critical events
* Communication:
  + Solid ability to deliver clear updates, manage crisis communication, prepare executive reports, and document RCA effectively
* Technical Expertise:
  + Solid understanding of IT infrastructure, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), API integrations, and AI‑driven monitoring & automation.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Solid understanding of enterprise monitoring systems
* Knowledge of infrastructure, cloud technologies, or experience in infrastructure/application support
* Self-starter with sound judgment and independent decision‑making ability
* Excellent interpersonal and organizational skills
* Demonstrated customer‑centric mindset and passion for customer experience
* Ability to drive results in a fast‑paced and challenging environment
* Secondary Skills:
  + Cloud Resilience
    - Knowledge of multi‑region failover strategies and API security/performance optimization
  + AI/ML Applications
    - Familiarity with predictive maintenance and automated insights using AI/ML tools
  + Data Analysis
    - Experience with trend analysis and creating dashboards for real-time metrics and operational visibility
  + Soft Skills:
    - Solid in stress management, negotiation, conflict resolution, and demonstrating customer empathy

title: General Manager - Engineering
description:

The IAD EAE+ CoE Leader is responsible for leading the execution strategies for Projects & Services as well as supporting our Pre-sales & Innovation initiatives, in collaboration w/ globally distributed Open Automation Delivery, Pre-sales & Innovation Support Leads & regional IAD & proposal teams. * **Projects/Services and Resource Management:**
  + Contribute to business growth by achieving Open Automation's targets through the delivery of successful, innovative, and high-quality projects
  + Contribute to and support project proposals, including defining execution models, scopes of work, solutions, pricing estimates, schedules, and resource allocations for business opportunities & projects
  + Plan, ability to lead when/if required, and support key project & technical discussions (eg: project reviews, design workshops, KOMs, etc.)
  + Serve as the focal point for managing/addressing escalations related to CoE team challenges
  + Oversee CoE resource forecasts, allocations, and utilization/recovery plans
  + Collaborate pro-actively w/ relevant IAD & other SE stakeholders to define competencies/skills required for the Open Automation Engineer of the future & define a plan for how IAD resources can acquire these skills
* **Quality and Process Improvement:**
  + Ensure proper quality reviews of CoE team deliverables by instituting the needed guidelines/controls in place & ensuring team compliance to those
  + Drive engineering excellence & consistency
* **Client and Stakeholder Engagement:**
  + Maintain productive relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and ensure successful customer engagement for strong customer satisfaction
* **Technical Excellence:**
  + Support (and lead when required) FEED, beneficial studies, PoC, technical risk reviews and cold eye reviews of selected projects
  + Explore alternatives and minimum compliant solutions for Projects and drive/support engineered solutions to meet customer requirements
  + Support Open Automation Innovation and Verification & Validation activities
  + Play an active role in knowledge management and sharing across the domain and wider team

* **Sales and Proposal Support:**
  + Early engagement on strategic opportunities and support sales with technical expertise during client presentations and product demos
  + Drive benchmark for technical solution & support estimations based on execution experiences
  + Participate in Deal winning sessions and CQA approval process when required
  + Review Compliance to Specifications and identify technical risks

**What skills and capabilities will make you successful?**

* Innovative approach, enthusiasm for the capabilities of EAE/SDA/OPA technology & passion for trying new things
* A continuous & quick learning mindset and a willingness to share knowledge
* Persuasive and Influential: Ability to effectively engage and inspire collaboration in a complex matrix & diverse team environment
* Business Acumen: Strong financial and commercial awareness, coupled with excellent judgment
* People Leadership: Focused on supporting team growth and development, recognizing and celebrating success, fostering a culture of continuous learning, strong engagement, motivation and designing an effective organization to meet current and future business needs
* Resilience: Comfortable with uncertainty, able to cope with pressure, and maintain composure
* Professional Challenger: Skilled in creating scope for discussion and negotiation, critical thinker, challenging professionally to drive better outcomes
* Pragmatic Decision-Making: Comfortable making fast decisions with calculated risks, ensuring practical and effective solutions

A recognized Degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Computer Science or Process Control is desirable.

* 10+ years experience with automation systems projects execution/delivery, with minimum of 4 years in lead technical and/or project management role
* Experience with automation systems proposals in terms of validation/benchmarking, architecture generation, sizing & estimation tools is a plus
* Knowledge of open automation solutions, tools & standards is a plus
* Fluency in English (oral and written). Other languages are beneficial
* Culturally sensitive and globally aware
* Willingness to travel internationally and regionally (as per business requirements)

Bring your project leadership expertise to a team that values impact and excellence — apply today!

title: Senior Development Manager, Technology
description:
Senior Development Manager – AI First Delivery & Transformation

LSEG Data | Corporate Actions

Role Purpose

  

The Engineering Manager is accountable for the delivery, migration, modernisation, and transformation of one or more Corporate Actions products. The role combines people leadership, technical leadership, product delivery accountability, and AI-first engineering practices to deliver secure, scalable, resilient, and commercially critical platforms.

The successful candidate will lead teams through complex transformation programmes while establishing and scaling AI-enabled software delivery, multi-agent engineering practices, and governed engineering control planes across the Software Development Lifecycle.

  
  

Technical

I lead AI-first engineering teams delivering complex products, migrations, and transformation programmes. I bring deep expertise in multi-agent software delivery, engineering control planes, agent orchestration, context engineering, and AI-enabled SDLC practices.

I establish standards for agent-assisted requirements, architecture, development, testing, governance, security, and operations while ensuring human accountability remains clear for all material decisions.

  

Mandatory Experience

Strong hands-on engineering background in either .NET/C# or Java enterprise development.

Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell or Bash.

Experience developing and operating containerised applications using Docker and modern cloud-native engineering practices.

Experience leading engineering teams delivering distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, and modern software platforms.

Experience implementing AI-assisted or agent-enabled software delivery practices.

  

Desirable Experience

React

Python

Go

Rust

C

C++

Azure

AWS

Kubernetes

Platform Engineering

AI orchestration frameworks, MCPs, agent governance, and model evaluation frameworks

  

Customer Focus

I ensure engineering teams remain focused on customer outcomes, service quality, and business value. I use AI and automation to accelerate delivery, improve product quality, reduce operational friction, and modernise legacy platforms without compromising reliability or trust.

  

Risk Management

I establish governance and control frameworks for AI-enabled engineering. I ensure agents, models, tools, and delivery workflows operate within defined security, compliance, operational resilience, and risk boundaries.

I balance delivery speed with appropriate engineering controls, auditability, observability, and release readiness.

  

Leadership

I lead high-performing engineering teams through product delivery, platform modernisation, cloud adoption, and large-scale transformation initiatives.

I create a culture where engineers effectively collaborate with AI agents, enabling teams to focus on architecture, decision-making, innovation, and customer outcomes rather than repetitive execution.

I coach and develop engineers, technical leads, and future leaders while building a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence.

  

Analytical

I use engineering, operational, delivery, and quality metrics to guide decisions and drive continuous improvement.

I establish measurable evidence for AI effectiveness, engineering productivity, quality improvement, delivery acceleration, operational resilience, and business outcomes.

  

Adaptability

I champion modern engineering practices and continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies, agent frameworks, cloud-native architectures, and software delivery models.

I help teams evolve from traditional software development approaches towards governed AI-native engineering operating models.

  

Communication

I communicate complex technical, delivery, transformation, and AI-related concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

I build confidence in AI-enabled delivery by explaining risks, controls, trade-offs, and outcomes in a transparent and evidence-based manner.

  

Key Accountabilities

Own delivery outcomes for assigned Corporate Actions products and platforms.

Lead major migration, modernisation, and transformation initiatives.

Drive adoption of AI-first software engineering practices.

Establish and govern multi-agent software delivery capabilities.

Improve engineering productivity, quality, and delivery predictability.

Ensure operational resilience, security, compliance, and service stability.

Partner with Product, Architecture, Quality Engineering, and Operations teams to deliver business outcomes.

Develop high-performing engineering teams and future technical leaders.

Manage technical debt, engineering risk, and platform sustainability.

Drive cloud adoption, automation, and platform simplification initiatives.

  

Success Measures

The role will be considered successful when:

Strategic transformation programmes are delivered successfully.

Product roadmaps are delivered predictably and with high quality.

Engineering productivity and automation maturity improve measurably.

AI-enabled delivery capabilities are embedded across the SDLC.

Operational risk, technical debt, and delivery friction are reduced.

Platform reliability, resilience, and observability improve.

Teams demonstrate strong engagement, capability growth, and retention.

Stakeholders have confidence in engineering execution, governance, and delivery outcomes.

Your role
  
Step into the engine room of enterprise technology, where every decision you make can shape how a customer’s systems perform today - and scale for tomorrow. You’ll dive deep into complex infrastructure environments, solving challenging technical problems, designing seamless integrations and ensuring systems run reliably at every level. Your expertise across networks, endpoints and mainframes, paired with a knack for logical problem-solving and clear documentation, will guide projects from concept to execution. Your solutions will make a real impact that customers notice and remember.
  
  
In this role, you’ll balance hands-on delivery with long-term strategic planning. From analyzing issues and testing solutions to automating processes and integrating across platforms, your work will touch every layer of IT infrastructure. You’ll collaborate with Architects, Technicians and Project Managers, gaining broad exposure and continuous opportunities to grow your skills and influence.
  
  
What you will do

* Design, deploy, and integrate end-to-end infrastructure solutions across hybrid cloud and on-premises environments to ensure seamless operations.
* Automate workflows, processes, and system tasks to improve reliability, efficiency, scalability, and operational consistency.

Continuously expand expertise in cloud technologies, enterprise IT systems, and emerging technologies while pursuing professional certifications and career growth opportunities.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior Administrator to Architect. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with customers in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You are customer-focused-someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless-naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

Required skills and experience
  

* 8+ years of experience and deep expertise within specific technology domain areas (e.g., software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics)
* Enterprise IT application experience
* Hands-on experience in at least one of the following: software development, DevOps engineering, systems administration, or systems architecture in public cloud AWS domain

Preferred skills and experience

**Being You**

We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. title: Assistant Manager, Strategic Partner Operations
description:
**ABOUT US:**

LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.

  

LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.

  

**OUR PEOPLE:**

People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.

  

We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.

  

**ROLE PROFILE:**
-----------------

**The Strategic Partner Operations team supports the commercial management of LSEG’s Strategic Partner ecosystem, including Co-Sell and Re-Sell Partners. The team is responsible for maintaining accurate partner reporting, supporting revenue share and Co-Sell reporting processes, and providing a reliable view of the Partner book of business.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**The team works closely with Partner Directors, Finance, Operations and other teams to improve data quality, reporting, revenue attribution and operational processes.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**The team is responsible for maintaining and analysing the Partner book of business, consolidating reporting from partners and internal systems, identifying trends and data-quality gaps, and improving how end-client relationships, revenue and partner performance are tracked.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**The team also manages the development and maintenance of a centralised global repository for Strategic Partner agreements, initially focused on Co-Sell agreements, to improve accessibility, governance and consistency of contractual information.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**ROLE SUMMARY:**
-----------------

The successful candidate will be part of the Global Strategic Partners organisation and will lead the Strategic Partner Operations team, with two Senior Analysts reporting to the role.

The Assistant Manager will be responsible for maintaining and improving reporting across the Co-Sell and Re-Sell Partner portfolio, ensuring a trusted view of the Partner book of business and strengthening the processes, tools and controls that support the team.

The role will also lead the development of a centralised repository for Co-Sell Partner agreements, ensuring contracts and key information are accurately captured, organised and accessible. The Assistant Manager will work closely with Partner Directors and other stakeholders to improve reporting, data quality, governance and operational processes as the business grows.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:**
-------------------------

* Lead the Strategic Partner Operations team and directly manage two Senior Analysts, setting priorities, supporting development and ensuring high-quality delivery.

* Own the collection, consolidation and analysis of reporting received from Co-Sell Partners, ensuring submissions are timely, complete and aligned to agreed requirements.

* Maintain the Co-Sell and Re-Sell book of business as a reliable source of truth across partner, end-client, revenue, product and geographic information.

* Lead the development and maintenance of a centralised global repository for Co-Sell Partner agreements, ensuring documentation is complete, accurate and accessible.

* Maintain key contractual information and support governance of the repository, working with Partner Directors and relevant teams to address missing or outdated records.

* Reconcile partner reported information against internal systems and commercial records, identifying discrepancies, duplicate records, missing data and other data-quality issues.

* Produce regular management reporting and dashboards covering Partner performance, revenue contribution, end-client activity and key trends.

* Work with Finance and other teams to improve the consistency and accuracy of Co-Sell revenue attribution.

* Provide analysis and insights to Partner Directors and the Global Strategic Partners leadership team to support commercial priorities and decision making.

* Lead improvements to reporting tools and processes, with a focus on automation, scalability, accuracy and reducing manual activity.

* Establish clear reporting standards, controls and operating rhythms across the team to ensure consistent and high-quality delivery.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**
----------------------

* Experience in business, partner, commercial or revenue operations, with responsibility for reporting, data management and operational processes.

* Experience building, maintaining and governing databases, books of business or commercial data repositories, with a focus on data quality and accuracy.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis, with experience working with large and complex datasets.

* Experience using CRM, reporting and data visualisation tools, such as Salesforce and Power BI, to develop dashboards and management reporting.

* Experience developing and improving operational processes, with a focus on simplification, automation and scalability.

* Ability to interpret commercial contracts and agreements and translate contractual terms, reporting obligations and commercial models into operational requirements.

* Experience with commercial reporting and revenue attribution, including reconciling information across multiple systems and identifying data gaps or inconsistencies.

* Ability to translate complex data into clear insights and recommendations that support business decisions.

* Effective communication and management skills, with the ability to collaborate across Partner, Finance, Sales, Operations and other global teams.

* Experience leading and developing team members, setting priorities, managing delivery and creating an inclusive, collaborative and accountable team environment.

* Commitment to data quality, operational excellence, governance and continuous improvement.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:**
------------------------------

As a member of the Global Strategic Partners organisation, you will gain exposure to some of LSEG's most important Co-Sell and Re-Sell Partners and to the breadth of Data & Analytics and Risk Intelligence products and services that underpin those relationships.

You will work closely with Partner Directors and Managers, Sales, Finance, Product, Operations and other specialist teams, giving you a broad understanding of how strategic partnerships are managed and how partner ecosystems contribute to LSEG's growth.

The role offers the opportunity to shape how we measure and manage the Co-Sell and Re-Sell business, improve the quality of decision-making through better data and reporting, and build scalable processes that can support future growth. You will also gain regular exposure to senior leaders and have the support of the wider team to help you develop your commercial, analytical and management capabilities.

You will also gain hands on experience leading and developing a team and working with key data, CRM, reporting and visualisation tools, including Excel, Salesforce and Power BI, while helping shape the tools and processes that support Strategic Partner Operations.

We recognize that to attract the best talent, we need to be flexible and we are open to discussing work arrangements with you. We take hybrid approach to workplace, this role is blended .

**Career Stage:**

Senior Associate

**London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) Information:**

Join us and be part of a team that values innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. If you're ready to take your career to the next level and make a significant impact, we'd love to hear from you.

LSEG is a leading global financial markets infrastructure and data provider. Our purpose is driving financial stability, empowering economies and enabling customers to create sustainable growth.

Our purpose is the foundation on which our culture is built. Our values of **Integrity, Partnership** , **Excellence** and **Change** underpin our purpose and set the standard for everything we do, every day. They go to the heart of who we are and guide our decision making and everyday actions.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

We are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. This means that we do not discriminate on the basis of anyone’s race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. Conforming with applicable law, we can reasonably accommodate applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs.

You will be part of a collaborative and creative culture where we encourage new ideas. We are committed to sustainability across our global business and we are proud to partner with our customers to help them meet their sustainability objectives. Our charity, the LSEG Foundation provides charitable grants to community groups that help people access economic opportunities and build a secure future with financial independence. Colleagues can get involved through fundraising and volunteering.

LSEG offers a range of tailored benefits and support, including healthcare, retirement planning, paid volunteering days and wellbeing initiatives.

Please take a moment to read this privacy notice carefully, as it describes what personal information London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG) (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, and how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject .

If you are submitting as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is essential and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to LSEG are aware of this privacy notice.
