title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
description:
**About the Role**
------------------

The **Senior AI Evals Test Engineer** is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the **Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks**. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment — ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including **adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement**. The engineer will **design scalable evaluation pipelines**, build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is **70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing**, and sits within the **Applied AI: Test Engineering team** as a key technical authority.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Design and build agent evaluation frameworks** — create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate
* **Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies** to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini models)
* **Build golden datasets and test harnesses** — curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)
* **Establish eval-as-a-service** — build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks
* **Automate regression and drift detection** — implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment
* **Define eval taxonomies and rubrics** — establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)
* **Instrument production observability** — build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns
* **Benchmark and select models** — run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases
* **Analyze and interpret evaluation results**, providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations
* **Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies** — functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) — tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities
* **Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts** (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions
* **Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects**, performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes
* **Evaluate new technologies and patterns** (e.g., new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap
* **Partner with policy and legal teams** to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements
* **Provide technical leadership to engineers**, including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers
* **Collaborate cross-functionally** — work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Education & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* **8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience**, with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)
* **2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building**, testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows
* **2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy,** quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment
* **1+ years** in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

### **Technical Skills**

* **Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation** — familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval,LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses
* **Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns** — tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
* **Production experience with eval pipelines** — building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)
* **Proficiency in Python** — strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale
* **Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service** relevant to AI/ML (e.g., Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows
* **Statistical literacy** — ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming)
* **Enterprise product sensibility** — understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs)
* **Excellent communication** — ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions
* **Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows**, including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps

### **Tech Stack:**

* **Languages:** Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional)
* **Test Automation:Selenium, Playwright**
* **LLM Providers:** Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models
* **Eval Tooling:** DeepEvals(Must), LLM as a Judge (Must), Promptfoo/RAGAS/LangSmith/ Custom harnesses
* **Agent Evals Frameworks/libraries:** LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, custom orchestrators
* **Infrastructure:**DevOps (Basic), Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), observability stacks (Datadog/Grafana)

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* **Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge**: Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment
* **Data Analysis:** Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results
* **Policy Background:** Familiarity with AI ethics principles and industry standards for responsible AI development
* **Garbage-in/Garbage-out (GIGO) Tools**: Any tool or framework that specializes in testing the model's response to highly ambiguous, misleading, or malformed inputs to test for robustness and safety failures
* **Experience testing complex APIs,** especially for tool-integration and function-calling scenarios in agentic workflows
* **Experience with prompt injection (Must)** and data poisoning skills is a plus
* **Certifications in AI/ML**, cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer, DeepLearning.AI specializations and software testing methodologies

**Soft Skills**
---------------

* **Proven ability to lead without direct authority**, influencing cross-functional teams and driving technical decisions through clarity and data rather than hierarchy.
* **Experience working in agile environments**, collaborating closely with product owners, scrum teams, and distributed stakeholders across time zones.
* **Excellent communication and documentation skills**, comfortable presenting solutions and trade-offs to engineers, managers, and senior business stakeholders.
* **Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills**, including the ability to decompose complex business processes into simple solutions

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience evaluating agents in cybersecurity, data protection, or infrastructure domains
* Familiarity with Rubrik's product portfolio or similar enterprise data management platforms
* Hands-on with human-in-the-loop eval workflows (annotation platforms, inter-rater reliability)
* Experience with model fine-tuning evaluation (pre/post quality comparison)
* Background in building internal developer platforms or tooling teams
* Contributions to open-source eval frameworks or published work on AI evaluation methodology
* Drive red-teaming and adversarial testing — design adversarial evaluation suites for jailbreak resistance, data leakage prevention, and boundary enforcement in enterprise-grade agents

**Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation**
----------------------------------------------------------------------

Rubrik (RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. Rubrik Security Cloud delivers complete cyber resilience by securing, monitoring, and recovering data, identities, and workloads across clouds. Rubrik Agent Cloud accelerates trusted AI agent deployments at scale by monitoring and auditing agentic actions, enforcing real-time guardrails, fine-tuning for accuracy and undoing agentic mistakes.

  

**Inclusion @ Rubrik**
----------------------

At Rubrik, we are dedicated to fostering a culture where people from all backgrounds are valued, feel they belong, and believe they can succeed. Our commitment to inclusion is at the heart of our mission to secure the world’s data.

Our goal is to hire and promote the best talent, regardless of background. We continually review our hiring practices to ensure fairness and strive to create an environment where every employee has equal access to opportunities for growth and excellence. We believe in empowering everyone to bring their authentic selves to work and achieve their fullest potential.

### **Our inclusion strategy focuses on three core areas of our business and culture:**

* Our Company: We are committed to building a merit-based organization that offers equal access to growth and success for all employees globally. Your potential is limitless here.
* Our Culture: We strive to create an inclusive atmosphere where individuals from all backgrounds feel a strong sense of belonging, can thrive, and do their best work. Your contributions help us innovate and break boundaries.
* Our Communities: We are dedicated to expanding our engagement with the communities we operate in, creating opportunities for underrepresented talent and driving greater innovation for our clients. Your impact extends beyond Rubrik, contributing to safer and stronger communities.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**
------------------------------------------------

Rubrik is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants in all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, promotion, compensation, training, leave, and termination.

Rubrik provides reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants and employees with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process or to perform your job, please contact hr@rubrik.com. Accommodations may include changes to the application process, documents in an alternate format, a sign language interpreter, or specialized equipment.

title: Sytems Engineer
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**Your role**  
As a System Engineer, you will play a key role in the configuration, maintenance and optimization of core Mainframe z/OS infrastructure that support mission critical enterprise workloads. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to respond to system issues and implement solutions, while also contributing to root cause analysis and continuous improvement efforts.

* Take required actions to maintain availability, reliability, and security.

You’ll be creating a well-rounded skillset while gaining professional certifications and qualifications.You can evolve horizontally into other technical or non-technical areas such as Technical Service Architect, or you can move vertically to become a Senior Project Manager or program manager. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

title: Senior Channel Account Manager
description:
**About Us:**

Proofpoint is a global leader in human- and agent-centric cybersecurity. We protect how people, data, and AI agents connect across email, cloud, and collaboration tools. Over 80 of the Fortune 100, 10,000 large enterprises, and millions of smaller organizations trust Proofpoint to stop threats, prevent data loss, and build resilience across their people and AI workflows. Our mission is simple: safeguard the digital world and empower people to work securely and confidently. Join us in our pursuit to defend data and protect people.

**How We Work:**

At Proofpoint you’ll be part of a global team that breaks barriers to redefine cybersecurity guided by our BRAVE core values:

**Bold** in how we dream and innovate

**Responsive** to feedback, challenges and opportunities

**Accountable** for results and best in class outcomes

**Visionary** in future focused problem-solving

**Exceptional** in execution and impact

**Proofpoint** is a leading cybersecurity company protecting organizations’ greatest assets and biggest risks: vulnerabilities in people. With an integrated suite of cloud-based solutions, Proofpoint helps companies around the world stop targeted threats, safeguard their data, and make their users more resilient against cyber attacks. Leading organizations of all sizes, including more than half of the Fortune 1000, rely on Proofpoint for people-centric security and compliance solutions mitigating their most critical risks across email, the cloud, social media, and the web.

We are singularly devoted to helping our customers protect their greatest assets and biggest security risk: their people. That’s why we’re a leader in next-generation cybersecurity.

**The Role and the Team**

In this role you will lead a group of sales leaders across our indirect sales teams in recruiting, developing and retaining top talent in order to deliver consistent revenue growth. You will be responsible for driving growth through the Channel and Alliance partnerships.

You will play a hands-on role with the field sales organization in this customer/partner facing and highly visible position, including (in-)direct participation in closing deals at key accounts.

This is an exciting opportunity to be an integral part of a dynamic and fast growing next generation security company, and you will have the opportunity to take the business to the next level.

We are open for the role to be in Australia or Singapore.

**Your day-to-day**

title: Performance & Capacility Management Specialist
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

As a Mainframe Performance & Capacity Management Specialist at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.
  
  
There’s never a typical day as a System Administrator at Kyndryl, because no two projects are alike. You’ll be managing systems data for clients and providing day-to-day solutions and security compliance. You’ll oversee a queue of assignments and work directly with technicians, prioritizing tickets to deliver the best solutions to our clients.
  
  
One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.
  
  
Your future at Kyndryl
  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  

* 5+ years of experience in mainframe performance and capacity planning on IBM z/OS platforms.
* In-depth knowledge of SMF/RMF data analysis, WLM configuration, and z/OS system performance metrics.
* Experience with Workload Load Manager (WLM), Parallel Sysplex configurations, multiple LPAR environments, and experience in capacity/performance reporting and modeling.
* Must have system performance understanding of mainframe components covering the areas of ZOS, JES, CICS, DB2 and IMS.
* Thorough knowledge in Performance analysis & tuning for ZOS operating environment / DASD / Tape storage systems.
* Ability to perform diagnostics and perform RCA [ Root cause analysis .
* Strong analytical and documentation skills.
* Should be a team player with excellent communication and technical skills.
* Provide a 7/24 service on-call to clients
* Capacity Planning for Processor, DASD, and on physical processors (CECs) for various customers.
* Knowledge about forecasting for processors, coupling facilities, DASD, Virtual Tape, and Tape in a complex.
Provide technical guidance to internal contacts in the design of infrastructure solutions that meet business needs and perform to engineered specifications.  

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  

* Hands on Experiences with navigation , debugging and monitoring with tools such as RMF(I, II, III) or Omegamon or TMON or BMC
* Hands on experiences with any Vendor products such as MXG, CA-MICS. Omegamon, Strobe, APA.
* Hands on experiences with TDS and QMF for Data extraction and Analysis.
* Experiences with tools such as CP3000, zPCR and zTPM are added advantage.
* Knowledge of **cost modeling** and mainframe MLC (Monthly License Charge) cost optimization strategies.

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Senior Engineer, Virtualization
description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***

**AHEAD is searching for a Senior Virtualization Engineer to be a part of our Managed Services team.** Candidates will be primarily responsible for the overall health, stability, security, performance, and lifecycle management of virtualization and compute platforms in our managed services customer environments. Candidates will serve as a senior member of the Managed Services Virtualization team, providing tier 3 technical leadership for virtualization technologies, complex incidents, platform improvements, and customer outcomes. The role participates in 24x7 operations and an on-call rotation. The ideal candidate should be customer focused, an effective communicator, self-initiating, accountable, and able to perform most tasks without direct oversight.

### **Principle Duties and Responsibilities**

Provide enterprise-level operational support for incident, problem, change, request, and event-management activities  

Lead complex and escalated virtualization incidents, including high-risk, recurring, cross-domain, vendor-dependent, and platform-impacting issues  
* Provide technical leadership during P1 incidents by assessing impact, coordinating technical actions, documenting risks and decisions, and driving resolution through closure

* Serve as a subject matter expert and escalation point for virtualization and compute technologies, addressing technical events and requests needing additional resources or urgent attention

Assess customer environments for performance, capacity, configuration, design, resilience, security, and supportability issues; propose and implement resolutions  

* Provide architectural oversight and validate that proposed changes, designs, and remediation plans align with vendor-supported practices, client standards, capacity, resiliency, security, and service scope

* Work across networking, storage, operating-system, security, monitoring, automation, and application teams to troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues

Work with vendors and hardware partners to resolve virtualization and compute issues, coordinate escalations, and implement supported resolutions  

* Own or contribute to problem-management records, corrective actions, preventive actions, post-incident reviews, and technical root-cause analyses for recurring or systemic issues

Lead or support platform lifecycle activities, including upgrade readiness, compatibility validation, capacity planning, end-of-support and end-of-life assessments, patch planning, firmware coordination, and VCF lifecycle management  

Maintain accurate client architecture, access, configuration, monitoring, hardware, firmware, inventory, and maintenance documentation. Reconcile documentation against authoritative platform, CMDB, monitoring, and inventory sources  
* Ensure that clients' infrastructure is healthy, stable, secure, documented, and configured with accepted technical best practices

Perform recurring operational-risk reviews and identify opportunities to improve platform stability, supportability, monitoring coverage, security posture, automation, and service consistency  

Support annual architecture, capacity, lifecycle, and standard-operating-procedure reviews, and provide technical inputs for quarterly business reviews or other strategic client reviews  
Own the technical execution of assigned client onboarding and offboarding activities, including access validation, monitoring coverage, vendor access, initial documentation, known-issue identification, and EoS/EoL review  
* Provide clear technical context, risk, impact, dependencies, recommended actions, and next steps to Client Success Managers and customer technical contacts. Business-impacting or scope-related customer communications should be coordinated through the appropriate Client Success Manager

* Participate in 24x7 operations and the on-call rotation, including major incidents and planned maintenance activities as scheduled

Complete training and certification as assigned to further skills and knowledge  

* Mentor L2 engineers, improve escalation quality, review technical work when assigned, and contribute to standards, runbooks, knowledge articles, training, and continuous-improvement initiatives

### **Qualifications/ Technology Experience**

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Unique education, specialized experience, skills, knowledge, training, or certification may be substituted)  

* 10+ yrs of experience with virtualization technologies and enterprise infrastructure operations
* + Experience with VMware vSphere/VVF required
  + Experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) required
  + Experience with Nutanix AHV required
  + Experience with Microsoft Hyper-V preferred
  Experience with Red Hat OpenShift Virtualization, including virtual-machine lifecycle management, networking, storage integration, and operational troubleshooting
* 5+ years of hands-on experience with VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF) deployment, configuration, lifecycle management, and operational support
* + Proficiency in VCF lifecycle management, including automated deployment, patching, and upgrades using SDDC Manager
  + Experience with VCF workload domains, including VI workload domains and NSX-T network virtualization
  + Knowledge of VCF validated designs and reference architectures for hybrid-cloud implementations
  + Experience with VCF integration with public-cloud services (VMware Cloud on AWS, Azure VMware Solution, Google Cloud VMware Engine) preferred
  + Experience with VCF's automated deployment and configuration of vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and vRealize Suite or Aria components
  Demonstrated ability to manage converged infrastructure through VCF's unified platform spanning compute, storage, networking, and security
10+ yrs of experience with operational administration of enterprise IT systems  
10+ yrs of experience with performance and infrastructure monitoring tools (LogicMonitor, Elastic, or comparable platforms)  
5+ yrs of experience with an enterprise ITSM system. ServiceNow preferred  
* Experience with Cisco UCS and Dell hardware systems required
Familiarity with Dell PowerFlex/PowerStore/VxRail preferred  
* Operating System skills with Windows and Linux preferred
Understanding of PowerShell and PowerCLI with ability to create and utilize scripts for administration, troubleshooting, reporting, and automation required  
Managed Services or consulting experience required  
VMware Certified Professional certification required; VMware Certified Advanced Professional certification preferred  
* ITILv4 certification preferred

### **Qualifications: Soft Skills**

Advanced technical troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities  

* Approach projects, changes, and problems with a “security first” mindset

Superior customer service and training skills  

* Possess a strong sense of urgency and ability to set priorities during normal operations and high-impact events

Ability to work without direct supervision and make sound technical decisions  

Team-oriented collaborator willing to share knowledge and experience  
Ability to communicate technical risk, business impact, dependencies, decisions, and recommended actions clearly to engineers, managers, CSMs, vendors, and customer technical stakeholders  
Ability to remain accountable for coordination and follow-through until the next owner formally accepts an escalation  
* Ability to balance customer requests with platform capacity, resiliency, security, contractual scope, change control, and operational risk

Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills and ability to build and maintain collaborative and positive working relationships at all levels  

Ability to effectively interact with all levels of business via phone, written communication, and in person  
Skilled in achieving results in a customer centric environment  
* Self-motivated, able to work in a fast-paced 24x7 managed-services environment

**Why AHEAD:**

Through our daily work and internal groups like Moving Women AHEAD and RISE AHEAD, we value and benefit from diversity of people, ideas, experience, and everything in between.

We fuel growth by stacking our office with top-notch technologies in a multi-million-dollar lab, by encouraging cross department training and development, sponsoring certifications and credentials for continued learning.

**India Employment Benefits include:**

**Comprehensive health insurance** coverage for employees, with options to extend coverage to dependents

**Paid time off and company holidays**, along with additional leave benefits as per policy

**Flexible work arrangements**, supporting work-life balance

**Learning and development opportunities** to support continuous growth and upskilling

**Employee wellness initiatives** and programs focused on physical and mental well-being

**Retirement and statutory benefits** in line with India regulations

**Inclusive and people-first culture**, with a strong focus on collaboration and ownership

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Principal Engineer- High-Performance Computing
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a Principal Engineer

**In this role, you will:**

* Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence applications, network, information security, database, operating systems, or web technologies for highly complex business and technical needs across multiple groups
* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Translate advanced technology experience, an in-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions
* Provide vision, direction and expertise to leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions
* Maintain knowledge of industry best practices and new technologies and recommends innovations that enhance operations or provide a competitive advantage to the organization
* Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership

**Required Qualifications:**

  

* 7+ years of Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

  

* 7+ years building distributed systems and platforms.
* Deep expertise in distributed computing (Kubernetes, Spark, Ray, Dask, distributed schedulers, HPC, large-scale data platforms).
* Strong CUDA/GPU programming experience, including performance tuning and GPU orchestration.
* Experience with cloud-native platforms (Azure preferred), containers, orchestration, and infrastructure automation.
* Demonstrated principal-level influence with the ability to define technology strategy and drive adoption across multiple engineering organizations.

**Job Expectations:**

* **Architect and build large-scale distributed computing platforms** that power model development, training, execution, and risk analytics workloads across cloud and hybrid environments, delivering high performance, resiliency, scalability, and operational excellence.
* **Lead GPU-accelerated computing strategy** by designing and optimizing CUDA-based workloads, distributed GPU scheduling, high-performance data processing, and model execution frameworks to maximize utilization and reduce compute costs.
* **Drive technical direction for PyFARM and related model platforms**, establishing architecture standards, platform patterns, observability, reliability engineering practices, and long-term roadmaps for model risk and quantitative analytics ecosystems.
* **Partner with quantitative researchers, model developers, data scientists, and platform engineering teams** to enable secure, governed, and efficient execution of large-scale machine learning, simulation, and analytical workloads while ensuring regulatory and risk-management requirements are met.
* **Serve as a technical leader and multiplier across the organization**, mentoring senior engineers, leading critical design reviews, influencing enterprise architecture decisions, and driving innovation in distributed systems, high-performance computing, AI infrastructure, and data-intensive platforms.

29 Oct 2026

* ***Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.***

There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

title: Software Quality Engineer (SQE) – Semiconductor Equipment
description:
**Job Requirements**  

At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for an experienced Software Quality Engineer (SQE) with expertise in Semiconductor Equipment Software to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of equipment automation solutions.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in test strategy, automation, semiconductor communication standards, and working closely with global engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Define and execute comprehensive test strategies for semiconductor equipment software applications.
* Design, develop, and maintain automated and manual test frameworks.
* Validate equipment software functionality, communication protocols, and factory automation workflows.
* Collaborate with Software Architects, Developers, Product Owners, and Program Managers to ensure quality throughout the SDLC.
* Review requirements, identify test scenarios, and develop detailed test plans and test cases.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.
* Validate equipment communication using SECS/GEM and GEM300 standards.
* Identify, track, and drive resolution of software defects while performing root cause analysis.
* Participate in customer acceptance testing (FAT/SAT) and production release validation.
* Drive quality metrics, continuous improvement initiatives, and process compliance.
* Mentor junior QA engineers and promote quality engineering best practices

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day. Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.

We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Capability to leverage artificial intelligence and AI tools to enhance data analysis, uncover business trends, and provide actionable insights for strategic decision-making.
* Advanced proficiency in implementing automation solutions to streamline business processes and improve operational efficiency.

description:

Vocera now a part of Stryker is looking for Senior Technical R&D Manager is sought to lead the Embedded OS and UX team responsible for creating dependable, intuitive, and maintainable device platforms. This role combines people leadership with technical direction across Yocto Linux and/or Android OS, board support packages, system services, device integration, and user experience. The manager will guide a multidisciplinary team through architecture, development, validation, release, and sustainment, partnering across product, hardware, quality, security, and operations to deliver high-quality embedded products.

Success in this role means establishing technical clarity, raising engineering quality, and shipping platform capabilities that are scalable, secure, testable, and intuitive for the people who use them.

**What You Will Do**

**Technical / Managerial Responsibilities**

  

* Lead the design and implementation of embedded OS platform architecture using Yocto Linux and/or Android OS, aligning platform choices with product, hardware, security, and UX goals.

  

* Own the team roadmap, architectural direction, technical debt strategy, and delivery plans for platform, middleware, device integration, and embedded UX capabilities.

  

* Provide technical leadership across board support packages, bootloaders, Linux kernel configuration, device drivers, hardware abstraction layers, system services, and application frameworks.

  

* Partner with Product, UX, Hardware, Systems, Quality, and Security teams to translate customer workflows into coherent, responsive, and accessible device experiences.

  

* Establish reproducible build and release practices, including source control, code review, continuous integration, automated validation, artifact traceability, and release governance.

  

* Strengthen product quality through unit, integration, system, performance, reliability, hardware-in-the-loop, and end-to-end testing across target devices.

  

* Guide secure platform engineering, including secure boot, signed software, permissions, vulnerability remediation, SBOM practices, and over-the-air update strategies.

  

* Work closely with Release Engineering and DevOps teams to ensure the smooth operation of build, test, packaging, deployment, and sustaining-engineering workflows.

  

* Drive functional excellence initiatives, deliver high-quality R&D functional deliverables, and ensure technical excellence for product or technology development. Drive technical projects of major magnitude and scope.

  

* Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies, applying this knowledge to continuously improve embedded platform architecture, development practices, and UX quality.

  

* Act as a performance coach by providing actionable feedback, setting clear objectives, developing technical talent, and building an inclusive, accountable engineering culture.

  

* Communicate plans, risks, trade-offs, and technical information clearly to team members and business stakeholders, supporting decisions with evidence and sound engineering judgment.

**What You Will Need**

**Technical Skills**

  

* Strong experience building and shipping embedded Linux and/or Android-based products, with a practical understanding of OS architecture, system startup, resource management, and device lifecycle.

  

* Hands-on expertise with the Yocto Project, including custom layers, recipes, image generation, SDKs, reproducible builds, package management, and distro or machine configuration.

  

* Experience with Android OS or AOSP, including the Android build system, framework services, HALs, permissions, system applications, OTA updates, and platform customization.

  

* Proficiency in modern C/C++ and scripting with Python and shell; familiarity with Java or Kotlin for Android platform and application integration is a plus.

  

* Deep understanding of BSP development, U-Boot or other bootloaders, Linux kernel configuration, device drivers, middleware, and hardware abstraction layers.

  

* Experience with embedded UX technologies such as Android UI, Qt/QML, Wayland/Weston, or comparable frameworks, including performance, responsiveness, and accessibility considerations.

  

* Working knowledge of hardware and connectivity interfaces such as I2C, SPI, UART, USB, Ethernet, CAN, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, and display or input subsystems.

  

* Strong debugging and profiling skills using tools such as GDB, perf, ftrace, kernel logs, logcat, crash dumps, tracing, and system observability tooling.

  

* Experience with CI/CD and engineering tools such as Git, Gerrit, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, or similar technologies.

  

* Understanding of embedded security, secure boot, code signing, key management, vulnerability response, SBOMs, and long-term product maintenance.

  

* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop creative, evidence-based solutions.

  

* Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in Agile, cross-functional, and geographically distributed development environments.

**Leadership Experience**

  

* Talented performance coach who is skilled at providing actionable feedback to team members, setting clear performance objectives, and managing team member performance.

  

* Experience executing a talent and performance-management strategy, including hiring, onboarding, development planning, succession planning, and organizational health.

  

* Demonstrated ability to communicate plans and technical information to team members and stakeholders within a business unit.

  

* Proven ability to deliver programs or other business goals on time, on quality, and within budget while managing scope, risk, dependencies, and trade-offs.

  

* Ability to balance hands-on technical depth with thoughtful delegation, coaching, and long-term team capability building.

**Education & Experience**

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field required; master's degree in a related field preferred.

  

* 15+ years of applicable experience, with 6+ years of direct people-management experience preferred.

  

* A strong level of understanding and experience in one's technical or functional disciplines, with the ability to mentor others and raise the engineering bar.

Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with its customers, is driven to make healthcare better. The company offers innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology, Orthopaedics and Spine that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside its customers around the world, Stryker impacts more than 150 million patients annually.

title: Front Office Executive
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Job Description – Front Desk Executive
  
  
**Position:** Front Desk Executive
  
**Department:** Facilities / Workplace Experience
  
**Reporting To:** Facilities Manager / Account manager
  
  
**Role Purpose:**  
The Front Desk Executive is responsible for delivering an outstanding workplace and visitor experience by managing front desk operations, coordinating service requests, supporting workplace administration, and ensuring seamless communication between employees, visitors, vendors, and internal stakeholders. The role requires a proactive, customer-focused professional with strong coordination skills and experience in corporate office environments.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Front Desk & Workplace Experience
  
Serve as the first point of contact for employees, visitors, clients, and guests, ensuring a professional and welcoming experience.
  
Manage reception operations, visitor registration, access management, and guest facilitation in compliance with security protocols.
  
Handle employee and visitor queries promptly, professionally, and efficiently.
  
Maintain high standards of customer service and represent the organization's values and workplace culture.
  
Service Ticket Management
  
Manage and monitor workplace-related service requests through ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow.
  
Track, coordinate, and follow up on service tickets to ensure timely resolution within defined service levels.
  
Liaise with internal functions and service partners to address facility, housekeeping, maintenance, engineering, security, and workplace-related concerns.
  
Maintain service records, prepare operational reports, and escalate critical issues as required.
  
Meeting Room & Executive Support
  
Coordinate meeting room bookings and ensure readiness of meeting spaces.
  
Arrange and monitor support services, including audio-visual equipment, seating arrangements, and meeting requirements.
  
Support leadership visits, business meetings, and workplace engagement activities.
  
  
Safety, Compliance & Incident Management
  
Adhere to and promote workplace safety, security, and compliance standards.
  
Report, track, and escalate incidents, service disruptions, and operational concerns in a timely manner.
  
Support audits, inspections, and compliance-related activities.
  
Ensure compliance with organizational policies and established workplace procedures.
  
Continuous Improvement
  
Identify opportunities to enhance workplace services and operational efficiency.
  
Support implementation of best practices and process improvements.
  
Contribute to initiatives focused on improving employee, visitor, and client experience.
  
Required Skills & Competencies
  
Excellent customer service and front office management skills.
  
Strong verbal and written communication abilities.
  
Effective stakeholder, vendor, and customer relationship management.
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced corporate environment.
  
Strong problem-solving, coordination, and organizational skills.
  
High level of professionalism, attention to detail, and service orientation.
  
Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
  
Technical Knowledge
  
Hands-on experience with ServiceNow or other service ticketing/helpdesk platforms.
  
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook).
  
Knowledge of meeting room booking and visitor management systems.
  
Understanding of corporate workplace and facilities management processes.
  
Experience & Qualifications
  
Graduate in any discipline.
  
Preference will be given to candidates with a Hotel Management degree/diploma specializing in Front Office Operations.
  
Minimum 5 years of experience in Front Office Operations, Workplace Experience, Facilities Management, Hospitality, or Customer Service within a corporate office environment.
  
Proven experience in managing service tickets, stakeholder coordination, visitor management, and workplace operations.
  
Experience in handling leadership interactions and executive-facing workplace services will be an added advantage.
  
  
**Key Attributes:** Customer-centric mindset, excellent presentation skills, strong interpersonal abilities, and the capability to deliver a seamless workplace experience in a corporate setting.
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

---------------

Amazon is looking for AVS Manager in Retail Business Services (RBS). AVS Manager at RBS leads Product Family/ Marketplace and manages a large group of strategic vendors through a team of Team Leads and Account Managers.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
As AVS Manager for Amazon Vendor Services, you will be responsible to deliver impact to a large group of strategic vendors, both directly and through a team of Team Leads/Account Managers reporting to you. Your priority will be to deliver on our commitment to help vendors improve their performance across key retail metrics, ensure their satisfaction with the service and continuously improve the productivity of your team. You will work in close collaboration with Vendor Managers, Retail Category leads and in-country AVS Product Family owners to understand your vendors’ needs and define the right goals and targets. You will be expected to contribute to continuous enhancements and innovation within the service.
  
The candidate will be a business owner who understands the key levers to drive business growth and can operationalize those levers across their team. Further, the candidate thrives in an ambiguous environment where they must develop, implement and iterate data, processes, mechanisms and guardrails to improve the customer experience. They have a passion for people leadership and are at their best when they’re building, developing and managing high-performing teams. You will lead the team of Managers that looks into strategic and operational aspects of vendors business with Amazon.  
  
A day in the life  
Managing a team of Managers, prioritizing strategic initiatives and provide escalation support as needed. Success will be measured by the performance of your internal teams on input metrics and impact of vendors on creating a great customer experience. Identify, action and/or provide advice on how to improve business input metrics that drive growth and improve end customer experience, in collaboration with other Amazon programs and teams. Act as a thought leader in defining success criteria and understand business needs of Selling Partners in an ever-changing business environment. Contributes to and leads strategic plans and documents for the organization.
  
  
About the team  
Amazon Vendor Services are a suite of services designed to help Amazon's most strategic vendors grow and deliver the best customer experience by working across all key retail levers (e.g. selection, availability, operational efficiency, catalog quality, and marketing). The service is delivered primarily through Account Managers assigned to specific vendors. Amazon has an ambitious vision for the future of this service, focusing on business impact for vendors and the categories, operational scalability and vendor satisfaction.

------------------------

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
* Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Experience using analytical, account management, and productivity tools, such as, Oracle Business Intelligence, SalesForce, Tableau, or similar
* Experience with Doubleclick (XSM, DFP), AdJuster or Salesforce
* MBA
* Demonstrated success managing a team with a track record of developing a high performing team.
* 10+ years’ experience in customer/ account management, marketing, buying, or customer service delivery in related industries like retail, telecom, technology or hospitality. Min 6 years of people management experience
* Experience using analysis, reporting, modeling, and forecasting to gather data for the purpose of making business decisions
* Organizational skills including prioritizing, scheduling, time management, and meeting deadlines.
* Written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in creating Annual Operating plans and P&L impact

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 5+ years of hiring and retaining digital advertising teams experience
* Experience with annual brand and media planning
* Experience managing large cross-functional teams
* E-Commerce experience preferred
* Program management experience

title: Technology Manager
description:
**About Revolut**

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. **About the role**

Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to make sure our IT changes and tech ecosystem are safe and well-managed. You'll be working closely with our Operations and Product teams to keep projects on track. We need a brilliant problem solver who's passionate about IT systems and networks.

title: Payroll-Apprentice

title: PM - Financial Disputes, RBS SPEG
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

RBS SPEG UDE team is looking for Sr. Program Manager to drive defect elimination for WW Retail under Financial Disputes program. In this role, you will be expected to partner with upstream tech and retail teams to drive automation and efficiency. This role will closely work with senior leadership team in Retail WW to drive upstream defect elimination and delivering on business KPI's. Key success factors for this role will be performance on Business goals, Vendor and Customer Experience and Cost of operations.
  
  
Candidate Profile  
Candidate will have 3+ years of experience in Vendor Management and Retail Operations. Additionally, you will have program management skills with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders and drive project execution. Lastly, you will be expected to deliver solutions and programs that are technology based, highly scalable - while maintaining a good customer and business partner focus.
  
  
You will have a demonstrated record of leading projects not only at the strategic level, but also tactically by diving deeply into business and technical domains. This requires a person that is very metrics driven, yet has the vision to scale the business. The individual would be responsible for overall planning, budgeting, growth, delivery and productivity of the program. The individual would have targets on elimination of defects causing downstream payment issues for vendors. Would engage with central product and program teams and build customer confidence through quality delivery, robust processes and sound reporting metrics.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
1) Lead high-impact UDE projects in cost optimization and revenue generation by identifying systemic defects, influencing upstream team roadmaps, and driving cross-organizational alignment.  
2) Establish comprehensive governance frameworks for UDE programs, including pipeline development, quality controls, and executive reporting mechanisms.  
3) Partner with senior leaders across multiple VP organizations to secure bandwidth and prioritize defect elimination over reactive fixes.  
4) Drive SPCtS goals through strategic UDE implementation, building robust pipelines that exceed targets while maintaining rigorous quality standards.  
  
Candidate Profile:  
Core Competencies:  
Strategic Vision & Execution - Demonstrates ability to identify opportunities, build comprehensive pipelines, and exceed ambitious targets. Translates complex technical problems into executive-level strategic narratives that secure leadership buy-in across multiple VP organizations.  
Cross-Functional Partnership - Proven track record partnering with senior leaders across multiple VP organizations to influence roadmaps without direct authority. Builds trust through data-driven insights and vendor advocacy, converting bottom-line initiatives to top-line priorities.  
Program Governance Excellence - Establishes scalable frameworks including quality controls, standardized methodologies, and executive reporting mechanisms. Maintains rigorous oversight of 30+ concurrent initiatives while driving accountability through structured reviews and clear escalation paths.  
Financial Acumen - Quantifies complex business impacts across COI, iGMS, VCtS, and HC savings with Data Science’s & finance validation. Secures pre-approvals and entitlement sign-offs through systematic methodology alignment with RBS Finance and Data Sciences teams.  
Technical Problem-Solving - Conducts root cause analysis on systemic defects, designs upstream solutions, and drives end-to-end implementation across legacy systems. Navigates technical complexities while managing engineering dependencies and resource constraints.  
Stakeholder Management - Orchestrates workshops with 10+ cross-functional teams, presents strategic documents to retail leaders, and maintains regular engagement with senior stakeholders. Translates technical details into business outcomes for executive audiences.  
What makes this candidate exceptional: They combine strategic thinking with execution rigor, influence without authority, and scale solutions from marketplace-specific pilots to worldwide implementations, all while maintaining the highest quality standards and exceeding every measurable goal.
  
  
About the team  
About Amazon.com  
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.  
  
The Retail Business Systems (RBS) group is an integral part of Amazon online product lifecycle and buying operations. RBS’ vision is to accelerate Amazon’s flywheel by fixing catalog defects and scale critical store operations function by standardization, automation and defect elimination through its selection, defect elimination, product, tech and paid selling partner support operations pillars (PSPS/AVS). The tasks handled by this group have a direct impact on Retail Cost to serve, customer buying decisions and vendor experience. This role is within Retail Efficiency program that supports both AVS and non-AVS Tier 1 vendors through providing business operations services.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

title: Enterprise Account Manager (B2B, SaaS)
description:
Founded in 2016, Katalon is the category leader in AI-augmented software testing, empowering hybrid testers—those blending manual, automation, and AI skills—to deliver exceptional digital experiences. Katalon enables software teams of any size to deliver world-class customer experiences faster, easier, and more efficiently.

Since its first launch, Katalon has experienced tremendous growth, serving more than 30,000 teams across 80+ countries, many of which are in the Fortune Global 500. Katalon has been named a G2 Leader in software testing for 11 consecutive quarters and a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years.

#### **About the role**

As a Enterprise Account Manager, you own a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts in Southeast Asia and Oceania, with responsibility for new business, expansion and renewals. You are the single point of accountability for your accounts, aligning internal teams and partners around a shared account plan.

#### **Key responsibilities**

* Own revenue for a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, delivering an annual quota across new business, expansion and renewals.
* Build account strategies tied to each customer's software quality goals, and orchestrate a cross-functional account team (Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Management, partners) to execute them.
* Land new logos and expand into new business units, geographies and use cases within existing accounts.
* Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles: build value-based business cases and negotiate enterprise agreements with procurement and legal.
* Build trusted relationships with executive sponsors and run business reviews.
* Protect and grow recurring revenue through proactive renewal management, upsell and cross-sell.
* Maintain accurate pipeline and forecasts in Salesforce.

#### **Job Requirements**

* 6+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, including 3+ years managing strategic enterprise accounts with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota.
* Proven success both landing new enterprise logos and growing existing accounts through renewal and expansion.
* Track record of closing large, complex enterprise deals with long sales cycles, multiple stakeholders, and procurement and legal negotiation.
* Ability to orchestrate cross-functional teams around an account plan, without direct authority.
* Executive presence and strong communication, with experience engaging C-level stakeholders.
* Disciplined pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce.

#### **Preferred Experience**

* Experience selling DevOps, QA or developer platforms to enterprise engineering organizations.
* Experience co-selling with resellers, system integrators or channel partners in Southeast Asia or Oceania.
* An established network of enterprise relationships in the region, especially in banking, financial services or telco.

#### **Job Benefit**

At Katalon, we bring together self-starting, open-minded, and talented people while actively promoting a transparent and growth-enabling working environment. But don’t just take our word for it. Take a better look below!

* **Attractive Compensation Package:** Either embrace periodic and compelling performance bonuses, OR an uncapped sales commission scheme, spiffs, and accelerators for Sales positions;

* **Everything You Need to Succeed:** Work with top-of-the-line equipment and enjoy modern facilities, plus helpful allowances to support your work setup.
* **A Place Where You Belong:** Join our worldwide family where we celebrate what makes each of us unique. Here, everyone has a voice and equal opportunities to shine.

title: Cloud Solution Architecture IC5
description:

With more than 45,000 employees and partners worldwide, the Customer Experience and Success (CE&S) organization is on a mission to empower customers to accelerate business value through differentiated customer experiences that leverage Microsoft’s products and services, ignited by our people and culture. We drive cross-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in-product, digital, or human-centered. CE&S is responsible for all up services across the company, including consulting, customer success, and support across Microsoft’s portfolio of solutions and products. Join CE&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.

The Customer & Commercial Success (CCS) organization, an organization within MCAPS-Core, is the connected engine that turns Microsoft’s commercial strategy into execution at scale — making it simpler and faster for the field to win for every customer, in every segment, region, and role. The organization brings together planning, landing, execution excellence, services portfolio and delivery, and field activation across ATU, STU, and CSU to accelerate customer value, drive growth, and strengthen the end-to-end experience across every customer moment.

The Customer & Commercial Success Architect’s Office is seeking a Cloud Solution Architect with a passion for customer and partner success. In this role, you will focus on driving adoption of Databricks solutions on the Microsoft platform, partnering with Databricks and customers to help them achieve business outcomes from their Microsoft technology investments.  
Using deep technical expertise across Databricks solutions and Microsoft Azure Data, Infrastructure, and AI services, you will lead partner and customer technical discussions, resolve blockers that affect customer success projects, and accelerate consumption. You will collaborate with Cloud Solution Architects, Customer Success Account Managers, Engineering, and Partner Development teams to drive measurable customer and partner outcomes. This role offers an opportunity to strengthen your technical leadership, expand your cloud expertise, and accelerate your career growth.  
  
This role is ideal for a technically credible, customer-focused architect who can connect Databricks capabilities with Microsoft Azure platform strengths to accelerate adoption, remove technical blockers, and deliver measurable customer and partner outcomes.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

Customer and partner success  

* Serve as a trusted technical advisor to Databricks, customers, and partners, helping them realize business value from their investments in Microsoft Azure and Databricks.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical strategy discussions, proof-of-concepts, and production deployments to accelerate adoption of data, analytics, AI, and modernization solutions.
* Guide customers and partners in implementing best practices for security, governance, reliability, performance, and operational excellence.
* Identify and resolve technical blockers that impact solution deployment, scalability, adoption, or customer success outcomes.

Solution architecture and technical leadership  

* Design, validate, and optimize enterprise-scale architectures leveraging Databricks, Azure Data Services, AI Services, and cloud-native technologies.
* Drive technical assessments, workload modernization initiatives, and architectural reviews for strategic customer and partner engagements.
* Develop reusable intellectual property (IP), reference architectures, technical guidance, and deployment accelerators that improve solution scalability and repeatability.
* Influence technology roadmaps and platform decisions by providing architectural leadership and industry expertise.

Partner ecosystem and industry leadership  

* Collaborate with Databricks, Microsoft Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, Product, and Partner teams to drive successful customer outcomes and adoption at scale.
* Lead virtual teams to address complex technical challenges and deliver cross-functional solutions.
* Represent Microsoft and Databricks in customer engagements, industry events, technical communities, and field enablement activities.
* Share customer and partner insights with Product and Engineering teams to influence product strategy and drive continuous improvement.

Consumption and business growth  

* Drive Azure consumption, Databricks adoption, and customer success metrics across assigned accounts and partner engagements.
* Help partners develop and scale differentiated solutions and services that create customer value and accelerate cloud adoption.
* Collaborate with partner technical and sales teams to identify growth opportunities and expand the adoption of Microsoft Data, Analytics, and AI solutions.

Continuous learning and innovation  

* Maintain deep expertise in Databricks, Azure, Data & AI technologies, industry trends, and competitive offerings.
* Demonstrate a growth mindset through continuous learning, technical skilling, and knowledge sharing.
* Contribute to Microsoft and Databricks thought leadership through technical insights, customer success stories, and best-practice development.

 **Qualifications**

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 7+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.

Additional Required Qualifications:
