* 6+ years experience leading technical projects.
* Deep expertise in Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and modern Data & AI platforms, including data engineering, analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI workloads.
* Proven experience designing, architecting, and deploying enterprise-scale cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure, including Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure AI Services, and Azure Machine Learning.
* Strong background in building and modernizing data platforms, including data lakes, data warehouses, streaming architectures, and advanced analytics environments.
* Demonstrated success in customer-facing architecture, consulting, technical sales, customer success, or solution delivery roles, supporting complex enterprise transformations.

* Experience influencing and engaging with executive stakeholders, technical decision-makers, architects, and engineering teams to drive strategic outcomes.
* Deep understanding of digital transformation trends, cloud platforms, and emerging Data & AI technologies, with the ability to translate technology capabilities into business value.
* Proven ability to lead the design, implementation, modernization, or support of large-scale distributed applications, data platforms, and analytics solutions.

* Databricks

title: Principal Engineer -Data Engineering
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo is seeking a highly motivated Principal Engineer to design, architect, and lead Data Engineering initiatives within the HR Information Technology organization. This role requires a hands‑on technologist who can anchor critical initiatives to drive operational excellence and enhance employee and customer experience.

The Principal Engineer will provide technical leadership across the design, development, and operationalization of Data and Generative AI solutions, while shaping the enterprise HR data strategy. This role will oversee the architecture and delivery of scalable, secure, and resilient data engineering solutions across the HR data ecosystem, enabling advanced analytics, AI‑driven insights, and next‑generation HR capabilities. The Principal Engineer will also act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, influencing architecture decisions, solution design, and implementation strategies to ensure alignment with business objectives, enterprise standards, and long‑term technology strategy.

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking
* Translate advanced technology experience, an in-depth knowledge of the organizations tactical and strategic business objectives, the enterprise technological environment, the organization structure, and strategic technological opportunities and requirements into technical engineering solutions

title: Assistant Manager - Customer Support
description:
Send your CV to alka@propertyangel.in or hr@propertyangel.in. Please mention the position in the subject line.

  

### **Assistant Manager - Customer Support**

Experience 5-8 years

#### **Role Overview**

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Customer Support Manager will be responsible for delivering a responsive, transparent and reliable experience to PropertyAngel’s property owners and tenants.

The role involves managing the customer-support team, monitoring service requests and escalations, coordinating with internal teams, and ensuring that every customer receives timely updates and effective resolution. The manager will also use support data and customer feedback to identify recurring problems and improve processes across the organisation.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Customer Support Management**

* Manage the day-to-day functioning of the customer-support team.
  
* Ensure that customer queries received through calls, email, WhatsApp, Freshdesk and other channels are acknowledged and resolved within defined timelines.
  
* Monitor open, pending and overdue tickets.
  
* Ensure that every interaction is professional, empathetic and solution-oriented.
  
* Maintain clear ownership of each customer request until final closure.

### **2. Escalation Management**

* Take ownership of complex or sensitive owner and tenant escalations.
  
* Investigate complaints, understand the root cause and coordinate with the appropriate internal teams for resolution.
  
* Communicate difficult decisions clearly and respectfully.
  
* Ensure that customers receive regular updates even when an immediate solution is not available.
  
* Escalate high-risk matters to senior management when required.

### **3. Team Leadership**

* Lead, train and motivate customer-support executives.
  
* Allocate work and monitor individual workloads and performance.
  
* Conduct regular ticket reviews, coaching sessions and quality audits.
  
* Train the team in communication, conflict management, empathy, documentation and PropertyAngel’s service standards.
  
* Create a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement.

### **4. Cross-functional Coordination**

* Coordinate with Operations, Accounts, Leasing, Maintenance, Inspections and Relationship Management teams.
  
* Follow up with internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer requests.
  
* Identify gaps in interdepartmental handovers and recommend better workflows.
  
* Ensure that information provided to customers is accurate and consistent across teams.

### **5. Systems and Process Management**

* Ensure proper use of Freshdesk or other customer-support systems.
  
* Establish clear ticket categories, priorities, escalation levels and service-level timelines.
  
* Maintain accurate customer histories, notes and resolution records.
  
* Develop and update standard operating procedures, response templates and escalation matrices.
  
* Identify opportunities to automate routine queries without compromising the quality of customer service.

### **6. Reporting and Service Improvement**

* Prepare weekly and monthly reports covering:
  
* + Ticket volumes and categories
    
  + First-response and resolution times
    
  + Pending and ageing tickets
    
  + Reopened tickets
    
  + Escalations and recurring complaints
    
  + Customer satisfaction
    
  + Team productivity and quality scores
  
* Analyse support data to identify recurring issues and their root causes.
  
* Work with management to implement corrective and preventive actions.
  
* Track whether process improvements have reduced complaints and improved turnaround time.
  
* Represent the voice of the customer in internal discussions.

**Key Performance Indicators**
------------------------------

* First-response time
  
* Average resolution time
  
* Percentage of tickets resolved within SLA
  
* Number and ageing of pending tickets
  
* Reopened-ticket rate
  
* Customer satisfaction score
  
* Number of escalations
  
* Quality and completeness of ticket documentation
  
* Reduction in recurring complaints
  
* Team productivity and adherence to processes

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------

* Graduate degree in any discipline.
  
* Approximately 5–8 years of experience in customer service, customer success, operations or relationship management.
  
* At least 2 years of experience leading a customer-support team.
  
* Experience using Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, Zendesk or a similar ticket-management platform.
  
* Experience in property management, real estate, hospitality, banking or another service-oriented industry would be an advantage.

**Skills and Competencies**
---------------------------

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
* Excellent problem-solving and conflict-resolution ability.
  
* Empathy combined with firmness and sound judgement.
  
* Ability to remain calm while handling demanding or dissatisfied customers.
  
* Strong follow-up, coordination and organisational skills.
  
* Ability to interpret support data and convert it into practical improvements.
  
* Comfortable working with service-level targets and performance dashboards.
  
* High attention to detail and documentation.
  
* Ability to take ownership and work effectively across departments.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------

We are looking for someone who understands that excellent customer service is not limited to responding politely. It requires ownership, accurate information, proactive communication and reliable follow-through.

The ideal candidate will be able to balance the interests of property owners, tenants and the company while ensuring that commitments are realistic and consistently fulfilled.

  

CTC: 5,00,000 - 7,00,000 /Year.

  

#### **Requirements & Skills**

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
------------------------------------------

* Graduate degree in any discipline.
  
* Approximately 5–8 years of experience in customer service, customer success, operations or relationship management.
  
* At least 2 years of experience leading a customer-support team.
  
* Experience using Freshdesk, Zoho Desk, Zendesk or a similar ticket-management platform.
  
* Experience in property management, real estate, hospitality, banking or another service-oriented industry would be an advantage.

description:

title: Senior Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Every minute of every day, Smiths Detection’s threat detection and security screening technology helps to protect people and infrastructure, making the world a safer place.

Smiths Detection, part of Smiths Group is a global leader in the development, manufacture and management of security and detection solutions designed to make the world a safer place. Our technology provides threat detection and screening solutions for customers in our key markets: aviation, ports and borders, defence, and urban security.

Our expertise spans 21 global offices, seven manufacturing sites and five R&D centres, with a global network of 3,000 dedicated colleagues contributing towards over 40 years at the frontline of advances in safety and security.

This results in careers built on variety and the opportunity to work on a range of state-of-the-art solutions, where you can develop your knowledge and experience every day.

 **Job Description**

**Duties:**

**Leadership, Mentorship & Cultural Awareness**

* Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of software developers, fostering professional growth and technical mastery.
* Conduct regular one-on-one sessions, performance reviews, and provide constructive feedback.
* Demonstrate strong communication, empathy, and active listening skills to build trust and cohesion within the team.
* Cultivate an inclusive environment that values diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and working styles.
* Promote psychological safety, encouraging open dialogue, respectful debate, and constructive feedback.
* Adapt leadership approaches to different cultural contexts, ensuring collaboration across global or cross-functional teams, with the ability to support the bridge between the markets (sales) teams and the industry (vertical) teams.

**Onboarding & Knowledge Transfer**

* Drive effective onboarding processes for new team members, ensuring they quickly gain the technical and domain knowledge needed to contribute successfully.

* Promote structured knowledge-sharing sessions, pair programming, and cross-training to reduce single points of failure and build resilience within the team.
* Foster a culture where expertise is openly shared, enabling smooth transitions when responsibilities shift and ensuring continuity across projects.
* Leads and develops employees through strong influential skills & using a performance management and development process that provides an overall context and framework to engage employee contribution with goal setting, feedback, and performance development planning.
* Collaborate with Human Resources to build and develop capabilities, reduce ‘single points of excellence’, depth, and diverse team to deliver against the product and technical roadmaps.
* Collaborate closely with other Digital Senior Engineering Managers within the Portfolio, but across the other Portfolios to foster knowledge sharing, harmonize ways of working, leverage engineering capabilities effectively, and strengthen organizational resilience and increasing cross-functional collaboration.
* Leverage resource capacity including assignments, training, leave management, telecommuting and administers continuous performance review program to ensure effectiveness, compliance, and equity within the organization.

**Technical Ownership & Project Delivery**

* Provide technical leadership for the design, development, validation, and deployment of AI and computer vision solutions, ensuring alignment with product strategy, system architecture, and business objectives.
* Apply a strong technical background in computer vision, machine learning, and deep learning to guide architectural decisions, evaluate technical approaches, and support the team in solving complex engineering challenges.
* Ensure high software engineering standards through sound architectural principles, coding guidelines, code reviews, automated testing, documentation, and maintainable software design.
* Maintain sufficient hands-on technical expertise to effectively lead teams developing in Python and C/C++ within Linux environments, including Bash scripting, Git-based development workflows, and Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines.
* Own project planning and delivery in close collaboration with Program Managers, Product Managers, Product Owners, Architects, and other stakeholders. Define priorities, allocate work, manage dependencies and risks, remove blockers, and ensure reliable delivery against agreed commitments.
* Collaborate with Quality, Service, Systems Engineering, and product line teams to ensure product quality, operational readiness, lifecycle support, and the successful transfer of new digital technologies into the new product introduction process.
* Build and promote technical competencies across the organization while continuously improving development processes, engineering tools, CI/CD practices, and product lifecycle processes.

**Innovation & Continuous Improvement**

* Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Drive process adherence, improvements, automation, and efficiency within the team.
* Champion a culture of innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

**Troubleshooting & Problem Solving**

* Act as the escalation point for complex technical issues, guiding the team in diagnosing and resolving problems efficiently.
* Apply and teach structured problem-solving techniques to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
* Encourage a proactive mindset within the team, ensuring potential issues are anticipated and mitigated before they impact delivery.
* Balance short-term fixes with long-term improvements to maintain system stability and scalability.
* Think solutions rather than problems.

  
**Qualifications**

**Technical Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

**Education / Training**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience (5+ years) in software development, with at least 2 years in a leadership role.
* Proven matrix and stakeholder management skills/experience working virtually in diverse teams.
* Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies.
* Ability to balance technical depth with strategic leadership.
* Effective communication skills at all levels of the organization and collaborative abilities.
* Excellent communication skills particularly in English (fluently spoken and written), in addition to any local language spoken at the place of work.
* Significant progressive experience in product development and engineering. Prior experience with system integration and/or as an architect in multiple software/system projects.
* Knowledgeable in program management; hardware, software & product design development activities including advanced process & development technology.
* Understanding of technical challenges within key markets digital preferred.
* Effective communicator and leader, makes commitments and delivers on promises.
* Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures.
* Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
* Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
* A self-starter with the ability to manage your time effectively, keen attention to detail and use your own initiative

**Competencies and Abilities:**

**Execution focus and results-driven: The ability and motivation to persistently pursue and achieve effective results which drive the business forward.**

The understanding and recognition of the organisation’s commercial environment and positioning themselves, their role and their actions in order to support the organisation’s commercial success. The key measure of success will be the attainment of milestones and KPIs, on time and within budget, for each initiative overseen. This can be demonstrated by:

* Setting and communicating KPIs and targets.
* Adopting a routine planning and reporting to monitor implementation progress across various KPI targets.
* Executing in a disciplined and focused manner, keeping in mind the big picture.
* Prioritizing effectively to focus time and effort on issues of the highest importance and urgency.

**Additional Information**

Join us and we’ll help build your career, with excellent training and opportunities for career growth across the business, both locally and globally. You’ll experience an inclusive environment, with strong leadership and a focus on safety and wellbeing. You’ll also have the flexibility to choose from a wide range of benefits to suit your lifestyle, offering you and your family support from a health and wellbeing, financial and lifestyle perspective.

We believe that different perspectives and backgrounds are what make a company flourish. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment regardless of color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, economic status, disability, age, or any other legally protected characteristics. title: Product Director- MXDR
description:
**Director, MXDR Product**

**Level**

Director

  

**Function**

Product Engineering & Development — MXDR (Managed Extended Detection & Response)

  

**Experience**

15–20 years, including 5+ years leading a security or infrastructure product at scale

**Role Summary**
================

The Director, MXDR Product owns the MXDR product line end-to-end — strategy, roadmap, delivery, and outcomes. This person sits at the intersection of engineering, architecture, security operations, sales, and customer success, converting technical capability into a coherent product that customers trust and buy. They will partner closely with the Senior Architect (who continues to own technical architecture) while taking full ownership of product direction, delivery commitments, cross-functional alignment, and executive/customer communication.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Product Ownership & Strategy**
--------------------------------

* Own the MXDR product roadmap end-to-end — define priorities, sequence releases, and make explicit trade-off calls between customer asks, competitive pressure, and technical debt.
* Translate market and customer signal (win/loss reviews, analyst reports, competitive intelligence, compliance requirements like FedRAMP/SOC 2) into a defensible product strategy.
* Own the business case for major initiatives — cost, timeline, staffing, and expected outcome — before they go to engineering, closing the gap between "good architecture" and "fundable roadmap."

**Delivery Ownership**
----------------------

* Own delivery predictability: turn architecture and design work into resourced, sequenced, trackable delivery plans with realistic timelines.
* Run the cadence that keeps delivery visible — regular progress reviews, clear status reporting (RAG/roadmap-vs-actual), and early escalation of risk rather than late surprises.
* Partner with the Senior Architect and engineering leads to convert technical designs into shippable phases with clear acceptance criteria and success metrics.

**Stakeholder Management & Communication**
------------------------------------------

* Be the primary product point of contact for CTO, executive leadership, and key customers — comfortable presenting roadmap, risk, and trade-offs to non-technical and executive audiences.
* Manage the inevitable tension between sales commitments, customer requests, and engineering capacity — and be the one who says no, with a clear rationale, when needed.
* Build and maintain trust with cross-functional stakeholders (engineering, SOC/security operations, sales, marketing, customer success, compliance) so the product roadmap reflects real constraints from every side, not just engineering's.

**Ownership & Accountability**
------------------------------

* Take end-to-end accountability for product outcomes — not just what was designed or built, but what shipped, what customers adopted, and what moved the business forward.
* Proactively surface risk (technical, delivery, market, compliance) rather than waiting to be asked — and bring a recommended path forward, not just a problem.
* Own post-release outcomes: adoption, customer feedback, support burden, and whether the product delivered the value it was built for.

**Domain & Technical Fluency**
------------------------------

* Be fluent enough in MXDR/SOC concepts (detection engineering, threat hunting, SIEM/UEBA/ITDR, incident response workflows, MITRE ATT&CK) to have a credible technical conversation with architects, customers, and analysts — without needing to be the one designing the models.
* Understand the compliance and certification landscape relevant to security products (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001, GDPR) well enough to factor it into roadmap decisions early, not as an afterthought.
* Expertise in building AI based SDLC using AI tools.

**AI/ML, LLM, and Innovation Strategy**

* **GenAI & LLM Integration:** Design the architectural blueprint for embedding Generative AI and LLMs (via commercial APIs like OpenAI/Anthropic or open-source models like Llama/Mistral) into our existing products to deliver next-generation customer value.
* **Machine Learning Pipelines:** Leverage the **Python** ecosystem to oversee the creation of scalable ML data pipelines, MLOps frameworks, and predictive modeling features that enhance our application's intelligent capabilities.
* **Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG):** Architect advanced RAG systems combining **Elastic Stack (Elasticsearch as a vector database)** and SQL to enable high-performance, context-aware semantic search and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
* **AI Security & Governance:** Establish enterprise-wide compliance, data privacy (preventing PII leakage into LLMs), and ethical guardrails for AI usage, ensuring alignment with emerging global AI regulations.
* **Internal AI Automation:** Lead initiatives to leverage AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) and automated testing tools to improve overall engineering team velocity and code quality.

**Executive Technology Strategy & Enterprise Architecture**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* **Long-Term Technical Vision**: Define and execute a 3-to-5-year technology roadmap that scales with the company’s business growth, shifting engineering from a reactive delivery unit to a proactive business driver.
* **Polyglot Stack Governance:** Establish modern architectural guardrails and engineering standards for our composite ecosystem—ensuring seamless, secure integration between enterprise Angular frontends, distributed Python services, and high-performance .NET Web APIs.
* **Enterprise Data & Search Strategy:** Architect the future state of our data layer; guide principal engineers in optimizing high-transaction SQL databases (replication, partitioning) alongside massive Elastic Stack (ELK) clusters utilized for real-time search, analytics, and observability.
* **R&D and Innovation Leadership**: Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and AI/ML capabilities to determine their business viability, running targeted Proof-of-Concepts (PoCs) to maintain market competitiveness.
* **Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity:** Own the design and regular testing of global Disaster Recovery (DR) and High Availability (HA) strategies to guarantee maximum business continuity and strict uptime SLA compliance.

**What We're Looking For**
==========================

**Required**
------------

* 15–20 years total experience, with a meaningful portion in product development or product leadership roles for security, infrastructure, or SaaS platforms.
* 5+ years operating at Director level or equivalent scope — owning a product line's roadmap, delivery, and business outcomes, not just a feature area.
* Demonstrated track record of taking a product from architecture/vision to shipped, adopted reality — able to speak to specific products they've owned end-to-end.
* **Technical Breadth:** Previous hands-on architecture experience in enterprise Microsoft environments (.NET/C#) blended with open-source ecosystems (Python, Angular).
* Strong delivery discipline: experience running structured delivery cadences (roadmaps, sprint/release tracking, RAG reporting) and holding cross-functional teams to commitments.
* Excellent communicator — comfortable presenting to CTO/executive leadership and to customers, and able to translate deep technical detail into business language and back.
* Experience working alongside (not replacing) a strong technical architect — clear sense of where product ownership ends and architecture ownership begins, and how to partner rather than compete.
* Working knowledge of security operations concepts: detection & response, threat intelligence, SIEM/XDR/UEBA, identity security, or adjacent domains.
* Compliance & Governance Alignment: Ensure all engineering processes, data handling pipelines, and architectural patterns adhere strictly to industry certifications relevant to a scaling mid-size company (**SOC2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA**, etc.).

**Preferred**
-------------

* Prior experience specifically in MXDR, MDR, SIEM, XDR, or broader security operations product lines.
* Experience navigating compliance-driven sales cycles (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001) and their impact on roadmap and architecture decisions.
* Experience building or scaling a product function — hiring and mentoring product managers, delivery leads, or program managers.
* Familiarity with modern detection engineering concepts (behavioral analytics, ML-based detection, identity threat detection) sufficient to evaluate technical proposals critically.

title: Senior Consultant - D365
description:
About Ellucian:

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.

About the Opportunity:

Are you an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365FO) developer with strong technical expertise in customizations, integrations, and solution development? Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and building scalable solutions that deliver value to customers? If so, we should talk!

Ellucian is seeking a D365FO Developer to join our Professional Services team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, customizing, and maintaining D365FO solutions that meet customer requirements. You will work closely with functional consultants, project managers, QA teams, and other developers to deliver high-quality technical solutions that support successful project delivery.

Our higher education customers are modernizing their business applications and adopting cloud-based solutions to improve operational efficiency and support institutional success. In this role, you will contribute to this transformation by developing and supporting D365FO customizations, integrations, reports, and extensions. You will also help troubleshoot technical issues, optimize application performance, and support deployment and upgrade activities while following Microsoft development best practices and Ellucian’s delivery standards.

**Where You Will Make an Impact**

* Design, develop, customize, and maintain Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365FO) solutions using X++ and the D365FO extensibility framework.
* Develop and enhance tables, forms, classes, data entities, SSRS reports, and business logic to meet customer requirements.
* Design, develop, and maintain integrations between D365FO and external systems using APIs, OData, custom services, and other integration technologies.
* Troubleshoot technical issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions while ensuring application stability and performance.
* Support code reviews, unit testing, debugging, and performance optimization to deliver high-quality, maintainable solutions.
* Work with Azure DevOps (ADO) for source control, version management, build processes, and deployable package preparation.
* Collaborate with functional consultants, project managers, QA teams, and other developers to deliver customizations and enhancements on time.
* Support D365FO application updates and upgrades by assessing customization impacts, resolving compatibility issues, and performing regression testing.
* Prepare technical documentation and follow development standards and best practices to ensure maintainability and scalability of solutions.

**What You Will Bring**

* Minimum 5–6 years of experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations (D365FO) development.
* Strong proficiency in X++ programming, including classes, tables, forms, queries, extensions, event handlers, and Chain of Command (CoC).
* Hands-on experience developing and maintaining D365FO customizations using Microsoft’s extensibility framework and best practices.
* Experience developing and supporting data entities, SSRS reports, business logic, and integrations with external systems.
* Strong understanding of D365FO architecture, application models, packages, metadata, and development environments.
* Experience developing integrations using OData, REST APIs, custom services, and JSON/XML.
* Proficiency in debugging, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolving technical issues related to D365FO customizations and integrations.
* Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO), including source control, branching, pull requests, build processes, and deployment package preparation.
* Understanding of D365FO build and deployment processes, database synchronization, environment management, and release practices.

title: Lobby Ambassador
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Lobby Ambassador - Job Description
  
Position Overview
  
The Lobby Ambassador serves as the primary point of contact for all visitors, tenants, and guests entering the building. This role is responsible for creating exceptional first impressions, ensuring seamless visitor experiences, and maintaining security protocols while delivering outstanding customer service in a professional corporate environment.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Visitor and Guest Services
  
Greet all visitors with professionalism and warmth, creating a welcoming atmosphere. Verify visitor credentials, issue badges, and maintain accurate visitor logs in compliance with security protocols. Notify Business Units contacts of guest arrivals promptly and courteously. Manage visitor check-in and check-out procedures efficiently while ensuring all security requirements are met.
  
  
Reception and Administrative Support
  
Answer incoming calls professionally and direct inquiries to appropriate parties. Provide accurate information about building amenities, tenant locations, and local area services. Coordinate meeting room reservations and conference services as needed. Receive, log, and distribute packages and deliveries to tenants. Assist with mail distribution and courier services.
  
Security and Access Control
  
Monitor building access points and ensure only authorized individuals enter the premises. Enforce building security policies consistently and professionally. Report security concerns, suspicious activity, or safety hazards immediately to management and security teams. Maintain awareness of emergency procedures and assist during evacuations or critical incidents. Issue temporary access cards and track their return.
  
Workspace and Environment Management
  
Maintain the lobby's professional appearance throughout the day. Ensure reception area remains clean, organized, and presentable. Refresh reading materials, brochures, and informational displays regularly. Monitor and report maintenance needs including lighting, temperature control, and equipment malfunctions.
  
Required Qualifications
  
Education and Experience
  
Bachelor degree in any steam or equivalent associate degree or relevant coursework preferred. Minimum 1-2 years of experience in customer service, hospitality, reception, or front desk roles. Experience in corporate office environments or commercial real estate settings is advantageous.
  
  
Skills and Competencies
  
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with diverse individuals at all organizational levels. Strong customer service orientation with a genuine desire to help others. Professional appearance and demeanor that reflects positively on the building. Basic computer proficiency including Microsoft Office Suite and visitor management systems. Ability to learn building-specific technology platforms quickly.
  
Personal Attributes
  
Reliable and punctual with strong work ethic. Friendly, approachable demeanor with positive attitude. Discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive information. Cultural awareness and ability to work effectively with diverse populations. Flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and situations. Team player who collaborates well with building staff and management.
  
Physical Requirements
  
Ability to stand for extended periods during shifts. Monitor lobby activities and communicate effectively. Mobility to move throughout the lobby area and assist visitors as needed.
  
Work Schedule
  
Full-time position with standard business hours, typically Monday through Friday. Flexibility for occasional extended hours during building events or special circumstances. Shift work may be required depending on building operations.
  
Reporting Structure
  
Reports directly to the Facilities Manager. Collaborates closely with corporate security teams.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –
  
  
We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  
Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  
Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.

title: Industry Solution Leader - Oil, Gas & Chemical (Refining / Chemical Asset Performance)
description:
C3 AI (NYSE: AI), is the Enterprise AI application software company. C3 AI delivers a family of fully integrated products including the C3 Agentic AI Platform, an end\-to\-end platform for developing, deploying, and operating enterprise AI applications, C3 AI applications, a portfolio of industry\-specific SaaS enterprise AI applications that enable the digital transformation of organizations globally, and C3 Generative AI, a suite of domain\-specific generative AI offerings for the enterprise. Learn more at: **C3 AI**


C3 AI is seeking an Industry Solution Leader (ISL) for Oil, Gas \& Chemical to lead the design and delivery of enterprise AI solutions for its clients with a specialization in Refining / Chemical Asset Performance.



Industry Solution Leaders combine deep industry and engineering expertise with end\-to\-end ownership of customer solutions. They are expected to understand a customer's operations deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify and quantify the highest\-value opportunities, define the right technical solution, and lead cross\-functional teams through design, deployment, validation, and scale.



The role combines the responsibilities of a senior domain expert and solution leader. Industry Solution Directors work directly with customer engineering, operations, maintenance, and executive teams while leading C3 AI Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product teams, and other technical resources to deliver measurable business outcomes.



The ideal candidate brings significant hands\-on experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, or maintenance and has the technical judgment, customer leadership, and delivery ownership required to lead complex enterprise AI solutions from problem definition through production.



The ISL, Oil, Gas \& Chemical \- Refining / Chemical Asset Performance should have **hands\-on experience working inside a refinery, chemical plant, or similar continuous\-process facility, including distillation, reactors, furnaces, compressors, heat exchangers, or utilities, with ownership of throughput, yield, energy, APC/process control, or reliability outcomes.**


**RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Own the overall solution strategy, technical direction, and delivery outcomes for assigned customer engagements, maintaining accountability from initial problem definition through production deployment and scale.
* Serve as the primary customer\-facing solution leader and domain expert, developing a detailed understanding of customer operations, equipment, processes, constraints, and business objectives.
* Identify and quantify high\-impact business opportunities across equipment reliability, maintenance, production performance, process optimization, throughput, yield, quality, energy efficiency, and operating economics.
* Translate complex engineering and operational challenges into tractable AI, machine learning, optimization, and software problems with clearly defined requirements, success criteria, and expected business value.
* Lead engagements through use case definition, requirements gathering, solution architecture, application configuration, validation, production deployment, user adoption, and scale\-out.
* Apply deep engineering and industry expertise to challenge assumptions, evaluate technical approaches, interpret analytical results, and ensure solutions are consistent with engineering fundamentals and operational realities.
* Lead cross\-functional teams of Forward Deployed Engineers, data scientists, product managers, engineers, and industry experts, establishing technical priorities and driving alignment around customer outcomes.
* Work directly with customer engineers, operators, reliability teams, maintenance organizations, and executives to validate requirements, solution performance, operational workflows, and business impact.
* Guide the interpretation and use of industrial data, including process signals, equipment attributes, operating states, maintenance history, production information, alarms, quality data, and other engineering information required to solve customer problems.
* Maintain accountability for solution quality, business value, technical risks, delivery progress, customer adoption, and executive communication throughout the engagement.
* Partner with C3 AI product management and engineering teams to identify reusable capabilities, inform product development, and scale successful solutions across assets, production lines, facilities, and business units.
* Support sales teams during opportunity assessment and capture by helping define customer problems, solution approaches, business value, technical requirements, deployment strategy, and demonstrations.
* Support development of statements of work and deployment plans, ensuring scope, deliverables, assumptions, data requirements, risks, timelines, and resource requirements are clearly defined.
* Develop repeatable industry methodologies, solution patterns, and best practices and represent C3 AI in relevant customer, industry, and technical forums.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline. Mechanical, Chemical, Electrical, Industrial, Mining, Metallurgical, Petroleum, Materials, or similar engineering backgrounds are preferred.
* 7\+ years of experience in engineering, manufacturing, operations, reliability, maintenance, industrial technology, or technically focused consulting.
* Deep experience in one or more asset\-intensive industries, including high\-tech or semiconductor manufacturing, steel and metals, minerals and mining, utilities and power generation, oil and gas, chemicals, petrochemicals, LNG, pharmaceuticals, or heavy manufacturing.
* Demonstrated experience solving complex operational problems and improving equipment reliability, production performance, throughput, yield, quality, maintenance effectiveness, energy efficiency, or operating economics.
* Strong understanding of industrial equipment, manufacturing or production processes, process controls, maintenance practices, and operational workflows.
* Experience working with industrial data including sensor and time\-series data, equipment states, alarms, maintenance history, production data, laboratory or quality information, equipment hierarchies, and engineering data.
* Experience with industrial systems such as process historians, SCADA, DCS, MES, EAM/CMMS, ERP, advanced process control, or industrial analytics platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to reason from engineering fundamentals and determine whether analytical and AI\-driven recommendations are physically, technically, and operationally credible.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, customer\-facing technical engagements and working directly with engineering, operational, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to structure ambiguous problems, establish priorities, and drive teams toward practical solutions.
* Ability to work effectively with software engineers, data scientists, product managers, and customer technical teams and translate between domain, business, and technical requirements.
* Excellent presentation, written communication, leadership, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to travel to customer locations as required.


**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Experience delivering AI, machine learning, advanced analytics, optimization, predictive maintenance, condition monitoring, process optimization, or industrial digital transformation solutions.
* Hands\-on technical experience working with industrial data, SQL, Python, analytics tools, application configuration, scripting, or similar technologies, with the ability to directly inspect data, prototype analyses, and troubleshoot solution behavior.
* Experience with rotating equipment, electrical equipment, production equipment, manufacturing lines, process units, mining systems, utility assets, or other complex industrial systems.
* Experience taking technical solutions from initial proof of value through production deployment and scale.
* Experience scaling solutions across multiple assets, plants, facilities, or business units.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Science, or a related technical discipline.


**C3 AI provides excellent benefits, a competitive compensation package and generous equity plan.**


C3 AI is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics, including disabled and veteran status.

title: Director Guest Service Center
description:
**About Us**  

Working at Target means helping all families discover the joy of everyday life. We bring that vision to life through our values and culture. Target is an iconic brand, a Fortune 50 company and one of America's leading retailers.  

Target Enterprise Services (TES) is close to the action when it comes to supporting guests, team members and enterprise partners. Through our Service Centers, we deliver exceptional experiences, resolve complex issues, generate business insights and help shape enterprise decisions that improve the end\-to\-end guest journey.

**About the Role**  

As a Director, Service Center, you will lead a large\-scale service center operation while serving as a strategic voice for the guest across the enterprise. You will lead an internal team of 6 to 10 Sr.Manager or Managers and 100\+ team members servicing guest contacts to deliver exceptional guest outcomes, operational excellence and team engagement while influencing broader business decisions that improve the end\-to\-end guest experience.

  

This role requires a balance of operational leadership, strategic thinking, innovation and enterprise influence. You will leverage guest feedback, contact drivers, data insights and operational intelligence to identify friction points, influence upstream solutions and improve how Target serves guests across channels.  

You will partner closely with Product, Technology, Digital, Stores, Operations, Merchandising and other enterprise teams to transform insights into action, drive innovation and shape the future of service delivery through automation, AI and evolving operating models.

**Core Responsibilities**  

**Guest Experience Leadership**  

* Champion the voice of the guest by using service center insights, guest feedback and journey analytics to influence business priorities and improve experiences.
* Ensure service center strategies align with Target's commitment to delivering


differentiated and connected guest experiences.  

* Identify and remove friction points across guest journeys by partnering with enterprise teams to implement scalable solutions.
* Measure, monitor and improve guest experience outcomes across channels and


touchpoints. Service Center Operations \& Organizational Leadership  

* Lead a large, complex service center organization through senior leaders, managers and team leaders.
* Deliver performance across service, quality, productivity, cost and team engagement metrics.
* Establish operating rhythms and accountability mechanisms that drive business results and continuous improvement.
* Balance short\-term performance needs with long\-term capability building and


transformation priorities.  

* Foster an inclusive, high\-performing culture focused on guest outcomes and operational excellence. Insights\-to\-Action Leadership
* Translate service center signals, contact drivers, sentiment trends and operational insights into actionable business recommendations.
* Partner with Analytics, Research and Product teams to identify systemic issues and opportunities.
* Influence enterprise decisions by framing root causes, quantifying business impact and recommending sustainable solutions.
* Shift organizational focus from resolving individual contacts to eliminating the causes of repeat contacts.
**Product, Technology \& AI Partnership**  

* Partner with Product, Technology and Digital teams to influence the design of


experiences, tools and processes that improve guest outcomes.  

* Evaluate emerging technologies, automation solutions and AI capabilities to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
* Drive adoption of AI\-enabled workflows and operating models that enhance both guest and team member experiences.
* Ensure technology implementations align with operational needs, controls and service objectives.
**Enterprise Leadership \& Influence**  

* Build trusted partnerships across Product, Technology, Stores, Operations,


Merchandising, Finance, Human Resources and other enterprise functions.  

* Influence senior leaders through data\-driven insights, operational expertise and guest\- centered recommendations.
* Drive shared accountability for enterprise guest outcomes across organizational


boundaries.  

* Represent Service Center perspectives during strategic business initiatives and


transformation efforts.**Transformation \& Change Leadership**  

* Lead large\-scale operational and organizational transformation initiatives.
* Navigate ambiguity while balancing service delivery, experience, technology, talent and financial considerations.
* Design and implement future\-ready operating models that incorporate automation, AI and evolving customer expectations.
* Lead teams through change while maintaining engagement, performance and business continuity.
 **Talent \& Organizational Capability**  

* Build diverse leadership pipelines and future\-ready organizational capabilities.
* Develop leaders through coaching, sponsorship, mentoring and meaningful growth opportunities.
* Anticipate evolving skill requirements as technology changes the nature of work and service delivery.
* Create career pathways and capability strategies that support long\-term organizational success.
 **Minimum Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 10\+ years of progressive leadership experience in service centers, contact centers, customer experience, operations, shared services or related environments.
* Demonstrated experience leading large, complex service organizations and developing high\-performing teams.
* Experience improving end\-to\-end guest, customer or consumer experiences.
* Proven ability to translate operational insights into strategic business actions.
* Experience partnering with Product, Technology, Analytics or Digital teams to improve customer experiences.
* Strong strategic thinking, business acumen and decision\-making capabilities.
* Demonstrated success leading through change and ambiguity.
* Exceptional stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills.
* Experience leveraging technology, automation and AI\-enabled solutions to improve business outcomes.
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience leading large\-scale service transformation efforts.
* Experience working within retail, e\-commerce, consumer\-facing or omnichannel


environments.  

* Experience redesigning workflows and operating models using automation or GenAI capabilities.
* Experience influencing enterprise strategy through customer insights and operational intelligence.
* Experience managing complex cross\-functional portfolios and executive\-level


partnerships. **Working at Target**  

We are committed to creating meaningful experiences for our guests and team members. As a Director, Service Center, you will have the opportunity to shape strategy, influence enterprise outcomes, develop future leaders, and make a significant impact on the success of Target's business and culture.

title: Senior Architect (Data, Cloud, AI)
description:
About Ellucian:

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI\-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best\-in\-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data\-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.
About the Opportunity:

Ellucian is seeking a highly skilled and innovative Senior Architect to lead the architecture and technical strategy for our next\-generation Data Platform and analytics solution. This role will be instrumental in transforming our current data warehouse ecosystem into a modern, scalable, cloud\-native Lakehouse platform capable of supporting analytics, AI/ML workloads, agentic AI experiences, and real\-time data products.


This is a hands\-on architecture leadership role requiring deep expertise in data platforms, data warehouse, distributed systems, cloud technologies, and emerging AI technologies.


As a key technical leader , role offers opportunities to spearhead technical initiatives, mentor engineers at all levels, and work closely with internal product managers, experienced engineers, and cross\-functional teams to design, develop, test, and deliver advanced features that enhance student success and drive higher education transformation.

**Where You Will Make an Impact**

**Architecture \& Strategy**

* Build and own the target\-state architecture for a next\-generation Lakehouse platform.
* Develop technology roadmaps aligned with business strategy and product vision.
* Lead architectural decisions across data ingestion, storage, processing, governance, observability, security, and AI enablement.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, and reference architectures.

**Platform Modernization**

* Lead migration from traditional data warehouse architectures to modern Lakehouse architectures.
* Design scalable data platforms supporting structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data.
* Evaluate and drive adoption of technologies such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, DuckDB, Trino, Flink, Kafka, and cloud\-native analytics services.
* Design multi\-tenant SaaS architectures with strong security and data isolation.

**AI \& Intelligent Data Platform**

* Define architecture patterns enabling AI\-powered data experiences.
* Design platforms supporting:
* + Generative AI applications
	+ Agentic AI workflows
	+ Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
	+ Vector databases and semantic search
	+ AI\-assisted analytics and insights
* Partner with AI teams to operationalize ML and GenAI workloads.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine applicability to the platform roadmap.

**Technical Leadership**

* Take ownership of critical tasks from specification review through final testing and deployment, ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Serve as the highest level technical authority for the platform.
* Mentor architects and senior engineers.
* Conduct architecture reviews and guide critical design decisions.
* Drive engineering excellence and technical innovation across teams.

**Scalability, Reliability \& Operations**

* Architect for high availability, performance, resiliency, and cost optimization.
* Define observability and operational excellence standards.
* Drive platform reliability through automation and SRE practices.
* Establish governance around performance, security, compliance, and data quality.

**What You Will Bring**

* **Experience**: Bachelor / Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, AI, or related field. Overall 15\+ years of software engineering exp with 7\+ years of professional software development experience in a product or SaaS environment building modern Data platform.
* Deep expertise in modern data architectures including Data warehouse, Data Mesh, Data platforms.
* Deep expertise in distributed data processing frameworks, Apache Spark, Trino, Flink, Kafka.
* Experience with open table formats, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake.

  

* Strong understanding of Metadata management, Lineage, observability.
* **Distributed Systems**: Experience designing, building, and evolving large\-scale distributed systems, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and highly available production services.
* **Cloud and Platform Engineering**: Strong knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, containerization, infrastructure automation, and modern operational practices for reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* **Engineering Excellence**: Deep experience with CI/CD, code review, test automation, observability, release engineering, and DevOps practices in modern software delivery environments.
* **Security and Risk Awareness**: Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, encryption, secure design, and practical application security principles in enterprise software.
* **LLM and Agentic Systems Experience**: Demonstrated experience building or guiding solutions that use large language models, including agent\-based workflows, prompt and context design, tool orchestration, structured outputs, and human\-in\-the\-loop validation patterns.
* **Model Selection and Evaluation**: Experience working with multiple LLMs or AI providers and making practical tradeoff decisions across model quality, latency, cost, reliability, safety, and enterprise suitability.
* **AI Engineering Practices**: Understanding of core patterns for production AI systems such as retrieval\-augmented generation, evaluation frameworks, observability, prompt management, guardrails, fallback strategies, and secure handling of sensitive data.
* **Judgment and Governance**: Ability to evaluate AI\-generated output critically, define validation standards, identify risk areas, and maintain human accountability for technical decisions and delivered outcomes.
* **Technical Communication**: Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills, with the ability to align engineers, product partners, and stakeholders around technical direction and execution tradeoffs.
* **Mentorship and Influence**: Proven experience mentoring engineers, leading technical discussions, raising engineering standards, and shaping development practices across a team or organization.

**Job Description**

**So, who are we?**

  

IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1\.3m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. What that means for the people who work here is real: genuinely complex problems to solve, the technology and resources to tackle them properly, and the kind of scope that's rare in established businesses.


The bar is high – bring a curious and forward\-thinking mindset and we'll give you the platform to define what comes next. Join us at IG – the future gets built here *.*

**Your team**

You will sit within the global customer experience team and have a SEO manager to support on day\-to\-day execution and two Content Editors who produce and optimise the editorial output across ig.com.


**Your role in the Team’s Success**

The Manager of Training \& Knowledge Management will lead IG Group’s strategy for customer support learning, product knowledge, and knowledge management within the Trading Services function. This role combines leadership, strategic vision, and digital innovation. You will oversee the design and delivery of training programs (using platforms such as Sana or other AI\-enabled learning solutions), manage our knowledge systems, and ensure that our teams across the globe have the skills and resources to provide exceptional customer experiences.


**What you’ll do**

**Learning \& Training Strategy**

* Define and implement a global learning strategy that equips customer support teams with skills in product knowledge, customer service, compliance, and digital tools.
* Leverage AI\-powered learning platforms to create scalable, adaptive, and personalised learning solutions.
* Embed continuous learning into onboarding, career pathways, and product adoption initiatives.

**Knowledge Management**

* Develop and own Trading Services knowledge management strategy, ensuring critical product and process knowledge is structured, accessible, and always up\-to\-date.
* Integrate knowledge bases, AI chatbots, and digital tools to support just\-in\-time learning and problem solving.

**Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of learning designers, trainers, and knowledge managers.
* Partner with senior leaders across Product, Compliance, and Trading and Operations to align learning and knowledge initiatives to business priorities.
* Act as a thought leader for innovative training practices, championing digital transformation in learning.

**Measurement \& Impact**

* Define KPIs for learning and knowledge initiatives, using analytics and AI insights to demonstrate business impact.
* Drive continuous improvement by incorporating learner feedback, data, and performance outcomes into strategy.

**What you’ll need for this role**

**Key Qualification Requirements:**

* Proven senior experience in learning \& development, training, or knowledge management leadership roles.
* Strong track record in designing and implementing corporate learning strategies.
* Experience with AI\-enabled learning and knowledge management platforms (Sana, Docebo, Cornerstone, ServiceNow KM, or similar).
* Demonstrated success in leading teams and managing global stakeholders.
* Excellent business acumen and ability to align learning strategy with operational and commercial goals.

**Bonus if you have:**

* Background in financial services, fintech, or trading environments.
* Experience driving digital transformation in customer service organisations.
* Familiarity with regulatory training requirements in financial markets.

**How we work**

We try to take a thoughtful approach to our ways of working as a company. We follow a hybrid working model with 3 days in the office – which we think balances the need to collaborate effectively and connect with each other . When it comes to how we deliver, there are 5 things we want everyone to do to drive high performance, better learning and career satisfaction:


* **Lead and Inspire:** Drives trust, alignment, and enthusiasm
* **Think Big:** Focus on the problems that most impact commercial outcomes
* **Champion the client:** Understand and prioritise client's needs
* **Deliver at pace:** Push for fast, sustainable growth;
* **Raise the bar:** Take ownership, be accountable and share feedback

We believe that diversity is vital to success, it fuels creativity, drives innovation and sets us up for global success. We’re committed to building teams with a variety of perspectives and skills to help us realise our vision and strategy, that’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join us on this journey.


**The Perks**

Your growth fuels our success! Thrive with tailored development programs, mentoring opportunities with leaders, and clear career progression. Expand your network through committees, sports and social clubs. Enjoy extra time off for volunteering and community work.  



**Join us for this exciting journey.** **Apply now!**

### **Role Overview**



We are hiring an **Engineering Manager – Platform Engineering** to lead multiple teams building and delivering high\-quality, scalable, and performant **core functionality** for telematic platform.



This is a **people and delivery leadership role**, responsible for execution, engineering excellence, and team growth within the **Experience Engineering stack**. You will work closely with the Architect (for architecture) and **Engineering teams** (for design alignment), ensuring seamless delivery of consistent and high\-quality functionalities.



This role is accountable for executing and building core functionality to support multiple dependent applications.


**What You’ll Do**


**People Leadership \& Team Development**


* Build, lead, and grow **high\-performing engineering teams**.
* Manage and coach **senior engineers, tech leads, and emerging leaders**.
* Drive a culture of **accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement**.
* Own:
* Hiring, onboarding, and retention
* Performance management and career development
* Succession planning and team structure


**Delivery \& Execution Excellence**


* Own **end\-to\-end delivery** of engineering initiatives across multiple teams.
* Translate product and architecture inputs into **execution plans with clear milestones**.
* Manage:
* Sprint execution, backlog prioritization, and release planning
* Risks, dependencies, and cross\-team coordination
* Ensure **predictable, high\-quality releases** using defined engineering metrics:
* Lead time
* Change failure rate
* Ensure predictable and well\-governed framework releases, including:
* Release notes
* Migration guides
* Backward compatibility considerations


**Technical Execution \& Platform Delivery**


* Drive delivery and implementation of **core platform** using Java, AWS, backend development tools.
* Ensure alignment with **architecture standards defined by the Architect**.
* Drive **core functionality** across teams by:
* Defining clear usage guidelines, patterns, and documentation
* Monitoring and improving core platform
* Partner with the **Architect** to implement architectural standards and ensure alignment with the broader strategy.
* Establish scalable processes for:
* Documentation and developer onboarding
* Feedback loops to continuously improve the platform
* Manage **dependencies and rollout strategies** across multiple teams.
* Define support and development, including issue triage, resolution timelines, and escalation paths for consuming teams.


**Platform Adoption \& Engineering Metrics**


* Define and track success metrics for platform, including:
* Developer onboarding time and productivity
* Defect trends and issue resolution timelines
* Use insights from usage and feedback to drive **continuous improvement of the platform**.


**Engineering Excellence \& Quality**


* Own enforcement of engineering quality standards and drive consistency across all teams.
* Ensure adherence to **engineering standards, coding guidelines, and best practices** defined at the org level.
* Drive implementation of:
* Automated testing (unit, integration, regression)
* CI/CD pipelines and release automation
* Track and improve **code quality, defect rates, and technical debt** within teams.
* Ensure **code quality (SonarQube), open\-source governance (FOSSA), and CI/CD quality gates**


**Performance, Reliability \& Observability**


* Ensure delivery meets **performance benchmarks.**
* Drive adoption of:
* Monitoring and observability (logs, alerts)
* Incident management and root cause analysis.
* Ensure systems meet **availability, scalability, and reliability expectations**.


**DevOps \& Release Management**


* Establish strong **release governance and operational cadence.**
* Progressive delivery (canary, blue\-green deployments)


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Partner with:
* **Architect** for technical direction
* **Product teams** for roadmap alignment
* **Platform/Cloud teams** for scalability and reliability
* Communicate progress, risks, and trade\-offs to stakeholders.

### **Qualifications**


* 12\&\#43; years of software engineering experience with strong focus on **backed\-end technologies**.
* 3–6\&\#43; years of experience managing **engineering teams**.
* Proven experience delivering **large\-scale product**.
* Strong expertise in:
* Java, AWS
* Back\-end architecture and scalable systems
* Experience working with **design systems and component\-driven development**.

September 16, 2026 \- October 1, 2026



Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply

title: Customer Relationship Executive
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a proactive and empathetic Relationship Manager to join our Relationship Marketing team at KoinBX. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our users throughout their lifecycle — from their very first sign\-up and KYC verification to becoming confident, active traders on the platform.

You will own the end\-to\-end user onboarding experience, conduct user interviews to uncover pain points and feature needs, and serve as the voice of the customer to internal product and leadership teams. The ideal candidate combines strong communication skills with a genuine curiosity about user behaviour and a passion for crypto and Web3\.

Key Responsibilities

Onboarding \& User Support

* Guide new users through the complete onboarding journey — account creation, KYC verification, first deposit, and first trade — ensuring a smooth, friction\-free experience.
* Proactively identify and resolve onboarding drop\-offs by reaching out to stalled users via calls, emails, or in\-app messages.
* Maintain a structured onboarding playbook and continuously update it based on user feedback and product changes.
* Track and report onboarding completion rates, time\-to\-first\-trade, and other funnel metrics weekly.

User Research \& Interviews

* Plan, schedule, and conduct structured user interviews (1\-on\-1 calls, surveys, feedback sessions) to deeply understand user pain points, motivations, and trading behaviour.
* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative user insights into actionable reports for the Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
* Build and maintain a user research repository — tagging insights by theme (e.g., UX friction, feature requests, trust concerns, pricing feedback).
* Recruit and manage a panel of power users and early adopters for ongoing beta testing and feedback loops.

Relationship Marketing \& Retention

* Design and execute lifecycle campaigns (welcome sequences, re\-engagement, milestone celebrations) in coordination with the Marketing team.
* Segment the user base by activity level, trading volume, and engagement score to personalise outreach and retention strategies.
* Own NPS, CSAT, and user health score tracking; flag at\-risk cohorts and implement targeted win\-back initiatives.
* Drive referral program adoption and community engagement by nurturing relationships with high\-value and high\-influence users.

Internal Communication \& Advocacy

* Act as the "Voice of the Customer" — regularly present user insights, recurring complaints, and feature requests to the Product Manager, Design Lead, and senior leadership.
* Collaborate with the Customer Support team to escalate systemic issues and close the loop on user\-reported bugs.
* Prepare weekly and monthly user sentiment reports with clear, data\-backed recommendations for cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Partner with Marketing on user testimonials, case studies, and community content by identifying and nurturing brand advocates.

Required Qualifications

* 2–5 years of experience in Relationship Management, Customer Success, Account Management, or User Research — preferably in a fintech, crypto, or high\-growth product company.
* Demonstrated experience in conducting user interviews, surveys, and qualitative research.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; proficiency in Hindi is must and other regional languages is a plus.
* Empathetic, patient, and user\-first mindset — you genuinely enjoy helping people solve problems.
* Analytical thinking: comfort with data, funnels, and metrics (onboarding rates, NPS, CSAT, retention cohorts).
* Self\-starter who thrives in a fast\-paced, ambiguous startup environment with minimal hand\-holding.

* Prior experience in the cryptocurrency, blockchain, or Web3 industry.
